SubjectLine: PAF LLS 185 Admin Only Invoice Summary
Query: select * from subscriptions.vw_claims_financial
ExportName: PAF LLS 185 Admin Only Invoice Summary

Query:
with data_filters as (
select 
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATEADD('day', 15,DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)))
ELSE date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) end as start_date,
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
ELSE date(DATEADD('day', 14, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))) end as end_date
)
,final_query as (
select 
distinct
c.batch_number as "Claim Batch Number",
c.claim_number as "Claim Number",
c.CLAIM_TYPE as "Claim Type",
ph.NABP_NUMBER as "Pharmacy Number",
mcf.chain_number as "Chain Number",
ph.PHARMACY_NAME as "Pharmacy Name",
mcf.reject_code_1 as "Reject Code 1",
mcf.reject_code_2 as "Reject Code 2",
mcf.rx_number as "Rx Number", 
to_char(mcf.rx_date,'mm/dd/yyyy') as "Rx Date",
mcf.NDC_TYPE_CODE as "Drug Type Code",
RIGHT(LPAD(CAST(mcf.ndc AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0'), 11) AS "National Drug Code",
mcf.prod_abbr as "Product Name",
CASE WHEN mcf.NEW_REFILL = 'N' THEN '0'
WHEN mcf.NEW_REFILL = 'R' THEN '1'
ELSE mcf.NEW_REFILL END AS "New/Refill Indicator",
mcf.metric_quantity as "Metric Quantity",
  mcf.DAYS_SUPPLY as "Days Supply"
  ,mcf.ing_billed as "Ingredient Cost Billed"
  ,mcf.ing_paid as "Ingredient Cost Paid"
  ,mcf.DISP_FEE as "Dispensing Fee",
  mcf.COPAY as "Copay",mcf.TAX as "Tax",mcf.AMOUNT_PAID as "Total Amount Paid",
  mcf.UCR_AMOUNT as "UCR Amount",
  to_char(mcf.BIRTH_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as "Member Birthdate",
  chd.SEX as "Member Sex",chd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER as "Cardholder Number", 
  chd.MEMBER_NUMBER as "Member Number",
  mcf.ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER as "Alternate Card Number",
  chd.RELATIONSHIP_CODE as "Patient Relationship",
  mcf.Physician_Number as "Physician Number",
  c.DIAGNOSIS_CODE as "Diagnosis Code", 
  grp.SYSTEM_NUMBER as "PDM System Number",
  grp.SPONSOR_NUMBER as "PDM Sponsor Number",
  grp.GROUP_NUMBER as "PDM Group Number",
  grp.ALT_GROUP_NUMBER as "Group Number",
  mcf.GENERIC_CODE as "Generic Code",
  c.MAC_NUMBER as "Mac Number",
  mcf.DAW_INDICATOR as "Daw Indicator",
  c.THERA_CLASS as "Therapeutic Class Code",
  mcf.RX_OTC as "Rx OTC Code",mcf.GPI,
  mcf.EXCEPTION_01 as "Exception Code 01",mcf.EXCEPTION_02 as "Exception Code 02",mcf.EXCEPTION_03 as "Exception Code 03",
  mcf.EXCEPTION_04 as "Exception Code 04",mcf.EXCEPTION_05 as "Exception Code 05",mcf.EXCEPTION_06 as "Exception Code 06",
  mcf.EXCEPTION_07 as "Exception Code 07",mcf.EXCEPTION_08 as "Exception Code 08",mcf.EXCEPTION_09 as "Exception Code 09",
  mcf.EXCEPTION_10 as "Exception Code 10",mcf.EXCEPTION_11 as "Exception Code 11",mcf.EXCEPTION_12 as "Exception Code 12",
  mcf.EXCEPTION_13 as "Exception Code 13",mcf.EXCEPTION_14 as "Exception Code 14",mcf.EXCEPTION_15 as "Exception Code 15",
  mcf.EXCEPTION_16 as "Exception Code 16",mcf.EXCEPTION_17 as "Exception Code 17",mcf.EXCEPTION_18 as "Exception Code 18",
  mcf.EXCEPTION_19 as "Exception Code 19",mcf.EXCEPTION_20 as "Exception Code 20",
  mcf.OVERRIDE_1 as "Override Code  01",mcf.OVERRIDE_2 as "Override Code  02",mcf.OVERRIDE_3 as "Override Code  03",
  mcf.OVERRIDE_4 as "Override Code  04",mcf.OVERRIDE_5 as "Override Code  05",mcf.OVERRIDE_6 as "Override Code  06",
  mcf.OVERRIDE_7 as "Override Code  07",mcf.OVERRIDE_8 as "Override Code  08",mcf.OVERRIDE_9 as "Override Code  09",
  mcf.OVERRIDE_10 as "Override Code  10"
  , to_char(mcf.PERIOD_ENDING,'mm/dd/yyyy') as "Period Ending", 
  null as "Paid Date",
  mcf.COMPOUND_CODE as "Compound Code",
  to_char(c.BATCH_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as "Batch Date",
  c.CLAIMS_COUNTER as "Claim Counter",
  mcf.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG as "Mail Order",
  grp.GROUP_BENEFIT_CODE "Benefit Code",
  c.AWP_100_PERCENT as "AWP",
  mcf.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR as "Claim Indicator",
  c.DRUG_PREF_IND as "Drug Preference Indicator",
  c.PRICE_INDICATOR as "Pricing Indicator",
  dd.MANUF_NAME_ABBR as "Drug Manufacturer",dd.DEA_CODE as "Controlled Substance",
  chd.LAST_NAME as "Patient Last Name",
  chd.FIRST_NAME as "Patient First Name",
  chd.MIDDLE_INITIAL as "Patient Middle Initial",
  c.THIRD_PARTY_CODE as "Third Party Code",
  ph.NPI_NUMBER as "Pharmacy NPI Number",mcf.rx_number as "D.0 Rx Number",
  mcf.OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE as "Other Coverage Code",
  mcf.DEDUCT_AMT as "Deductible Amount",
  chd.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD as "Number on Card",null as "FILLER"
 from
(select chain_number, reject_code_1,reject_code_2,rx_number, rx_date, NEW_REFILL, metric_quantity,physician_number,
DAYS_SUPPLY, ingredient_billed as ing_billed, client_ingredient_paid as ing_paid, client_dispensing_fee as DISP_FEE,
patient_pay as COPAY, TAX, client_amount_paid as AMOUNT_PAID, UCR_AMOUNT, GENERIC_CODE, DAW_INDICATOR,rx_otc_code as RX_OTC,
PERIOD_ENDING,COMPOUND_CODE,MAIL_ORDER_FLAG, CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE, deduct_amount as DEDUCT_AMT,
amount_copay as AMT_COPAY,NDC_TYPE_CODE, NDC,prod_abbreviation as prod_abbr,MANUF_NAME_ABBR,controlled_substance_indicator as dea_code,
cardholderbirthdate as BIRTH_DATE,CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,groupnumber as GROUP_NUMBER,claim_key, gpi
 ,EXCEPTION_01,EXCEPTION_02,EXCEPTION_03,EXCEPTION_04,EXCEPTION_05,EXCEPTION_06,EXCEPTION_07,EXCEPTION_08,EXCEPTION_09,EXCEPTION_10,EXCEPTION_11,EXCEPTION_12,EXCEPTION_13,EXCEPTION_14,EXCEPTION_15,EXCEPTION_16,EXCEPTION_17,EXCEPTION_18,EXCEPTION_19,EXCEPTION_20,OVERRIDE_1,OVERRIDE_2,OVERRIDE_3,OVERRIDE_4,OVERRIDE_5,OVERRIDE_6,OVERRIDE_7,OVERRIDE_8,OVERRIDE_9,OVERRIDE_10
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial where process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) AND (select end_date from data_filters)
and systemnumber = 192 and CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR in ('Y','C')) mcf 
inner join
(select BATCH_DATE, batch_number, claim_number, CLAIM_TYPE, PAYMENT_DIR, DIAGNOSIS_CODE,MAC_NUMBER,THERA_CLASS,claim_key,
cardholder_key, pharmacy_number,drug_key,CLAIMS_COUNTER,AWP_100_PERCENT,DRUG_PREF_IND,PRICE_INDICATOR,THIRD_PARTY_CODE from cloud_data_warehouse.claims WHERE meta_curr_ind ='Y' and process_date BETWEEN 
(select start_date from data_filters) AND (select end_date from data_filters) 
and sys_number = 192 and CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR in ('Y','C')) c on mcf.claim_key =c.claim_key
inner join 
(select systemnumber as SYSTEM_NUMBER,sponsornumber as SPONSOR_NUMBER,alternate_group_number as ALT_GROUP_NUMBER,
GROUP_BENEFIT_CODE,GROUPNUMBER as GROUP_NUMBER from subscriptions.vw_group_extract) grp on grp.GROUP_NUMBER =mcf.GROUP_NUMBER 
inner join 
(select SEX,CARDHOLDER_NUMBER, MEMBER_NUMBER,RELATIONSHIP_CODE,LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, MIDDLE_INITIAL,CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
CARDHOLDER_KEY from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') chd on chd.CARDHOLDER_KEY = c.CARDHOLDER_KEY
inner join
(select drug_key,dea_code,manuf_name_abbr,prod_abbr,ndc,ndc_type_code from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind='Y') dd on dd.drug_key=c.drug_key
inner join 
(select pharmacy_number from cloud_data_warehouse.pharmacy_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') pd on pd.pharmacy_number = c.pharmacy_number
inner join 
(select gpi from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data  where meta_curr_ind ='Y') gpi on gpi.gpi=mcf.gpi
 inner join
(select chain_number,chain_name from cloud_data_warehouse.chain_data where meta_curr_ind='Y') chn on chn.chain_number=mcf.chain_number
inner join 
(select NABP_NUMBER, PHARMACY_NAME,NPI_NUMBER  from cloud_data_warehouse.phdem where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and system_number =0) ph
on ph.NABP_NUMBER = c.pharmacy_number
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT p.hms_piid, p.npi, d.dea, p."last" AS lastname, p."first" AS firstname, p.middle AS middleinitial, a.address1, a.address2, a.city, a.state, a.zip, a.phone1, a.phone2, a.fax, p.practitioner_type, p.gender, p.date_born, p.date_died, p.active_flag, p.medicare_participation, p.npi_taxonomy_description,p.suffix, p.cred
   FROM hms.hms_practitioner_profile p
   LEFT JOIN hms.hms_dea d ON p.hms_piid::text = d.hms_piid::text AND d.rank = 1
   LEFT JOIN hms.hms_address a ON a.hms_piid::text = p.hms_piid::text AND a.rank = 1) DEA ON mcf.physician_number::character(50) = DEA.DEA
LEFT JOIN (select npi,first_name,last_name,middle_initial,business_name,entity_code from cloud_data_warehouse.npi where meta_curr_ind ='Y') NPI ON mcf.physician_number::character(50) = NPI.npi)
select * from final_query order by "Claim Batch Number","Claim Number";

WITH date_filters AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN TO_CHAR(date_add('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE)), 'YYYY-MM') || '-24'
         WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 8 AND 15 THEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM') || '-01'
         WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 16 AND 23 THEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM') || '-08'
         WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 24 AND 31 THEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM') || '-16'
    END AS start_date,
    CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN TO_CHAR(date_add('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
         WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 8 AND 15 THEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM') || '-07'
         WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 16 AND 23 THEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM') || '-15'
         WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 24 AND 31 THEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM') || '-23'
    END AS end_date
),
final_query as (
select
	sponsornumber::varchar as "Number",
	sponsor_name as "Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	'' as "Rel",
	'' as "Birth Date",
	'' as "Rx Date",
	'' as "Rx Number",
	null as "D/S",
	null as "Met Qua",
	count(*) as "Claims",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar)as "Ing Paid",
	'$' || cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar)as "Disp & Tax",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid + client_dispensing_fee + tax) as varchar)as "Total",
	'$' || cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar)as "Copay",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar)as "AMt PAID",
	null as "NCPDP",
	null as "Claim Key",
	'2' as typ,
	cast (systemnumber || sponsornumber as varchar) as key ,
	'2' order_by
from
	subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif mcfw
where
	systemnumber = 160  
	and sponsornumber = 2763
	and process_date between 
	 (select start_date from date_filters) and (
	 select end_date from date_filters)
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'N'
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
group by
	sponsor_name,
	sponsornumber,
	key
union all
select
	master_group::varchar || '-' || '000' as "Number",
	master_group_name as "Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	'' as "Rel",
	'' as "Birth Date",
	'' as "Rx Date",
	'' as "Rx Number",
	null as "D/S",
	null as "Met Qua",
	count(*) as "Claims",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar)as "Ing Paid",
	'$' || cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar)as "Disp & Tax",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid + client_dispensing_fee + tax) as varchar)as "Total",
	'$' || cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar)as "Copay",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar)as "AMt PAID",
	null as "NCPDP",
	null as "Claim Key",
	'3' as typ,
	cast ((systemnumber || sponsornumber || master_group) as varchar) as key ,
	'2' order_by
from
	subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif mcfw
where
	systemnumber = 160
	and sponsornumber = 2763
	and process_date between 
	(select start_date from date_filters) and (
	 select end_date from date_filters)
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'N'
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
group by
	master_group,
	master_group_name,
	key
union all
select
	SUBSTRING(cast(groupnumber as varchar),
	1,
	LENGTH(cast(groupnumber as varchar)) - 3) || '-' || right(cast(groupnumber as varchar),
	3) as Number ,
	group_name as "Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	'' as "Rel",
	'' as "Birth Date",
	'' as "Rx Date",
	'' as "Rx Number",
	null as "D/S",
	null as "Met Qua",
	count(*) as "Claims",
	('$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar)) as "Ing Paid",
	'$' || cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar)as "Disp & Tax",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid + client_dispensing_fee + tax) as varchar)as "Total",
	'$' || cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar)as "Copay",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar)as "AMt PAID",
	null as "NCPDP",
	null as "Claim Key",
	'4' as typ,
	cast ((systemnumber || sponsornumber || master_group || groupnumber) as varchar) as key ,
	'2' order_by
from
	subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif mcfw
where
	systemnumber = 160
	and sponsornumber = 2763
	and process_date between (
	select
		start_date
	from
		date_filters) and (
	select
		end_date
	from
		date_filters)
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'N'
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
group by
	groupnumber,
	group_name,
	key
union all
select
	left(cast(max(p.nabp_number) as VARCHAR),
	2)|| '-' || LPAD(SUBSTRING(cast(max(p.nabp_number) as VARCHAR),
	3,
	LENGTH(cast(max(p.nabp_number) as VARCHAR))),
	4,
	'0') as "Number",
	pharmacy_name as "Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	'' as "Rel",
	'' as "Birth Date",
	'' as "Rx Date",
	'' as "Rx Number",
	null as "D/S",
	null as "Met Qua",
	count(*) as "Claims",
	cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar) as "Ing Paid",
	cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar) as "Disp & Tax",
	cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid + client_dispensing_fee + tax) as varchar) as "Total",
	cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar)as "Copay",
	cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar) as "AMt PAID",
	null as "NCPDP",
	null as "Claim Key",
	'5' as typ,
	cast((systemnumber || sponsornumber || master_group || groupnumber || nabp_number) as varchar) as key ,
	'2' order_by
from
	subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif mcfw
inner join (
	select
		distinct claim_key,
		pharmacy_number
	from
		cloud_data_warehouse.claims
	where
		meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' ) claims1 on
	mcfw.claim_key = claims1.claim_key
left join (
	select
		nabp_number
	from
		cloud_data_warehouse.phdem
	where
		meta_curr_ind::text = 'Y'::character varying::text) p 
on
	claims1.pharmacy_number = p.nabp_number
where
	systemnumber = 160
	and sponsornumber = 2763
	and process_date between (
	select
		start_date
	from
		date_filters) and (
	select
		end_date
	from
		date_filters)
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'N'
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
group by
	mcfw.pharmacy_name,
	key
union all
select
	null as "Number" ,
	'Retail' as "Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	'' as "Rel",
	'' as "Birth Date",
	'' as "Rx Date",
	'' as "Rx Number",
	null as "D/S",
	null as "Met Qua",
	count(*) as "Claims",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar) as "Ing Paid",
	'$' || cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar) as "Disp & Tax",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid + client_dispensing_fee + tax) as varchar)as "Total",
	'$' || cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar) as "Copay",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar) as "AMt PAID",
	null as "NCPDP",
	null as "Claim Key",
	'6' as typ,
	cast((systemnumber || sponsornumber || master_group || groupnumber || nabp_number) as varchar) as key ,
	'2' order_by
from
	subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif mcfw
inner join (
	select
		distinct claim_key,
		pharmacy_number
	from
		cloud_data_warehouse.claims
	where
		meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' ) claims1 on
	mcfw.claim_key = claims1.claim_key
left join (
	select
		nabp_number
	from
		cloud_data_warehouse.phdem
	where
		meta_curr_ind::text = 'Y'::character varying::text) p 
on
	claims1.pharmacy_number = p.nabp_number
where
	systemnumber = 160
	and sponsornumber = 2763
	and process_date between (
	select
		start_date
	from
		date_filters) and (
	select
		end_date
	from
		date_filters)
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'N'
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
group by
	key
union all
select
	(case
		when gd.cardholder_number_flag = 'N' then mcfw.cardholder_number
		else cd.cardholder_number
	end)::text || '-'||cd.member_number as "Number",
	(case
		when gd.cardholder_number_flag = 'N' then Rtrim(mcfw.member_last_name)
		else Rtrim(cd.last_name)
	end)|| ', ' ||(case
		when gd.cardholder_number_flag = 'N' then Rtrim(mcfw.member_first_name)
		else Rtrim(cd.first_name)
	end) as "Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	cast((case
		when gd.cardholder_number_flag = 'N' then mcfw.member_relationship_code
		else cd.relationship_code
	end) as varchar) as "Rel",
	(case
		when gd.cardholder_number_flag = 'N' then to_char(mcfw.member_birth_date,
		'mm/dd/yyyy')
		else to_char(cd.birth_date,
		'mm/dd/yyyy')
	end) as "Birth Date",
	to_char(rx_date,
	'mm/dd/yy') as "Rx Date",
	rx_number::varchar as "Rx Number",
	max(days_supply) as "D/S",
	max(metric_quantity) as "Met Qua",
	null as "Claims",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar)as "Ing Paid",
	'$' || cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar)as "Disp & Tax",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid + client_dispensing_fee + tax) as varchar)as "Total",
	'$' || cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar)as "Copay",
	'$' || cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar)as "AMt PAID",
	LPAD(SUBSTRING(cast(max(p.nabp_number) as VARCHAR),
	1,
	LENGTH(cast(max(p.nabp_number) as VARCHAR)) - 2),
	4,
	'0') 
|| '-' || right(cast(max(p.nabp_number) as VARCHAR),
	2) as "NCPDP",
	mcfw.claim_key as "Claim Key",
	'7' as typ,
	cast((systemnumber || sponsornumber || master_group || groupnumber || nabp_number || mcfw.cardholder_number) as varchar) as key ,
	'2' order_by
from
	subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif mcfw
inner join (
	select
		distinct claim_key,
		pharmacy_number,
		cardholder_key,
		group_number
	from
		cloud_data_warehouse.claims
	where
		meta_Curr_ind = 'Y'
		and current_claim_indicator <> 'N'
		and current_claim_indicator <> 'D') claims1 on
	mcfw.claim_key = claims1.claim_key
left join (
	select
		nabp_number
	from
		cloud_data_warehouse.phdem
	where
		meta_curr_ind::text = 'Y'::character varying::text) p 
on
	claims1.pharmacy_number = p.nabp_number
inner join (
	select
		cardholder_key,
		relationship_code,
		cardholder_number,
		member_number,
		first_name,
		last_name,
		sex,
		birth_date
	from
		cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data
	where
		meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cd on
	cd.cardholder_key = claims1.cardholder_key
left join (
	select
		cardholder_number_flag,
		group_number
	from
		cloud_data_warehouse.group_data
	where
		meta_curr_ind = 'Y') gd on
	claims1.group_number::character varying::text = gd.group_number::text
where
	systemnumber = 160
	and sponsornumber = 2763
	and process_date between
	(
	select
		start_date
	from
		date_filters) and (
	select
		end_date
	from
		date_filters)
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'N'
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
group by
	"Number",
	mcfw.member_relationship_code,
	mcfw.member_birth_date,
	mcfw.rx_date,
	mcfw.rx_number,
	mcfw.claim_key,
	mcfw.sponsornumber,
	mcfw.groupnumber,
	p.nabp_number,
	mcfw.cardholder_number,
	mcfw.systemnumber,
	mcfw.master_group,
	mcfw.member_first_name,
	mcfw.member_last_name,
	gd.cardholder_number_flag,
	cd.last_name,
	cd.first_name,
	cd.relationship_code,
	cd.birth_date
order by
	key,
	typ,
	order_by)
select
	fq."Number",
	fq."Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	fq."Rel",
	fq."Birth Date",
	fq."Rx Date",
	fq."Rx Number",
	fq."D/S",
	fq."Met Qua",
	fq."Claims",
	fq."Ing Paid",
	fq."Disp & Tax",
	fq."Total",
	fq."Copay",
	fq."AMt PAID",
	fq."NCPDP",
	fq."Claim Key"
from
	final_query as fq;

with data_filters as (

  c.ING_PAID - c.DIFF_ING_PAID as IngPaid,  
  c.DISP_FEE - c.DIFF_DISP_FEE as DispFee,  
  c.COPAY,  
  c.TAX,  
  c.AMOUNT_PAID,  
  c.UCR_AMOUNT,   
   CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.MEMBER_BIRTH ELSE chd.BIRTH_DATE END ,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.SEX ELSE chd.SEX END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ELSE chd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.MEMBER_NUMBER ELSE chd.MEMBER_NUMBER END,  
  chd.ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  
  chd.RELATIONSHIP_CODE,  
  CASE WHEN (c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X) = 1 THEN   
      (SELECT TOP 1 DEA FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE   
       WHERE NPI = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X)  
    ELSE c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X   
  END as DEA_NUMBER,  
  c.DIAGNOSIS_CODE,  
  gd.SYSTEM_NUMBER,  
  gd.SPONSOR_NUMBER,  
  gd.GROUP_NUMBER,  
  gd.ALT_GROUP_NUMBER,  
  c.GENERIC_CODE,  
  c.MAC_NUMBER,  
  c.DAW_INDICATOR,  
  c.THERA_CLASS,  
  c.RX_OTC,  
  c.GPI,  
  c.EXCEPTION_01,  
  c.OVERRIDE_1,  
  c.PERIOD_ENDING,  
  '' as PAID_DATE,  
  c.COMPOUND_CODE,  
  c.BATCH_DATE,   
  c.CLAIMS_COUNTER,  
  c.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,    
  gd.GROUP_BENEFIT_CODE,  
  c.AWP_100_PERCENT,  
  c.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,  
  c.DRUG_PREF_IND,  
  c.PRICE_INDICATOR,  
  dd.MANUF_NAME_ABBR,  
  dd.DEA_CODE,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_LAST_NAME ELSE chd.LAST_NAME END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_FIRST_NAME ELSE chd.FIRST_NAME END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_MIDDLE_INITIAL ELSE chd.MIDDLE_INITIAL END,  
  c.THIRD_PARTY_CODE,  
  p.NPI_NUMBER,  
  c.OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,  
  c.DEDUCT_AMT,  
  chd.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,  
  null as FILLER_1,  
  null as FILLER_2,  
  c.AMT_COPAY,  
  c.AMT_COINSURANCE,  
  c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X AS "Physician Number",
  CASE
                WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X, '[^0-9]', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN
                    (SELECT RTRIM(LastName) || ', ' || RTRIM(FirstName) || ' ' || MiddleInitial
                     FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE
                     WHERE NPI = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X
                     LIMIT 1)
                ELSE
                    (SELECT RTRIM(LastName) || ', ' || RTRIM(FirstName) || ' ' || MiddleInitial
                     FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE
                     WHERE DEA = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X
                     LIMIT 1) end as "Physician Name",  
  c.PROCESS_DATE,
  NULL as DateofReversal,  
  CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'   
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' 
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND c.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J' THEN 'J'  
  ELSE 'U' END as PaidorReversalFlag,  
  1 as AdjClaimCount,  
  c.AMOUNT_PAID as AdjAmountPaid,  
  c.Amount_Applied_To_OOP,  
  c.SKIP_LIMIT_FLAG,  
   p.State as PharmacyState ,  
  dd.DOSAGE_FORM as DosageForm ,  
  dd.METRIC_STRENGTH as MetricStrength ,  
  dd.SIZE_U_M as SizeUM ,  
  dd.ROUTE_ADMIN as RouteofAdministration ,  
  CASE WHEN c.GENERIC_CODE in ('Y', 'B') THEN 'GENERIC' 
    ELSE 'BRAND' END as BrandGeneric ,  
  rtrim(gd.GROUP_NAME) as GroupName,
    c.PENALTY_AMOUNT as PenaltyAmount,
  c.ADMIN_FEE as AdminFeeClaims
FROM (select BATCH_NUMBER,CLAIM_NUMBER, CLAIM_KEY , CLAIM_TYPE, PAYMENT_DIR, REJECT_CODE_1, REJECT_CODE_2, RX_NUMBER,  RX_DATE,  NEW_REFILL,METRIC_QUANTITY,  DAYS_SUPPLY,  ING_BILLED,  ING_PAID,DIFF_ING_PAID,  DISP_FEE,DIFF_DISP_FEE,  COPAY,  TAX,  AMOUNT_PAID,  UCR_AMOUNT,MEMBER_BIRTH,SEX,CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,MEMBER_NUMBER,PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X,DIAGNOSIS_CODE,   
GENERIC_CODE,  MAC_NUMBER,  DAW_INDICATOR,  THERA_CLASS,  RX_OTC,  GPI,  EXCEPTION_01,  OVERRIDE_1,  PERIOD_ENDING,  COMPOUND_CODE,  BATCH_DATE,  
MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,  AWP_100_PERCENT,  DRUG_PREF_IND,  PRICE_INDICATOR, PATIENT_LAST_NAME, PENALTY_AMOUNT,ADMIN_FEE, PATIENT_FIRST_NAME,  PATIENT_MIDDLE_INITIAL,  THIRD_PARTY_CODE,    DEDUCT_AMT,   
OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,  AMT_COPAY,  AMT_COINSURANCE,CLAIMS_COUNTER, PROCESS_DATE, REVERSAL_CODE, amount_applied_to_oop,  SKIP_LIMIT_FLAG,GROUP_NUMBER,CARDHOLDER_KEY,DRUG_KEY,PHARMACY_NUMBER,CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,Date_of_Reversal, CHAIN_NUMBER
from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and sys_number= 160 and sponsor_number= 3103) c    
INNER JOIN (select reversal_key,proc_date,date_of_reversal from cloud_data_warehouse.reversal where meta_curr_ind ='Y') r  
 ON c.CLAIM_KEY = r.REVERSAL_KEY  
INNER JOIN (select CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG, SYSTEM_NUMBER, SPONSOR_NUMBER, GROUP_NUMBER,  ALT_GROUP_NUMBER, GROUP_BENEFIT_CODE, 
GROUP_NAME from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') gd    
 ON gd.GROUP_NUMBER = c.GROUP_NUMBER   
INNER JOIN (select BIRTH_DATE, SEX, CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ,MEMBER_NUMBER , ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  RELATIONSHIP_CODE, LAST_NAME ,  FIRST_NAME , MIDDLE_INITIAL ,CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
CARDHOLDER_KEY  from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') chd      
 ON chd.CARDHOLDER_KEY = c.CARDHOLDER_KEY   
INNER JOIN (select NDC_TYPE_CODE,  NDC, PROD_ABBR,MANUF_NAME_ABBR,DEA_CODE,DOSAGE_FORM, METRIC_STRENGTH, SIZE_U_M,  
ROUTE_ADMIN, DRUG_KEY from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') dd    
 ON dd.DRUG_KEY = c.DRUG_KEY   
INNER JOIN (select  gpi from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') g   
 ON g.GPI = c.GPI   
INNER JOIN (select NABP_NUMBER, PHARMACY_NAME, NPI_NUMBER, State from cloud_data_warehouse.phdem where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and system_number=0)  p 
 ON p.NABP_NUMBER = c.PHARMACY_NUMBER       
WHERE     (c.PROCESS_DATE = current_date -1)   
    AND REJECT_CODE_1 in (0)  
    AND (c.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'O' OR (c.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR  = 'Y' AND c.REVERSAL_CODE = '1'))      
ORDER BY c.Date_of_Reversal DESC , c.PROCESS_DATE desc));

Query:
with data_filters as (

),    

claims_final as
(select claims.*,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif)

and systemnumber = 134 and sponsornumber = 2736 and mastergroupnumber = 85796 and groupnumber in ( 85796028,85796029) and 
process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims

(select distinct claim_key,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key),

result_data as (
SELECT   
left(claims_final.claim_key,8) as batch_number,
cast(right(claims_final.claim_key,6) as int) as claim_number,
claims_final.CLAIM_KEY ,
claims_final.claim_type,
claims_final.PAYMENT_DIR,
claims_final.pharmacy_number,
claims_final.CHAIN_NUMBER,
claims_final.PHARMACY_NAME,
claims_final.REJECT_CODE_2,
claims_final.RX_NUMBER,
claims_final.RX_DATE,
claims_final.NDC_TYPE_CODE,
LPAD(claims_final.NDC,0,11) as NDC,
claims_final.prod_abbreviation,
claims_final.NEW_REFILL,
claims_final.METRIC_QUANTITY,
claims_final.DAYS_SUPPLY,
claims_final.ingredient_billed,
claims_final.client_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid as ING_PAID,
claims_final.client_dispensing_fee - claims_final.diff_dispensing_fee as DISP_FEE,
claims_final.patient_pay,
claims_final.TAX,
claims_final.client_amount_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_dispensing_fee as AMOUNT_PAID,
claims_final.UCR_AMOUNT,
claims_final.member_birth_date,
claims_final.member_sex,
claims_final.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
claims_final.MEMBER_NUMBER,
claims_final.ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
claims_final.member_relationship_code,
claims_final.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,
claims_final.diagnosis_code,
claims_final.systemnumber,
claims_final.sponsornumber,
claims_final.groupnumber,
claims_final.alt_group_number,
claims_final.GENERIC_CODE,
claims_final.MAC_NUMBER,
claims_final.DAW_INDICATOR,
claims_final.therapeutic_class_name,
claims_final.RX_OTC_CODE,
claims_final.GPI,
claims_final.EXCEPTION_01,
claims_final.OVERRIDE_1,
claims_final.PERIOD_ENDING,
'' as PAID_DATE,
claims_final.COMPOUND_CODE,
claims_final.batch_date,
claims_final.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,
claims_final.benefit_code,
claims_final.AWP_100_PERCENT,
claims_final.drug_pref_indicator,
claims_final.PRICE_INDICATOR,
claims_final.manuf_name_abbr,
claims_final.member_first_name,
claims_final.member_last_name,
claims_final.member_middle_initial,
claims_final.third_party_code,
claims_final.pharmacy_npi_number,
claims_final.OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,
claims_final.deduct_amount,
claims_final.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
'' FILLER_1,
'' FILLER_2,
claims_final.amount_co_insurance,
claims_final.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,
(physician_last_name || ',' || physician_first_name) as physician_name,
claims_final.PROCESS_DATE,
claims_final.amount_applied_to_oop,
claims_final.skip_limit_flag,
claims_final.penalty_amount,
claims_final.admin_fee_on_claim,
claims_final.specialty_flag,
controlled_substance_indicator as dea_code,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0  
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or

((SELECT

  c.PAYMENT_DIR,

with data_filters as (
select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
), 

final_data as (
select 
claims.claim_key as ClaimBatchNumber,
to_char(claims.PERIOD_ENDING,'yyyymmdd') as PeriodEnding,
claims.rx_number as PBMClaimReference,
claims1.claims_counter as ClaimCounter,
claims.rx_number as RxNumber,
claims.current_claim_indicator as ClaimIndicator,
to_char(claims.rx_Date,'yyyymmdd') as RxDate,
claims.cardholder_number as PolicyID,
claims.member_number as MemberSequence,
claims.card_id_sent_from_pharm as MemberID,
claims.alt_cardholder_number as AltCardNumber,
cards.last_name as PatientLastName,
cards.first_name as PatientFirstName,
cards.middle_initial as PatientMiddleInitial,
to_char(member_birth_date,'yyyymmdd') as PatientDOB,
CASE claims.Member_SEX  WHEN 'M' THEN '1'  WHEN 'F' THEN '2' WHEN 'U' THEN '0' ELSE claims.Member_SEX end as PatientGender,
claims.member_relationship_code as MemberRelationship,
claims.alt_group_number as GroupNoPlanCode,
claims.groupnumber as PDMGroupNumber,
claims.sponsornumber as SponsorNumber,
cast(left(claims.pharmacy_number,length(claims.pharmacy_number)-1) as int) as PharmacyNumber,
claims.pharmacy_npi_number as PharmacyNPI,
claims.physician_number as PhysicianNumber,
lpad(claims.ndc,11,0) as NationalDrugCode,
claims.therapeutic_class_category as NDCDrugClassification,
claims.prod_abbreviation as ProductName,
claims.prod_abbreviation as TradeName,
claims.gpi_name as IngredientName,
claims.compound_code as CompoundCode,
claims.generic_code as GenericCode,
CASE WHEN claims.GPI is not null THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as SpecialtyFlag,
claims.controlled_substance_indicator as ControlledSubstanceFlag,
lpad(claims.gpi,14,0) as GPI,
CASE Claims.NEW_REFILL  WHEN 'N' THEN '0' WHEN 'R' THEN '1' ELSE Claims.NEW_REFILL END as NewRefillIndicator,
claims.metric_quantity as MetricQuantity,
claims.days_supply as DaysSupply,
claims.mail_order_flag as MailOrderIndicator,
claims.ingredient_billed as IngredientCostBilled,
claims.client_ingredient_paid as IngredientCostPaid,
claims.client_dispensing_fee as DispensingFee,
claims.patient_pay as Copay,
claims.tax as Tax,
claims.deduct_amount as DeductibleAmount,
claims.client_amount_paid as TotalAmountPaid,
case WHEN LEFT(CLAIMS.GPI ,10) = '9999999999' THEN 0 WHEN (GROUP_DATA.BROKER = 'EPS' OR CLAIMS1.NETWORK_NUMBER  IN ('1080', '286')) THEN 5 
	when CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG = 'M' then admin1.Mail_3 else admin1.Direct_3 end as "Admin Fee" ,
CASE  WHEN claims.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG = 'D' THEN 'M'  ELSE 'P' END as Payee,
DRUG_DATA.AWP_PRICE_1 as AWPUnitPrice,
DRUG_DATA.PACKAGE_SIZE as UnitSize,
claims.group_name as GroupName,
claims.therapeutic_class_category as TherapeuticCategory,
DRUG_DATA.AWP_PACK_PRICE_1 as AWPPackPrice
from
(select *, master_group as mastergroupnumber from  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif
WHERE (CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' OR (CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'N' AND REJECT_CODE_1 = 601))

 and systemnumber = 58 and   

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
left join (select drug_key,awp_price_1,awp_pack_price_1,PACKAGE_SIZE from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_Data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') drug_data
on drug_data.drug_key = LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0)
left join (select claim_key,claims_counter,network_number from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key
left join (select distinct group_number, broker, adm_eff_date_1,adm_eff_date_2,adm_eff_date_3,adm_eff_date_4,adm_eff_date_5,adm_schedule_number_1,
				adm_schedule_number_2,adm_schedule_number_3,adm_schedule_number_4,adm_schedule_number_5 from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') group_data
on claims.groupnumber = group_Data.group_number
left join (select * from cloud_data_warehouse."admin" where meta_curr_ind = 'Y' ) admin1
ON CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER = admin1.System_Number               
   AND CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER = admin1.Sponsor_Number               
   AND (CASE WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_5, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_4, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_5        
	   		 WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_4, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_3, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_4        
			 WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_3, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_2, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_3        
			 WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_2, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_1, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_2        
			 ELSE GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_1       
			 END) = admin1.Schedule_Number
left join (select gpi,CASE WHEN GPI is NOT NULL AND gpi_add_date IS NULL THEN '1-1-1900' ELSE ss_gen_term_date END as GPIEffectiveDate,
		CASE WHEN GPI is NOT NULL AND gpi_add_date IS NULL THEN '12-31-2999' ELSE ss_gen_term_date END as GPITermDate 
		from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') gpi
on claims.gpi = gpi.gpi
left join (select cardholder_key, last_name,first_name, middle_initial from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cards
on LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) = cards.CARDHOLDER_KEY
)

select 
BATCH_NUMBER as "C111TT_CLAIM_BATCH_NUMBER",
CLAIM_NUMBER as "C111TT_CLAIM_NUMBER",
CLAIM_TYPE as "C111TT_CLAIM_TYPE",
PAYMENT_DIR as "C111TT_PAYMENT_DIRECT",
RPAD(CAST(NABP_NUMBER AS VARCHAR(6)), 6, '0') as "C111TT_PHARMACY_NUMBER",
CHAIN_NUMBER as "C111TT_CHAIN_NUMBER",
PHARMACY_NAME as "C111TT_PHARMACY_NAME",
REJECT_CODE_1 as "C111TT_REJECT_CODE_01",
REJECT_CODE_2 as "C111TT_REJECT_CODE_02",
DIAGNOSIS_CODE as "C111TT_DIAGNOSIS_CODE_ICD10",
DATE_PART(year, rx_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, rx_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, rx_date)  as "C111TT_RX_DATE",
NDC_TYPE_CODE as "C111TT_DRUG_TYPE_CODE",
RPAD(CAST("NDC" AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0')  as "C111TT_NATIONAL_DRUG_CODE",
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(prod_abbr), '"', ''), '''', ''), '|', ''), ',', '')  as "C111TT_PRODUCT_NAME",
case when new_refill = 0 then 0 when new_refill = 1 then 1 else 2 end AS "C111TT_NEW_REFILL_IND",
METRIC_QUANTITY AS "C111TT_METRIC_QUANTITY",
DAYS_SUPPLY AS "C111TT_DAYS_SUPPLY",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ing_billed ELSE ing_billed end as "C111TT_INGREDIENT_COST_BILLED", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ingpaid ELSE ingpaid end as "C111TT_INGREDIENT_COST_PAID", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * dispfee ELSE dispfee end as "C111TT_DISPENSING_FEE", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * copay ELSE copay end as "C111TT_COPAY",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * tax ELSE tax end as "C111TT_TAX", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_paid ELSE amount_paid end as "C111TT_TOTAL_AMOUNT_PAID",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ucr_amount ELSE ucr_amount end as "C111TT_UCR_AMOUNT",
DATE_PART(year, birth_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, birth_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, birth_date) as "C111TT_MEMBER_BIRTHDATE",
CASE WHEN sex='M' THEN 1 WHEN sex='F' THEN 2 WHEN sex='U' THEN 0 ELSE 3 END AS "C111TT_MEMBER_SEX",
rtrim(cardholder_number) as "C111TT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER",
rtrim(member_number) as "C111TT_MEMBER_NUMBER",
rtrim(alt_cardholder_number) as "C111TT_ALTERNATE_CARD_NUMBER", 
rtrim(relationship_code) as "C111TT_PATIENT_RELATIONSHIP",
rtrim(DEA_NUMBER) as "C111TT_PHYSICIAN_NUMBER",
diagnosis_code as "C111TT_DIAGNOSIS_CODE",
system_number as "C111TT_PDM_SYSTEM_NUMBER",
sponsor_number as "C111TT_PDM_SPONSOR_NUMBER",
group_number as "C111TT-PDM-GROUP-NUMBER", 
rtrim(alt_group_number) as "C111TT_GROUP_NUMBER",
generic_code as "C111TT_GENERIC_CODE",
mac_number as "C111TT_MAC_NUMBER",
DAW_INDICATOR as "C111TT_DAW_IND",
thera_class as "C111TT_THERAPEUTIC_CLASS_CODE",
rx_otc as "C111TT_RX_OTC_CODE",
RPAD(CAST(gpi AS VARCHAR(14)), 14, '0') as "C111TT_GPI",
EXCEPTION_01 as "C111TT_EXCEPTION_CODE",  
override_1 as "C111TT_OVERRIDE_CODE",
DATE_PART(year, period_ending) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, period_ending) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, period_ending) as "C111TT_PERIOD_ENDING_DATE",
'' as "C111TT_PAID_DATE",
compound_code as "C111TT_COMPOUND_CODE",
DATE_PART(year, batch_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, batch_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, batch_date) as  "C111TT_BATCH_DATE",
claims_counter as "C111TT_CLAIM_COUNTER",
mail_order_flag as "C111TT_MAIL_ORDER", 
group_benefit_code as "C111TT_BENEFIT_CODE",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * awp_100_percent ELSE awp_100_percent end as "C111TT_AWP",
PaidorReversalFlag as "C111TT_CLAIM_IND" ,
drug_pref_ind as "C111TT_DRUG_PREFERENCE_IND", 
price_indicator as "C111TT_PRICING_IND" , 
manuf_name_abbr as "C111TT_DRUG_MANUFACTURER" , 
dea_code as "C111TT_CONTROLLED_SUBSTANCE",
rtrim(last_name) as   "C111TT_PATIENT_LAST_NAME",
rtrim(first_name) as "C111TT_PATIENT_FIRST_NAME",
rtrim(middle_initial) as  "C111TT_PATIENT_MIDDLE_INIT",
third_party_code as "C111TT_THIRD_PARTY_CODE",
npi_number as "C111TT_PHARMACY_NPI_NUMBER",
rx_number as "C111TT_D0_RX_NUMBER",
other_coverage_code as "C111TT_OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * deduct_amt ELSE deduct_amt end as "C111TT_DEDUCTIBLE_AMOUNT",
rtrim(card_number_on_card) as "C111TT_NUMBER_ON_CARD",
DATE_PART(year, dateofreversal) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, dateofreversal) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, dateofreversal) as "C111TT_REVERSAL_DATE", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_applied_to_oop ELSE amount_applied_to_oop end as "C111TT_AMOUNT_APPLIED_TO_OOP",
CASE WHEN SkipLimitFlag between 1 and 99 THEN 'N'  ELSE 'Y' END as "C111TT_ACCUMULATOR_APPLIED_IND",
AMT_COINSURANCE as "C111TT_AMOUNT_COINSURANCE",
AMT_COPAY as "C111TT_AMOUNT_COPAY", 
PenaltyAmount as "C111TT_PENALTY_AMOUNT",
AdminFeeClaims as "C111TT_ADMIN_FEE",
filler_1 as "C111TT_FILLER_ONE",
FILLER_2 as "C111TT_FILLER_TWO"
from 
((SELECT    
  c.BATCH_NUMBER,  
  c.CLAIM_NUMBER,  
  c.CLAIM_KEY ,  
  c.CLAIM_TYPE,  
  c.PAYMENT_DIR,  
  p.NABP_NUMBER,  
  c.CHAIN_NUMBER,  
  p.PHARMACY_NAME,  
  0 as REJECT_CODE_1,  
  c.REJECT_CODE_2,  
  c.RX_NUMBER,  
  c.RX_DATE,  
  dd.NDC_TYPE_CODE,  
 RIGHT(LPAD(CAST(dd.ndc AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0'), 11) AS "NDC",  
  dd.PROD_ABBR,  
  CASE WHEN c.NEW_REFILL = 'N' THEN '0'  
    WHEN c.NEW_REFILL = 'R' THEN '1'
    ELSE '' END AS NEW_REFILL,  
  c.METRIC_QUANTITY,  
  c.DAYS_SUPPLY,  
  c.ING_BILLED,  
  c.ING_PAID - c.DIFF_ING_PAID as IngPaid,  
  c.DISP_FEE - c.DIFF_DISP_FEE as DispFee,  
  c.COPAY,  
  c.TAX,  
  c.AMOUNT_PAID,  
  c.UCR_AMOUNT,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.MEMBER_BIRTH ELSE chd.BIRTH_DATE END ,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.SEX ELSE chd.SEX END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ELSE chd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.MEMBER_NUMBER ELSE chd.MEMBER_NUMBER END,  
  chd.ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  
  chd.RELATIONSHIP_CODE,  
  CASE WHEN (c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X) = 1 THEN   
      (SELECT TOP 1 DEA FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE   
       WHERE NPI = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X)  
    ELSE c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X  
  END as DEA_NUMBER,  
  c.DIAGNOSIS_CODE,  
  gd.SYSTEM_NUMBER,  
  gd.SPONSOR_NUMBER,  
  gd.GROUP_NUMBER,  
  gd.ALT_GROUP_NUMBER,  
  c.GENERIC_CODE,  
  c.MAC_NUMBER,  
  c.DAW_INDICATOR,  
  c.THERA_CLASS,  
  c.RX_OTC,  
  c.GPI,  
  c.EXCEPTION_01,  
  c.OVERRIDE_1,  
  c.PERIOD_ENDING,  
  '' as PAID_DATE,  
  c.COMPOUND_CODE,  
  c.BATCH_DATE,  
   1 as CLAIMS_COUNTER,

), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,

		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3079 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,

		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

) claims

(select distinct claim_key,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1

claims_final.CLAIM_KEY ,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0

	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'

--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

resultsstaging as

CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ING_PAID ELSE ING_PAID END as "Ingredient Cost",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * DISP_FEE ELSE DISP_FEE END as "Dispensing Fee",

CASE 
WHEN substring(N1ClaimKEY ,5,1) <> 'N' and Reject_Code_1 = '0'  -- N1 Paid Claim
THEN COPAY - (SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)
WHEN (N1ClaimKey is NULL OR  SUBSTRING(Claim_Key, 1, 4) = substring(N1ClaimKey, 1, 4))THEN (CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * COPAY ELSE COPAY END) --Normal Claim

(SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS  WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1

	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,

null as date_of_reversal,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid

and sys_number= 218 and sponsor_number= 5082) c

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5546 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

claims,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1

with data_filters as (
select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
),   


final_data as
(select
distinct
ove.system_link,
ove.systemnumber,
ove.system_name as systemname,
ove.sponsor_name as sponsorname,
ove.sponsornumber,
ove.master_group as mastergroupnumber,
ove.master_Group_name as mastergroupname,
ove.group_name as groupname,
ove.groupnumber,
ove.user_name,
ove.gpi,
gpi.gpi_description,
ove.type_code,
ove.enter_date,
ove.cardholder_number,
last_name || ', ' || first_name as cardholder_name,
eff_date_1,
ter_date_1,
ove.reason,
(ove.gpi || gpi_description || user_name || type_code || enter_Date || ove.cardholder_number || last_name || first_name || eff_date_1 || ter_date_1 || reason) as key1

from 
(select distinct cardholder_key,last_name,first_name,eff_date_1,ter_date_1,cardholder_number,member_number,spon_number from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') card
inner join 
(
select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.vw_overrides_extract) claims
WHERE systemnumber is not null
and systemnumber = 69 and sponsornumber = 368 and   

effective_date <= (select end_Date from data_filters) and ((term_date is null) or (date(term_date) >= (select end_Date from data_filters))) -- if override report type = 'A'
--enter_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)  -- if override report type = 'E'
) ove
on ove.cardholder_number = card.cardholder_number and ove.member_number = card.member_number and ove.sponsornumber = card.spon_number 
inner join (select distinct gpi,gpi_description from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data  where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') gpi
on ove.gpi= gpi.gpi
inner join (
select distinct group_number, group_ter_date,sponsor_number from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data  
where meta_curr_ind = 'Y' and (group_ter_date is null or group_ter_date >= (select end_Date from data_filters))) grp
on ove.groupnumber = grp.group_number and ove.sponsornumber = grp.sponsor_number
)

select 
user_name as "User",
gpi as "GPI",
gpi_description as "GPI Description",
type_code as "Type Code",
enter_date as "Enter Date",
cardholder_number as "Cardholder",
cardholder_name as "Name",
eff_date_1 as "Eff Date",
ter_date_1 as "Term Date",
reason as "Reason"

from 
(
select 
null as user_name,
system_link as gpi,
null as gpi_description,
null as type_code,
null as enter_date,
null as cardholder_number,
count(distinct key1) || ' Overrides' as cardholder_name,

claims_final.skip_limit_flag,
claims_final.penalty_amount,
claims_final.admin_fee_on_claim,
claims_final.specialty_flag,
controlled_substance_indicator as dea_code,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0  
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3147 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

with data_filters as (
select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
),  


cardholder_data as 
(select 
	distinct LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) cardholderkey
	from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
	where claims.process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	and claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'N'),

resultsstaging as
(select
	distinct 
	claims.systemnumber as sys_number,
	LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as cardholderkey,
	(select start_date from data_filters) as rollbegdate,
	(select end_Date from data_filters) as rollenddate,
	sum(case when claims.current_claim_indicator = 'R' then 0 else claims.client_amount_paid end) as amtpaid,
	sum(claims.patient_pay) as copay,
	sum(case when claims.current_claim_indicator = 'R' then 0 else 1 end) as claims,
	sum(case when reversal_key is not null then 1 else 0 end) as reversedinprogressclaims,
	sum(case when reversal_key is not null then claims.client_amount_paid else 0 end) as reversedinprogressamountpaid
	from
	(select claims.*,reversal.reversal_key, master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
	left join cloud_data_warehouse.reversal reversal on claims.claim_key = reversal.reversal_key
	WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' 
	
	 and systemnumber = 171 and    
	 
	((process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)) or
	(reversal.proc_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)))
	) claims
	
	group by
	claims.systemnumber,
	LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)),
	
tmp as
(select
	distinct 
	lpad(limit_daily.sponsor_nbr,8,0)+lpad(limit_daily.cardholder_nbr,10,0)+lpad(limit_daily.member_nbr,2,0) as cardholderkey,
	limit_daily.cardholder_nbr as cardholdernbr,
	limit_daily.member_nbr as membernbr,
	limit_daily.bin,
	limit_daily.system_nbr as systemnbr,
	max(limit_daily.roll_date) as rolldate
	from cloud_data_warehouse.limit_daily  limit_daily
	inner join cardholder_data

PAYMENT_DIR as "C111TT_PAYMENT_DIRECT",
RPAD(CAST(NABP_NUMBER AS VARCHAR(6)), 6, '0') as "C111TT_PHARMACY_NUMBER",
CHAIN_NUMBER as "C111TT_CHAIN_NUMBER",
FEDERAL_TAX_ID_NUMBER as "C111TT_PHARMACY_TAX_ID1",

REJECT_CODE_2 as "C111TT_REJECT_CODE_02",
DIAGNOSIS_CODE as "C111TT_DIAGNOSIS_CODE_ICD10",
DATE_PART(year, rx_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, rx_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, rx_date)  as "C111TT_RX_DATE",
NDC_TYPE_CODE as "C111TT_DRUG_TYPE_CODE",
RPAD(CAST(ndc AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0')  as "C111TT_NATIONAL_DRUG_CODE",
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(prod_abbr), '"', ''), '''', ''), '|', ''), ',', '')  as "C111TT_PRODUCT_NAME",
case when new_refill = 0 then 0 when new_refill = 1 then 1 else 2 end AS "C111TT_NEW_REFILL_IND",
METRIC_QUANTITY AS "C111TT_METRIC_QUANTITY",
DAYS_SUPPLY AS "C111TT_DAYS_SUPPLY",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ing_billed ELSE ing_billed end as "C111TT_INGREDIENT_COST_BILLED", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ingpaid ELSE ingpaid end as "C111TT_INGREDIENT_COST_PAID", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * dispfee ELSE dispfee end as "C111TT_DISPENSING_FEE", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * copay ELSE copay end as "C111TT_COPAY",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * tax ELSE tax end as "C111TT_TAX", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_paid ELSE amount_paid end as "C111TT_TOTAL_AMOUNT_PAID",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ucr_amount ELSE ucr_amount end as "C111TT_UCR_AMOUNT",
DATE_PART(year, birth_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, birth_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, birth_date) as "C111TT_MEMBER_BIRTHDATE",
CASE WHEN sex='M' THEN 1 WHEN sex='F' THEN 2 WHEN sex='U' THEN 0 ELSE 3 END AS "C111TT_MEMBER_SEX",

rtrim(member_number) as "C111TT_MEMBER_NUMBER",
rtrim(alt_cardholder_number) as "C111TT_ALTERNATE_CARD_NUMBER", 
rtrim(relationship_code) as "C111TT_PATIENT_RELATIONSHIP",

generic_code as "C111TT_GENERIC_CODE",

rx_number as "C111TT_D0_RX_NUMBER",

 RIGHT(LPAD(CAST(dd.ndc AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0'), 11) AS "NDC",

   P.FEDERAL_TAX_ID_NUMBER

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),     

invoice_data as
(select distinct
GROUP_DATA.SPONSORNUMBER,
GROUP_DATA.systemnumber ,
GROUP_DATA.SPONSOR_NAME,
GROUP_DATA.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
GROUP_DATA.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
GROUP_DATA.GROUP_NAME,
GROUP_DATA.GROUPNUMBER,
INLOG.INL_PERIOD_ENDING,
INL_SYS_CLAIM_INV_NUM as ClaimsInvoiceNumber,
INL_SYS_ADMIN_INV_NUM as AdminInvoiceNumber,
sum(INL_CLAIM_COUNT) as ClaimCount,
sum(INL_CLAIM_INV_AMT) as ClaimInvoiceAmount,
sum(INLOG.INL_DIFF_ADMIN) as InlDifferentialAdminFee,
sum(INL_SYS_ADMIN_FEE) as AdminFee,
sum(INL_SPO_ADMIN_FEE) as SponAdminFee,
sum(INL_CHECK_CHARGE) as CheckCharge,
sum(INL_NUMBER_OF_CHECKS) as CheckCount,
sum(INL_MKT_CHARGE) as MarketingCharge,
sum(INL_RENTED_NETWORK_CLAIMS) as NetworkClaims,
sum(INL_RENTED_NETWORK_AMOUNT) as NetworkAmount,
sum(INL_ADMIN_FEE) as AdminFeeDifferentialAdd

FROM cloud_data_warehouse.inlog
INNER JOIN (select *, master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.vw_group_extract) GROUP_DATA
ON GROUP_DATA.GROUPNUMBER = INLOG.INL_GROUP_NBR
WHERE INL_SYS_CLAIM_INV_NUM is not null

 and systemnumber = 136 and    

INL_PERIOD_ENDING BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

GROUP BY
GROUP_DATA.SPONSORNUMBER,
GROUP_DATA.systemnumber,
GROUP_DATA.SPONSOR_NAME,
GROUP_DATA.MASTER_GROUP,
GROUP_DATA.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
GROUP_DATA.GROUP_NAME,
GROUP_DATA.GROUPNUMBER,
INLOG.INL_PERIOD_ENDING,
INL_SYS_CLAIM_INV_NUM,
INL_SYS_ADMIN_INV_NUM
),

claims_Data as 
(
SELECT 
SPONSORNUMBER,
SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) as PaidClaims,
SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'Y' THEN ADMIN_FEE_ON_CLAIM ELSE 0 end) as PaidAdminFee,
SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) as ReversalClaims,
SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'R' THEN ADMIN_FEE_ON_CLAIM ELSE 0 end) as ReversalAdminFee,
SUM(CASE WHEN substring(LPAD(NDC,11,0), 1, 5) = '99999' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) as DeliveryClaims,
SUM(CLIENT_AMOUNT_PAID) as AmountPaid,
SUM(ADMIN_FEE_ON_CLAIM) as TotalAdminFee,
SUM(1) as Claims,
SUM(diff_dispensing_fee) as DiffDispFee,
SUM(CASE WHEN NETWORK_NUMBER = 699 THEN diff_ingredient_paid END) as DiffIngPaid
from
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif)
WHERE CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'
	
 and systemnumber = 136 and  
 
process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
inner join 
(select distinct claim_key,network_number
from cloud_data_warehouse.claims WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key
GROUP BY SPONSORNUMBER
),

final_data as 
(
select 
invoice_data.SPONSORNUMBER,
invoice_data.systemnumber,
invoice_data.SPONSOR_NAME,
invoice_data.MASTERGROUPNUMBER,
invoice_data.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
invoice_data.GROUP_NAME,
invoice_data.GROUPNUMBER,
invoice_data.ClaimCount ,
invoice_data.ClaimInvoiceAmount - invoice_data.AdminFeeDifferentialAdd ClaimInvoiceAmount,
--invoice_data.InlDifferentialAdminFee ,
invoice_data.AdminFeeDifferentialAdd InlDifferentialAdminFee,
invoice_data.AdminFee ,
invoice_data.ClaimInvoiceAmount + invoice_data.AdminFee as total
from invoice_data
inner join claims_Data
on Claims_Data.SponsorNumber = Invoice_Data.SponsorNumber
)

select 
groupnumber as "Spon Num",
groupname as "Sponsor Name",
claims as "Total Claims",
to_char(ClaimInvoiceAmount,'FM$999,999,999,999,999.99') as "Claims invoice amount",
to_char(InlDifferentialAdminFee,'FM$999,999,999,999,999') as "Inl Differential Admin Fee",
to_char(AdminFee,'FM$999,999,999,999,999.99') as "Admin Fee",
to_char(total,'FM$999,999,999,999,999.99') as "Total"

from 
(
select
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsor_name  as groupname,
sum(claimcount) as claims,
sum(ClaimInvoiceAmount) as ClaimInvoiceAmount,
sum(InlDifferentialAdminFee) as InlDifferentialAdminFee,
sum(AdminFee) as AdminFee,	
sum(Total) as Total,
'1.sponsor' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from final_data
group by
sponsornumber,
sponsor_name,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) 

union all

select
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
MASTER_GROUP_NAME as groupname,
sum(claimcount) as claims,
sum(ClaimInvoiceAmount) as ClaimInvoiceAmount,
sum(InlDifferentialAdminFee) as InlDifferentialAdminFee,

CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,

_id: TSC_Daily City of Crown Point Claims Data
SubjectLine: Daily City of Crown Point Claims Data
Query:
with data_filters as (
select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
),    

claims_final as
(select claims.*,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif)
WHERE systemnumber is not null
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3064 and 
process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
left join 
(select distinct claim_key,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key),

result_data as (
SELECT   
left(claims_final.claim_key,8) as batch_number,
cast(right(claims_final.claim_key,6) as int) as claim_number,
claims_final.CLAIM_KEY ,
claims_final.claim_type,
claims_final.PAYMENT_DIR,
claims_final.pharmacy_number,
claims_final.CHAIN_NUMBER,
claims_final.PHARMACY_NAME,
claims_final.REJECT_CODE_2,
claims_final.RX_NUMBER,
claims_final.RX_DATE,
claims_final.NDC_TYPE_CODE,
LPAD(claims_final.NDC,0,11) as NDC,
claims_final.prod_abbreviation,
claims_final.NEW_REFILL,
claims_final.METRIC_QUANTITY,
claims_final.DAYS_SUPPLY,
claims_final.ingredient_billed,
claims_final.client_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid as ING_PAID,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)))

ELSE date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) end as start_date,

ELSE date(DATEADD('day', 14, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))) end as end_date

select claims.*,route_Admin,SIZE_U_M,METRIC_STRENGTH,vendor_id,agency_id
from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif) claims

and systemnumber = 136 and sponsornumber = 3866 and mastergroupnumber = 87197 and   

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

inner join 
(select distinct drug_key,route_Admin,SIZE_U_M,METRIC_STRENGTH from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' AND (TER_DATE IS NULL OR TER_DATE >= current_Date )) drug_data
on drug_data.drug_key = LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0)

left join 
(select distinct claim_key, ing_number from cloud_data_warehouse.claimcompound

on cc.claim_key = claims.claim_key

left join 
(select vendor_id,agency_id,pdm_group from cloud_data_warehouse.cms_hospice where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cmshps

),

	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     else claims.CLAIMS_COUNTER
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,

	else claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,

     else claims.date_of_reversal

     END as PaidorReversalFlag,

DISPENSER_TYPE_CODE,

Query:
with data_filters as (
select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
),    

claims_final as
(select claims.*,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif)
WHERE systemnumber is not null
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3156 and 
process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
left join 
(select distinct claim_key,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key),

result_data as (
SELECT   
left(claims_final.claim_key,8) as batch_number,
cast(right(claims_final.claim_key,6) as int) as claim_number,
