claims_final.skip_limit_flag,
claims_final.penalty_amount,
claims_final.admin_fee_on_claim,
claims_final.specialty_flag,
controlled_substance_indicator as dea_code,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0  
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)))

vgd.ROLLOVER_DATE_1 as RolloverDate,

vgd.max_family as PlanMaxFamily,
chd.CARDHOLDER_KEY as CardholderKey,
c.DIFF_ING_PAID as DiffIngPaid,
c.DIFF_DISP_FEE as DiffDispFee,
chd.TER_DATE_1 as CardholderTermDate1,
vgd.GROUP_TER_DATE as GroupTermDate

inner join

group_ter_date from subscriptions.vw_group_data where system_number=49 and sponsor_number=282 and master_group=93808 and group_number=93808001) vgd on c.GROUP_NUMBER = vgd.GROUP_NUMBER
left join

null as "Member Term Date",
null  as "Group Number",	
null  as "GROUP NAME",

null as "Rollover Date",
 sum(cdr.Claims) as "Claims",
 '$'||(sum(cdr.AmtPaid)::varchar) as "Amt Paid",

gd.GROUP_NAME as "GROUP NAME",

group by

order by "Max Used" desc)--,"Member ID" asc)

date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date

final_data as
( 
Select	distinct
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
CLAIMS.PHARMACY_NUMBER as NCPDPNumber,
claims.pharmacy_name as pharmacy_name,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number as cardholdernumber,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER as MemberNumber,
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_first_name) as FirstName,
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_LAST_NAME)  as LastName,
CASE
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'R'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'S'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'O'::text THEN 'OTC'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'P'::text THEN 'OTC'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS rx_otc,
claims.ndc as ndc,
claims.prod_abbreviation as prod_abbr,
1 as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
to_char(claims.process_date,'mm/dd/yyyy') as process_date,
size_u_m

left join (select distinct drug_key,size_u_m from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') drug_data
on LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) = drug_Data.drug_key

WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'S'::text THEN 'Rx'::text

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),        

GenericTableNumber AS (
    SELECT 1570 AS GenericTableNumber
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1573
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1572
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1576
),

GPI AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
    ACT_CODE,
        GTN.GenericTableNumber,
        DRUG_DATA.GPI,
        DRUG_DATA.prod_abbr AS Description,
        COALESCE(GenericTable7.STATUS_CODE, GenericTable6.STATUS_CODE, GenericTable5.STATUS_CODE, GenericTable4.STATUS_CODE, 
                 GenericTable3.STATUS_CODE, GenericTable2.STATUS_CODE, GenericTable1.STATUS_CODE) AS StatusCode
    FROM 
        subscriptions.vw_drug_extract DRUG_DATA
    left join (select drug_key,act_code from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') vdd
    	on vdd.drug_key = LPAD(DRUG_DATA.ndc_type_code || lpad(DRUG_DATA.ndc,11,0), 15,0)
    CROSS JOIN 
        GenericTableNumber GTN
    LEFT JOIN 
        cloud_data_warehouse.GENERIC_TABLE_ALL AS GenericTable1 
        ON SUBSTRING(DRUG_DATA.GPI, 1, 2) || '000000000000' = GenericTable1.GPI 
        AND GenericTable1.TABLE_NUMBER = GTN.GenericTableNumber
    LEFT JOIN 
        cloud_data_warehouse.GENERIC_TABLE_ALL AS GenericTable2 
        ON SUBSTRING(DRUG_DATA.GPI, 1, 4) || '0000000000' = GenericTable2.GPI 
        AND GenericTable2.TABLE_NUMBER = GTN.GenericTableNumber
    LEFT JOIN 
        cloud_data_warehouse.GENERIC_TABLE_ALL AS GenericTable3 
        ON SUBSTRING(DRUG_DATA.GPI, 1, 6) || '00000000' = GenericTable3.GPI 
        AND GenericTable3.TABLE_NUMBER = GTN.GenericTableNumber
    LEFT JOIN 
        cloud_data_warehouse.GENERIC_TABLE_ALL AS GenericTable4 
        ON SUBSTRING(DRUG_DATA.GPI, 1, 8) || '000000' = GenericTable4.GPI 
        AND GenericTable4.TABLE_NUMBER = GTN.GenericTableNumber
    LEFT JOIN 
        cloud_data_warehouse.GENERIC_TABLE_ALL AS GenericTable5 
        ON SUBSTRING(DRUG_DATA.GPI, 1, 10) || '0000' = GenericTable5.GPI 
        AND GenericTable5.TABLE_NUMBER = GTN.GenericTableNumber
    LEFT JOIN 
        cloud_data_warehouse.GENERIC_TABLE_ALL AS GenericTable6
        ON SUBSTRING(DRUG_DATA.GPI, 1, 12) || '00' = GenericTable6.GPI 
        AND GenericTable6.TABLE_NUMBER = GTN.GenericTableNumber
    LEFT JOIN 
        cloud_data_warehouse.GENERIC_TABLE_ALL AS GenericTable7 
        ON DRUG_DATA.GPI = GenericTable7.GPI 
        AND GenericTable7.TABLE_NUMBER = GTN.GenericTableNumber
    where COALESCE(GenericTable7.GPI,GenericTable6.GPI,GenericTable5.GPI,GenericTable4.GPI,
    				GenericTable3.GPI ,GenericTable2.GPI,GenericTable1.GPI) IS NOT NULL
        AND DRUG_DATA.PROD_ABBR <> ''
        AND DRUG_DATA.STATUS_FLAG NOT IN ('I', 'Z') 
        AND DRUG_DATA.NDC_TYPE_CODE IN (1,2,3)
        
        and
        
        coalesce(act_code,'C') not in ('D')
)

SELECT 
	DISTINCT 
    GPI,
    Description AS "Desc", 
    "1570" AS "Table 1 (Std)",
    "1573" AS "Table 2 (Cardio)",
    "1572" AS "Table 3 (Resp)",
    "1576" AS "Table 4 (Comprehensive)"
FROM 
    GPI
PIVOT (
    MAX(StatusCode) FOR GenericTableNumber IN ('1570','1573','1572','1576')
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY 
    GPI desc

drug_data.ROUTE_ADMIN as Route,

case WHEN DRUG_DATA.SIZE_U_M = 'EA' THEN 'UN' WHEN DRUG_DATA.SIZE_U_M = 'GM' THEN 'GR' WHEN DRUG_DATA.SIZE_U_M = 'MG' THEN 'ME' ELSE DRUG_DATA.SIZE_U_M END as Unit_Measure,
(claims.process_date || 'T' || left(claims1.time_hhmm,2) || ':' || right(claims1.time_hhmm,2) || ':00') as MsgTimeDtStamp,

(select distinct claim_key, time_hhmm from cloud_data_warehouse.claims WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' )claims1

		from cloud_data_warehouse.claims WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y'

	(select distinct cardholder_number,street_1,street_2,ssn,city,state,zip,spon_number

		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,

	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))

)

WITH date_filters  AS (
SELECT 
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATEADD('day', 15,DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)))
ELSE date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) end as start_date,
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
ELSE date(DATEADD('day', 14, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))) end AS end_date
),
final_query as (
select
	'' as "Number",
	'' as "Alt Group Number",
	'' as "Network Number",
	system_name as "Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	'' as "NDC",
	'' as "DoB",
	'' as "Relationship Code",
	'' as "M/F",
	'' as "Prod Abbr",
	'' as "Rx OTC",
	'' as "Rx Date",
	'' as "Rx Number",
	null as "D/S",
	null as "Met Qua",
	count(*)  "Claims",
case when sum(client_ingredient_paid)<0 then '($'|| replace(cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar),'-','')||')' 
        else '$'|| cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar) end as "Ing Paid",
case when sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee)<0 then '($'|| replace(cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar),'-','')||')' 
        else '$'|| cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar) end as "Disp & Tax",
		case when sum(patient_pay)<0 then '($'|| replace(cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar),'-','')||')' 
        else '$'|| cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar) end as "Copay",
case when sum(client_amount_paid)<0 then '($'|| replace(cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar),'-','')||')' 
        else '$'|| cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar) end as "Amt Paid",
	'1' as typ,
	cast(systemnumber as varchar) as key ,
	'1' order_by
from
	subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif mcfw
where
	systemnumber = 181
	and process_date between 
	(
	select
		start_date
	from
		date_filters) and (
	select
		end_date
	from
		date_filters)
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'N'
	and current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
group by
	systemnumber,
	system_name
union all
select
	sponsornumber::varchar "Number",
	'' as "Alt Group Number",
	''  as "Network Number",
	sponsor_name as "Sponsor/Group/Carholder",
	'' as "NDC",
	'' as "DoB",
	'' as "Relationship Code",
	'' as "M/F",
	'' as "Prod Abbr",
	'' as "Rx OTC",
	'' as "Rx Date",
	'' as "Rx Number",
	null as "D/S",
	null as "Met Qua",
	count(*) "Claims",
case when sum(client_ingredient_paid)<0 then '($'|| replace(cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar),'-','')||')' 
        else '$'|| cast(sum(client_ingredient_paid) as varchar) end as "Ing Paid",
case when sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee)<0 then '($'|| replace(cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar),'-','')||')' 
        else '$'|| cast(sum(tax + client_dispensing_fee) as varchar) end as "Disp & Tax",
		case when sum(patient_pay)<0 then '($'|| replace(cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar),'-','')||')' 
        else '$'|| cast(sum(patient_pay) as varchar) end as "Copay",
case when sum(client_amount_paid)<0 then '($'|| replace(cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar),'-','')||')' 
        else '$'|| cast(sum(client_amount_paid) as varchar) end as "Amt Paid",
		'2' as typ,
	cast (systemnumber || sponsornumber as varchar) as key ,

with data_filters as (
select 
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATEADD('day', 15,DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)))
ELSE date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) end  as start_date,
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
ELSE date(DATEADD('day', 14, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))) end as end_date
),
final_query as(
select 
distinct
vge.SYSTEM_NUMBER as "Carrier Id",  
vge.SPONSOR_NUMBER as "Account Id",  
vge.SPONSOR_NUMBER AS "Sponsor Number",  
vge.MASTER_GROUP AS "Master Group Number",  
vge.GROUP_NUMBER as "Group Number", 
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN mcf.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ELSE chd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER END AS "Cardholder Number",  
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN mcf.MEMBER_NUMBER ELSE chd.MEMBER_NUMBER END AS "Member Number",  
chd.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD as "Card Number on Card",  
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_LAST_NAME ELSE chd.LAST_NAME END AS "Last Name",  
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_FIRST_NAME ELSE chd.FIRST_NAME END AS "First Name",  
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN to_char(mcf.MEMBER_BIRTH, 'MM/DD/YYYY')  ELSE to_char(mcf.BIRTH_DATE,'MM/DD/YYYY')  END AS "Date of Birth",
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN mcf.SEX ELSE chd.SEX END AS Gender,
chd.ZIP AS "Patient Zip Code",  
case when cc.INGNumber >= 1 then drg.PROD_ABBR else mcf.PROD_ABBR end as "Product Name",  
case when cc.INGNumber >= 1 then drg.DOSAGE_FORM else mcf.DOSAGE_FORM end AS "Dosage Form",  
case when cc.INGNumber >= 1 then drg.NDC else mcf.NDC END AS NDC,  
CASE WHEN dd.ROUTE_ADMIN IN ('EP','IA','IC','ID','IJ','IL','IM','IO','IP','IS','IT','IV','IX','PL','SC')  
THEN '0294' ELSE '0250' END AS  "Revenue Code",
case when cc.INGNumber >= 1 THEN drg.ROUTE_ADMIN ELSE dd.ROUTE_ADMIN END AS "Route of Admin",  
CASE WHEN cc.INGNumber >+ 1 THEN cc.MetricQuantity ELSE mcf.METRIC_QUANTITY end as "Filled Quantity",  
null AS "HCPCS Code",  
null AS "HCPCS Quanity", 
case when cc.INGNumber >= 1 THEN    
(case  when drg.SIZE_U_M = 'EA' THEN 'UN' when drg.SIZE_U_M = 'GM' THEN 'GR' when drg.SIZE_U_M = 'MG' THEN 'ME' ELSE drg.SIZE_U_M END)   
ELSE    
(CASE  WHEN dd.SIZE_U_M = 'EA' THEN 'UN' WHEN dd.SIZE_U_M = 'GM' THEN 'GR' WHEN dd.SIZE_U_M = 'MG' THEN 'ME' ELSE dd.SIZE_U_M END)   
END AS "Unit of Measure",
'$'||(case when (cc.INGNumber = 1 or cc.INGNumber is null) then mcf.AMOUNT_PAID ELSE '0.00' end) AS Charge,  
'Y'AS Billed,   
case when mcf.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR IN ('Y','C') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS Active,  
CASE WHEN mcf.COMPOUND_CODE = 2 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Compound",  
cc.INGNumber as "ING Number",  
mcf.RX_NUMBER AS "Prescription Number", 
to_char(mcf.rx_date,'MM/DD/YYYY')as "Rx Date",
to_char(mcf.PROCESS_DATE,'MM/DD/YYYY')as "Process Date", 
mcf.NEW_REFILL  AS Refill,  
mcf.REFILL_COUNT_NUM AS "Refill Number",  
dd.METRIC_STRENGTH AS Strength,  
mcf.DAYS_SUPPLY as "Day Supply",  
null AS Frequency,  
mcf.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER AS "Physician Number",
 case when NPI.NPI is not NULL then 
 case when NPI.ENTITY_CODE = 1 THEN NPI.LAST_NAME + ' ,' + NPI.FIRST_NAME + ' ,' + NPI.MIDDLE_INITIAL ELSE NPI.BUSINESS_NAME  end 
else DEA.lastname||' ,'||DEA.firstname||' ,'||DEA.middleinitial||' '||DEA.suffix||' '||DEA.cred    
END as "Physician Name",
ph.NPI_NUMBER as "Pharmacy NPI", 
ph.PHARMACY_NAME AS "Pharmacy Name",  
mcf.CLAIM_KEY as "Claim Key",  
CAST(mcf.PROCESS_DATE || ' ' || LPAD(SUBSTRING(c.TIME_HHMM, 1, 2), 2, '0') || ':' || LPAD(SUBSTRING(c.TIME_HHMM, 3, 2), 2, '0') || ':00' 
AS TIMESTAMP) AS "Msg Time Date Stamp",
case when cc.INGNumber >= 1 then drg.RX_OTC_CODE else dd.RX_OTC_CODE END AS "Rx OTC", 
mcf.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR as "Current Claim Indicator",  
mcf.AWP_100_PERCENT as AWP100Percent 
from 
(select cardholder_number, MEMBER_NUMBER,member_birth_date as MEMBER_BIRTH,member_sex as sex,METRIC_QUANTITY,client_amount_paid as 
AMOUNT_PAID,CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR, COMPOUND_CODE, RX_NUMBER, RX_DATE, PROCESS_DATE, NEW_REFILL,refill_number as REFILL_COUNT_NUM,
DAYS_SUPPLY,CLAIM_KEY,AWP_100_PERCENT, groupnumber as GROUP_NUMBER,GPI,rx_otc_code as RX_OTC,physician_number,
cardholderbirthdate as BIRTH_DATE,prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,DOSAGE_FORM,NDC,ndc_type_code  
from subscriptions.vw_claims_financial where CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' and  rx_otc_code <> 'O' and ndc_type_code IN (1,2,3) 
AND rx_otc_code <> 'P' and (process_date between (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_date from data_filters)) and systemnumber = 181) mcf
inner join 
(select claim_key,PATIENT_LAST_NAME,PATIENT_FIRST_NAME,TIME_HHMM, CARDHOLDER_KEY,DRUG_KEY, PHARMACY_NUMBER,PHYSICIAN_KEY,ndc_type_code as NDCTypeCode
from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' and  RX_OTC <> 'O' AND RX_OTC <> 'P' 
and (process_date between (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_date from data_filters)) and sys_number=181) c on mcf.claim_key = c.claim_key
inner join 
(select systemnumber as SYSTEM_NUMBER,sponsornumber as SPONSOR_NUMBER,MASTER_GROUP,GROUPNUMBER as GROUP_NUMBER
 from subscriptions.vw_group_extract) vge on vge.GROUP_NUMBER =mcf.GROUP_NUMBER
inner join 
(select CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG,GROUP_NUMBER from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') gd on gd.GROUP_NUMBER =mcf.GROUP_NUMBER
inner join 
(select CARDHOLDER_NUMBER, MEMBER_NUMBER,LAST_NAME,FIRST_NAME,CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,ZIP,SEX,
CARDHOLDER_KEY from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') chd on chd.CARDHOLDER_KEY = c.CARDHOLDER_KEY
inner join 
(select DRUG_KEY, ROUTE_ADMIN,SIZE_U_M,METRIC_STRENGTH,RX_OTC_CODE,ter_date from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data 
where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and (TER_DATE IS NULL OR TER_DATE >= getdate())) dd on dd.drug_key=c.drug_key
inner join 
(select pharmacy_number from cloud_data_warehouse.pharmacy_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') pd on pd.pharmacy_number =c.pharmacy_number
inner join 
(select gpi from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data  where meta_curr_ind ='Y') gpi on gpi.gpi=mcf.gpi
inner join
(select NABP_NUMBER, PHARMACY_NAME,NPI_NUMBER  from cloud_data_warehouse.phdem where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and system_number =0) ph
on ph.NABP_NUMBER = c.pharmacy_number
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT p.hms_piid, p.npi, d.dea, p."last" AS lastname, p."first" AS firstname, p.middle AS middleinitial, a.address1, a.address2, a.city, a.state, a.zip, a.phone1, a.phone2, a.fax, p.practitioner_type, p.gender, p.date_born, p.date_died, p.active_flag, p.medicare_participation, p.npi_taxonomy_description,p.suffix, p.cred
   FROM hms.hms_practitioner_profile p
   LEFT JOIN hms.hms_dea d ON p.hms_piid::text = d.hms_piid::text AND d.rank = 1
   LEFT JOIN hms.hms_address a ON a.hms_piid::text = p.hms_piid::text AND a.rank = 1) DEA ON mcf.physician_number= DEA.DEA
LEFT JOIN (select npi,first_name,last_name,middle_initial,business_name,entity_code from cloud_data_warehouse.npi where meta_curr_ind ='Y') NPI 
ON mcf.physician_number = NPI.npi 
left join 
(select ing_number as INGNumber,Metric_Quantity as MetricQuantity,claim_key as ClaimKey, reject_code_1 as RejectCode1, ndc
from subscriptions.vw_claim_compound_extract) cc on cc.ClaimKey = mcf.CLAIM_KEY and cc.RejectCode1 = 0  
left outer JOIN (select PROD_ABBR,DOSAGE_FORM,NDC,DRUG_KEY, ROUTE_ADMIN,SIZE_U_M,RX_OTC_CODE  from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data
where meta_curr_ind ='Y') drg  
ON drg.DRUG_KEY = LPAD(CAST(NDCTypeCode AS VARCHAR(2)), 4, '0') || LPAD(CAST(cc.NDC AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0')
order by  mcf.CLAIM_KEY,cc.INGNumber
)

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1

	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR

null as date_of_reversal,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid

WHERE systemnumber is not null

) claims

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1

	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'

--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

-1 AS Claims_counter ,

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR

--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'

    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid

_id: BLRX_Claims Detail by Member sort by MasterGroup
SubjectLine: Claims Detail by Member sort by MasterGroup
Query:
with date_filters as (
select 
(date_trunc('quarter', getdate())-interval '3 months')::date 
as start_date,
(date_trunc('quarter', getdate())-interval '1 day')::date 
as end_date
),
PaidClaimsReportbyYearMonth as(
select (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM process_date) * 100 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM process_date)) AS "Year Month", 
SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR in ('Y', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Paid Claims"  
from
(select claim_key,process_date,CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,sys_number from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and sys_number in
(select distinct system_number  from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y'
 and system_link='BLRX' and system_number in (219)) and substring(claim_key,5,1)='V'
 and process_date between (select start_date from date_filters) and (select end_Date from date_filters) and CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR in ('Y', 'C'))
 group by "Year Month" order by "Year Month")
select * from PaidClaimsReportbyYearMonth;
ExportName: Claims Detail by Member sort by MasterGroup

'' as "Patient Zip Code",

lpad(claims.ndc,11,0) as "NDC",

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

)

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0

	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,

--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

select

CLAIM_NUMBER as "C111TT_CLAIM_NUMBER",
n1_batch_number as "C111TT_ORIGINAL_BATCH NUMBER",
n1_claim_number as "C111TT_ORIGINAL_CLAIM NUMBER",
CLAIM_TYPE as "C111TT_CLAIM_TYPE",
PAYMENT_DIR as "C111TT_PAYMENT_DIRECT",
RPAD(CAST(NABP_NUMBER AS VARCHAR(6)), 6, '0') as "C111TT_PHARMACY_NUMBER",
CHAIN_NUMBER as "C111TT_CHAIN_NUMBER",
RTRIM(PHARMACY_NAME) as "C111TT_PHARMACY_NAME",
REJECT_CODE_1 as "C111TT_REJECT_CODE_01",
REJECT_CODE_2 as "C111TT_REJECT_CODE_02",
DIAGNOSIS_CODE as "C111TT_DIAGNOSIS_CODE_ICD10",
DATE_PART(year, rx_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, rx_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, rx_date)  as "C111TT_RX_DATE",
NDC_TYPE_CODE as "C111TT_DRUG_TYPE_CODE",
RPAD(CAST(ndc AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0')  as "C111TT_NATIONAL_DRUG_CODE",
RTRIM(prod_abbr) as "C111TT_PRODUCT_NAME",
--new_refill AS "C111TT-NEW-REFILL-IND",
CASE new_refill WHEN 'N' THEN '0' WHEN 'R' THEN '1' ELSE new_refill END AS "C111TT-NEW-REFILL-IND",
METRIC_QUANTITY AS "C111TT_METRIC_QUANTITY",
DAYS_SUPPLY AS "C111TT_DAYS_SUPPLY",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ing_billed ELSE ing_billed end as "C111TT_INGREDIENT_COST_BILLED", 
CASE WHEN substring(CLAIM_KEY ,5,1) = 'N' and REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 
THEN IngPaid - (SELECT IngPaid FROM CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = n1_claim_key)
WHEN substring(CLAIM_KEY ,5,1) = 'N' and REJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 
(SELECT IngPaid FROM CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = n1_claim_key)- COPAY
WHEN substring(CLAIM_KEY ,5,1) <> 'N' THEN (CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * IngPaid ELSE IngPaid END)
END as  "C111TT-INGREDIENT-COST-PAID",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * dispfee ELSE dispfee end as "C111TT_DISPENSING_FEE", 
CASE WHEN substring(CLAIM_KEY ,5,1) = 'N' and REJECT_CODE_1 = 0
 THEN COPAY - (SELECT COPAY FROM CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = n1_claim_key)
 WHEN substring(CLAIM_KEY ,5,1) = 'N' and REJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 
(SELECT COPAY FROM CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = n1_claim_key)- COPAY 
WHEN substring(CLAIM_KEY ,5,1) <> 'N' THEN (CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * COPAY ELSE COPAY END) 
end as "C111TT-COPAY",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * tax ELSE tax end as "C111TT_TAX", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_paid ELSE amount_paid end as "C111TT_TOTAL_AMOUNT_PAID",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ucr_amount ELSE ucr_amount end as "C111TT_UCR_AMOUNT",
DATE_PART(year, birth_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, birth_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, birth_date) as "C111TT_MEMBER_BIRTHDATE",
CASE WHEN sex='M' THEN '1' WHEN sex='F' THEN '2' WHEN sex='U' THEN '0' ELSE SEX END AS "C111TT_MEMBER_SEX",
rtrim(cardholder_number) as "C111TT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER",
rtrim(member_number) as "C111TT_MEMBER_NUMBER",
rtrim(alt_cardholder_number) as "C111TT_ALTERNATE_CARD_NUMBER", 
rtrim(relationship_code) as "C111TT_PATIENT_RELATIONSHIP",
rtrim(DEA_NUMBER) as "C111TT_PHYSICIAN_NUMBER",
diagnosis_code as "C111TT_DIAGNOSIS_CODE",
system_number as "C111TT_PDM_SYSTEM_NUMBER",
sponsor_number as "C111TT_PDM_SPONSOR_NUMBER",
group_number as "C111TT-PDM-GROUP-NUMBER", 
rtrim(alt_group_number) as "C111TT_GROUP_NUMBER",
generic_code as "C111TT_GENERIC_CODE",
mac_number as "C111TT_MAC_NUMBER",
DAW_INDICATOR as "C111TT_DAW_IND",
thera_class as "C111TT_THERAPEUTIC_CLASS_CODE",
rx_otc as "C111TT_RX_OTC_CODE",
RPAD(CAST(gpi AS VARCHAR(14)), 14, '0') as "C111TT_GPI",
EXCEPTION_01 as "C111TT_EXCEPTION_CODE",  
override_1 as "C111TT_OVERRIDE_CODE",
DATE_PART(year, period_ending) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, period_ending) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, period_ending) as "C111TT_PERIOD_ENDING_DATE",
'' as "C111TT_PAID_DATE",
compound_code as "C111TT_COMPOUND_CODE",
DATE_PART(year, batch_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, batch_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, batch_date) as  "C111TT_BATCH_DATE",
claims_counter as "C111TT_CLAIM_COUNTER",
mail_order_flag as "C111TT_MAIL_ORDER", 
group_benefit_code as "C111TT_BENEFIT_CODE",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * awp_100_percent ELSE awp_100_percent end as "C111TT_AWP",
PaidorReversalFlag as "C111TT_CLAIM_IND" ,
drug_pref_ind as "C111TT_DRUG_PREFERENCE_IND", 
price_indicator as "C111TT_PRICING_IND" , 
manuf_name_abbr as "C111TT_DRUG_MANUFACTURER" , 
dea_code as "C111TT_CONTROLLED_SUBSTANCE",
rtrim(last_name) as   "C111TT_PATIENT_LAST_NAME",

rtrim(middle_initial) as  "C111TT_PATIENT_MIDDLE_INIT",
third_party_code as "C111TT_THIRD_PARTY_CODE",
npi_number as "C111TT_PHARMACY_NPI_NUMBER",
rx_number as "C111TT_D0_RX_NUMBER",
other_coverage_code as "C111TT_OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * deduct_amt ELSE deduct_amt end as "C111TT_DEDUCTIBLE_AMOUNT",
rtrim(card_number_on_card) as "C111TT_NUMBER_ON_CARD",
DATE_PART(year, dateofreversal) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, dateofreversal) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, dateofreversal) as "C111TT_REVERSAL_DATE", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_applied_to_oop ELSE amount_applied_to_oop end as "C111TT_AMOUNT_APPLIED_TO_OOP",
CASE WHEN SkipLimitFlag between 1 and 99 THEN 'N'  ELSE 'Y' END as "C111TT_ACCUMULATOR_APPLIED_IND",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * AMT_COINSURANCE ELSE AMT_COINSURANCE END as "C111TT-AMOUNT-COINSURANCE",

((SELECT

GENERIC_CODE,  MAC_NUMBER,  DAW_INDICATOR,  THERA_CLASS,  RX_OTC,  GPI,  EXCEPTION_01,  OVERRIDE_1,  PERIOD_ENDING,  COMPOUND_CODE,  BATCH_DATE,  
MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,  AWP_100_PERCENT,  DRUG_PREF_IND,  PRICE_INDICATOR, PATIENT_LAST_NAME, PENALTY_AMOUNT,ADMIN_FEE, PATIENT_FIRST_NAME,  PATIENT_MIDDLE_INITIAL,  THIRD_PARTY_CODE,    DEDUCT_AMT,   
OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,  AMT_COPAY,  AMT_COINSURANCE,CLAIMS_COUNTER, PROCESS_DATE, REVERSAL_CODE, amount_applied_to_oop,  SKIP_LIMIT_FLAG,GROUP_NUMBER,CARDHOLDER_KEY,DRUG_KEY,PHARMACY_NUMBER,CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,Date_of_Reversal, CHAIN_NUMBER
from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and (PROCESS_DATE = current_date -1) AND REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND (CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'O' OR (CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR  = 'Y' AND REVERSAL_CODE = '1'))  
and sys_number= 218 and sponsor_number= 5075) c    
INNER JOIN (select reversal_key,proc_date,date_of_reversal from cloud_data_warehouse.reversal where meta_curr_ind ='Y') r  
 ON c.CLAIM_KEY = r.REVERSAL_KEY

GROUP_NAME from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') gd    
 ON gd.GROUP_NUMBER = c.GROUP_NUMBER   
INNER JOIN (select BIRTH_DATE, SEX, CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ,MEMBER_NUMBER , ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  RELATIONSHIP_CODE, LAST_NAME ,  FIRST_NAME , MIDDLE_INITIAL ,CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
CARDHOLDER_KEY  from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') chd      
 ON chd.CARDHOLDER_KEY = c.CARDHOLDER_KEY

 ON dd.DRUG_KEY = c.DRUG_KEY

 ON g.GPI = c.GPI

 ON p.NABP_NUMBER = c.PHARMACY_NUMBER

with data_filters as (
select 
dateadd('day',-7,current_date) AS start_date,
current_date-1 as end_date
),
final_query as(
select 
trim(vgd.system_link) as "SystemLink",
trim(vgd.system_number) as "SystemNumber",
trim(vgd.system_name) as "SystemName",

voe.type_code)

with data_filters as (
select CASE

ELSE date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) end as start_date,
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
ELSE date(DATEADD('day', 14, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))) end as end_date
),     

claims_final as
(
select claims.*,route_Admin,SIZE_U_M,METRIC_STRENGTH,vendor_id,agency_id
from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif) claims
WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND claims.NDC_TYPE_CODE IN (1,2,3)
AND CLAIMS.RX_OTC_CODE <> 'O' AND CLAIMS.RX_OTC_CODE <> 'P'
and systemnumber = 136 and sponsornumber = 3866 and mastergroupnumber = 87198 and   

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
inner join 
(select distinct drug_key,route_Admin,SIZE_U_M,METRIC_STRENGTH from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' AND (TER_DATE IS NULL OR TER_DATE >= current_Date )) drug_data
on drug_data.drug_key = LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0)

left join 
(select distinct claim_key, ing_number from cloud_data_warehouse.claimcompound 
where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cc
on cc.claim_key = claims.claim_key

left join 
(select vendor_id,agency_id,pdm_group from cloud_data_warehouse.cms_hospice where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cmshps
on claims.groupnumber = cmshps.pdm_group
),

final_data as (
select 
claims_final.vendor_id as "Vendor ID",
claims_final.agency_id as "Agency ID",

claims_final.member_last_name as "Last Name",

lpad(claims_final.ndc,11,0) as "NDC",
case when claims_final.ROUTE_ADMIN IN ('EP','IA','IC','ID','IJ','IL','IM','IO','IP','IS','IT','IV','IX','PL','SC') THEN '0294' ELSE '0250' END as "Revenue Code",
claims_final.ROUTE_ADMIN as "Route Type",
case WHEN claims_final.SIZE_U_M = 'EA' THEN 'UN' 
		WHEN claims_final.SIZE_U_M = 'GM' THEN 'GR' 
		WHEN claims_final.SIZE_U_M = 'MG' THEN 'ME'	
		ELSE claims_final.SIZE_U_M END as "Unit of Measure",
'' as "HCPCS",
claims_final.METRIC_QUANTITY as "Filled Quantity",

'Y' as "Billed",

'' as "Cost",
CASE WHEN claims_final.COMPOUND_CODE = 2 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as "Compound",
claims_final.RX_NUMBER as "Prescription Number",

Query:
with data_filters as (
select 
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATEADD('day', 15,DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)))
ELSE date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) end as start_date,
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
ELSE date(DATEADD('day', 14, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))) end as end_date
),
final_query as(
select 
c.batch_number as "BATCH NUMBER",
c.claim_number as "CLAIM NUMBER",
gd.SYSTEM_NUMBER as "SYSTEM NUMBER",
gd.SPONSOR_NUMBER as "SPONSOR NUMBER",
gd.MASTER_GROUP as "MASTER GROUP",
gd.GROUP_NUMBER as "GROUP NUMBER",
gd.GROUP_NAME as "GROUP NAME",
phdem.npi_number as "PHARM NPI",
phdem.nabp_number as "NABP NUMBER",
vphdm.nabp_7 as "NABP 7",
vphdm.pharmacy_name as "PHARMACY NAME",
vphdm.street_1 as "PHARM STREET 1",
vphdm.street_2 as "PHARM STREET 2",
vphdm.city as "PHARM CITY",
vphdm.state as "PHARM STATE",
vphdm.zip as "PHARM ZIP",
vphdm.phone as "PHARM PHONE",
c.physician_number_x as "PHYSICIAN NUMBER",
case when NPI.NPI is not NULL then 
 case when NPI.ENTITY_CODE = 1 THEN NPI.LAST_NAME + ', ' + NPI.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + NPI.MIDDLE_INITIAL ELSE NPI.BUSINESS_NAME  end 
else DEA.lastname||', '||DEA.firstname||' '||DEA.middleinitial||' '||DEA.suffix||' '||DEA.cred    
END as "PHYSICIAN NAME",
c.card_id_sent_from_pharm as "CARD ID SENT FROM PHARM",
cd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER as "CARDHOLDER NUMBER",
cd.MEMBER_NUMBER as "MEMBER NUMBER",
cd.LAST_NAME as "LAST NAME",
cd.FIRST_NAME as "FIRST NAME",
cd.GENDER,
cd.BIRTH_DATE as "BIRTH DATE",
mvcf.gpi as "GPI",
RIGHT(LPAD(CAST(mvcf.ndc AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0'), 11) AS "NDC",
mvcf.prod_abbr as "PROD ABBR",
mvcf.generic_code as "GENERIC CODE",
c.drug_pref_ind as "DRUG PREF IND",
mvcf.mail_order_flag as "MAIL ORDER FLAG",
c.new_refill as "NEW REFILL",
mvcf.rx_date as "RX DATE",
mvcf.process_date as "PROCESS DATE",
mvcf.rx_number as "RX NUMBER",
mvcf.metric_quantity as "METRIC QUANTITY",
mvcf.days_supply as "DAYS SUPPLY",
mvcf.amount_paid as "AMOUNT PAID",
mvcf.copay as "COPAY",
mvcf.ing_paid as "ING PAID",
mvcf.disp_fee as "DISP FEE",
c.admin_fee as "ADMIN FEE",
mvcf.tax as "TAX"
from (select member_birth_date as member_birth,current_claim_indicator,period_ending,compound_code,daw_indicator,
awp_100_percent,ucr_amount,client_amount_paid as amount_paid,patient_pay as copay,tax,client_dispensing_fee as disp_fee,
ingredient_billed as ing_billed,client_ingredient_paid as ing_paid,days_supply,metric_quantity,mail_order_flag,generic_code,
gpi,rx_number,rx_date,process_date,claim_key,prod_short_name AS prod,prod_abbreviation as prod_abbr,ndc,dosage_form from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial where systemnumber=222 and PROCESS_DATE BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) AND (select end_date from data_filters) AND (CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N')) mvcf
inner join(select cardholder_key,physician_key,drug_key,pharmacy_number
,plan_key,member_birth,patient_first_name,patient_last_name,reversal_code,claims_counter,
coverage_type,form_gt,generic_table,claim_number,batch_number,awp_processed,
admin_fee,new_refill,refill_count_num,claim_key,group_number,physician_number_x,card_id_sent_from_pharm,drug_pref_ind from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind='Y' and sys_number=222 and PROCESS_DATE BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) AND (select end_date from data_filters) AND (CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N')) c on mvcf.claim_key=c.claim_key
inner join
(SELECT 
CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
MEMBER_NUMBER,
RELATIONSHIP_CODE,
LAST_NAME,
FIRST_NAME,
MIDDLE_INITIAL,
SEX as GENDER,
BIRTH_DATE,
CARDHOLDER_KEY from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind='Y') cd on c.cardholder_key=cd.CARDHOLDER_KEY
inner join 
(select SYSTEM_LINK,
SYSTEM_NUMBER,
SYSTEM_NAME,
SPONSOR_NUMBER,
SPONSOR_NAME,
MASTER_GROUP,
GROUP_NUMBER,
GROUP_NAME,
ALT_GROUP_NUMBER,
BRAND_FIXED,
BRAND_PCT,
NP_FIXED,
NP_PCT from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind='Y') gd on c.group_number=gd.GROUP_NUMBER
inner join 
(select package_size,drug_key from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind='Y') dd on c.drug_key=dd.drug_key
inner join 
(select pharmacy_name,seventh_digit,nabp_7,street_1,street_2,city,state,zip,nabp_number,phone from cloud_data_warehouse.phdem where meta_curr_ind='Y' and system_number=0) vphdm on vphdm.nabp_number=c.pharmacy_number
inner join 
(select plan_key,plan_number,plan_description from cloud_data_warehouse.plan_data where meta_curr_ind='Y') pd on pd.plan_key=c.plan_key
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT p.hms_spec1 as PHYSICIAN_SPECIALTY,p.hms_piid, p.npi, d.dea, p."last" AS lastname, p."first" AS firstname, p.middle AS middleinitial, a.address1, a.address2, a.city, a.state, a.zip, a.phone1, a.phone2, a.fax, p.practitioner_type, p.gender, p.date_born, p.date_died, p.active_flag, p.medicare_participation, p.npi_taxonomy_description,p.suffix, p.cred
   FROM hms.hms_practitioner_profile p
   LEFT JOIN hms.hms_dea d ON p.hms_piid::text = d.hms_piid::text AND d.rank = 1
   LEFT JOIN hms.hms_address a ON a.hms_piid::text = p.hms_piid::text AND a.rank = 1) DEA ON c.physician_number_x::character(50) = DEA.DEA
LEFT JOIN (select npi,first_name,last_name,middle_initial,business_name,entity_code from cloud_data_warehouse.npi where meta_curr_ind ='Y') NPI ON c.physician_number_x::character(50) = NPI.npi
inner join 
(select nabp_number,npi_number from cloud_data_warehouse.phdem where meta_curr_ind='Y' and system_number=0) phdem on phdem.nabp_number=c.pharmacy_number)
select * from final_query;

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5658 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,

sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,

CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,

CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,

SubjectLine: Daily Automated Routing Claims Data NL
Query:
with data_filters as (
select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
),    

claims_final as
(select claims.*,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif)
WHERE systemnumber is not null
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3079 and 
process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
left join 
(select distinct claim_key,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key),

result_data as (
SELECT   
left(claims_final.claim_key,8) as batch_number,
cast(right(claims_final.claim_key,6) as int) as claim_number,
claims_final.CLAIM_KEY ,
claims_final.claim_type,
claims_final.PAYMENT_DIR,
claims_final.pharmacy_number,
claims_final.CHAIN_NUMBER,
claims_final.PHARMACY_NAME,
claims_final.REJECT_CODE_2,
claims_final.RX_NUMBER,
claims_final.RX_DATE,
claims_final.NDC_TYPE_CODE,
LPAD(claims_final.NDC,0,11) as NDC,
claims_final.prod_abbreviation,
claims_final.NEW_REFILL,
claims_final.METRIC_QUANTITY,
claims_final.DAYS_SUPPLY,
claims_final.ingredient_billed,
claims_final.client_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid as ING_PAID,
claims_final.client_dispensing_fee - claims_final.diff_dispensing_fee as DISP_FEE,
claims_final.patient_pay,
claims_final.TAX,
claims_final.client_amount_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_dispensing_fee as AMOUNT_PAID,
claims_final.UCR_AMOUNT,
claims_final.member_birth_date,
claims_final.member_sex,
claims_final.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
claims_final.MEMBER_NUMBER,
claims_final.ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
claims_final.member_relationship_code,
claims_final.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,
claims_final.diagnosis_code,
claims_final.systemnumber,
claims_final.sponsornumber,
claims_final.groupnumber,
claims_final.alt_group_number,
claims_final.GENERIC_CODE,
claims_final.MAC_NUMBER,
claims_final.DAW_INDICATOR,
claims_final.therapeutic_class_name,
claims_final.RX_OTC_CODE,
claims_final.GPI,
claims_final.EXCEPTION_01,
claims_final.OVERRIDE_1,
claims_final.PERIOD_ENDING,
'' as PAID_DATE,
claims_final.COMPOUND_CODE,
claims_final.batch_date,
claims_final.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,
claims_final.benefit_code,
claims_final.AWP_100_PERCENT,
claims_final.drug_pref_indicator,
claims_final.PRICE_INDICATOR,
claims_final.manuf_name_abbr,
claims_final.member_first_name,
claims_final.member_last_name,
claims_final.member_middle_initial,
claims_final.third_party_code,
claims_final.pharmacy_npi_number,
claims_final.OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,
claims_final.deduct_amount,
claims_final.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
'' FILLER_1,
'' FILLER_2,
claims_final.amount_co_insurance,
claims_final.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,
(physician_last_name || ',' || physician_first_name) as physician_name,
claims_final.PROCESS_DATE,
claims_final.amount_applied_to_oop,
claims_final.skip_limit_flag,
claims_final.penalty_amount,
claims_final.admin_fee_on_claim,
claims_final.specialty_flag,
controlled_substance_indicator as dea_code,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0  
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00

GROUP_DATA.SPONSORNUMBER,

GROUP_DATA.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,

GROUP_DATA.GROUP_NAME,
GROUP_DATA.GROUPNUMBER,
INLOG.INL_PERIOD_ENDING,

select 
period_ending as "Period Ending",
groupnumber as "Sponsor Number",
groupname as "Group Name",
claims as "Claims",
fee as "Synergy Fee at $.20 per Claim"

from 
(
select
	cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	sponsor_name  as groupname,
	null as period_ending,
	sum(claimcount) as claims,
	sum(claimcount)*0.2 as fee,	
	'1.sponsor' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from final_data
group by
	sponsornumber,
	sponsor_name,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) 

union all

select
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
MASTER_GROUP_NAME as groupname,
null as period_ending,
sum(claimcount) as claims,
sum(claimcount)*0.2 as fee,	
'2.mastergroup' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
final_data
group by
	mastergroupnumber,
	MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  

select
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
group_name,
INL_PERIOD_ENDING as period_ending,
sum(claimcount) as claims,
sum(claimcount)*0.2 as fee,	
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from 
final_data
group by 
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar),
group_name,
INL_PERIOD_ENDING,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select
	Null as groupnumber,
	'Total'  as groupname,
	null as period_ending,
	sum(claimcount) as claims,
	sum(claimcount)*0.2 as fee,
	'4.Total' as type,
	'Total' as key
from
final_data
)
order by key,type asc

sum(metric_quantity) as "MetricQuantity",

cardholder_number as "CardholderNumber",
member_number as "MemberNumber",

member_last_name as "LastName",
member_relationship_code as "RelationshipCode",
member_birth_Date as "BirthDate",
ndc as "NDC",
prod_abbreviation as "PROD_ABBR",

			when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_2 = 11 then 11
			when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_3 = 11 then 11
			when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_4 = 11 then 11
			when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_5 = 11 then 11

			end as "OverrideTypeCode"

(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif) claims

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

groupnumber,
group_name,
system_link,
SystemNumber,
system_name,
SponsorNumber,
sponsor_name,
master_group,
master_group_name,
mail_order_flag,
case claims.mail_order_flag when 'M' then 'Mail' when 'D' then 'DMR' else 'Retail' end,
claim_key,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
left(CLAIMS.claim_key,8),
cast(right(CLAIMS.claim_key,6) as int),
PHARMACY_NUMBER,
rx_Date,
rx_number,
cardholder_number,
member_number,
member_first_name,
member_last_name,
member_relationship_code,
member_birth_Date,
ndc,
prod_abbreviation,
gpi,
awp_100_percent,
compound_code,
case when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_1 = 11 then 11
	 when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_2 = 11 then 11
	 when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_3 = 11 then 11
	 when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_4 = 11 then 11
	 when CLAIMS.OVERRIDE_5 = 11 then 11
	 else 0 end
having 
DaysSupply > 150 and AmtPaid > 500
)

select

CLAIM_TYPE as "C111TT-CLAIM-TYPE",
PAYMENT_DIR as "C111TT-PAYMENT-DIRECT",

CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ing_billed ELSE ing_billed end as "C111TT-INGREDIENT-COST-BILLED", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ingpaid ELSE ingpaid end as "C111TT-INGREDIENT-COST-PAID",

CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_paid ELSE amount_paid end as "C111TT-TOTAL-AMOUNT-PAID",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ucr_amount ELSE ucr_amount end as "C111TT-UCR-AMOUNT",
DATE_PART(year, birth_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, birth_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, birth_date) as "C111TT-MEMBER-BIRTHDATE",
CASE WHEN sex='M' THEN 1 WHEN sex='F' THEN 2 WHEN sex='U' THEN 0 ELSE 3 END AS "C111TT-MEMBER-SEX",
rtrim(cardholder_number) as "C111TT-CARDHOLDER-NUMBER",
rtrim(member_number) as "C111TT-MEMBER-NUMBER",
rtrim(alt_cardholder_number) as "C111TT-ALTERNATE-CARD-NUMBER", 
rtrim(relationship_code) as "C111TT-PATIENT-RELATIONSHIP",
rtrim(DEA_NUMBER) as "C111TT-PHYSICIAN-NUMBER",
diagnosis_code as "C111TT-DIAGNOSIS-CODE",
system_number as "C111TT-PDM-SYSTEM-NUMBER",
sponsor_number as "C111TT-PDM-SPONSOR_NUMBER",
group_number as "C111TT-PDM-GROUP-NUMBER", 
rtrim(alt_group_number) as "C111TT-GROUP-NUMBER",
generic_code as "C111TT-GENERIC-CODE",
mac_number as "C111TT-MAC-NUMBER",
DAW_INDICATOR as "C111TT-DAW-IND",
thera_class as "C111TT-THERAPEUTIC-CLASS-CODE",
rx_otc as "C111TT-RX_OTC-CODE",
RPAD(CAST(gpi AS VARCHAR(14)), 14, '0') as "C111TT-GPI",
EXCEPTION_01 as "C111TT-EXCEPTION-CODE",  
override_1 as "C111TT-OVERRIDE-CODE",
DATE_PART(year, period_ending) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, period_ending) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, period_ending) as "C111TT-PERIOD-ENDING-DATE",
'' as "C111TT-PAID-DATE",
compound_code as "C111TT-COMPOUND-CODE",
DATE_PART(year, batch_date) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, batch_date) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, batch_date) as  "C111TT-BATCH-DATE",
claims_counter as "C111TT-CLAIM-COUNTER",
mail_order_flag as "C111TT-MAIL-ORDER", 
group_benefit_code as "C111TT-BENEFIT-CODE",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * awp_100_percent ELSE awp_100_percent end as "C111TT-AWP",
PaidorReversalFlag as "C111TT-CLAIM-IND" ,
drug_pref_ind as "C111TT-DRUG_PREFERENCE-IND", 
price_indicator as "C111TT-PRICING-IND" , 
manuf_name_abbr as "C111TT-DRUG-MANUFACTURER" , 
dea_code as "C111TT-CONTROLLED-SUBSTANCE",
rtrim(last_name) as   "C111TT-PATIENT-LAST-NAME",
rtrim(first_name) as "C111TT-PATIENT-FIRST-NAME",
rtrim(middle_initial) as  "C111TT-PATIENT-MIDDLE-INIT",
third_party_code as "C111TT-THIRD-PARTY-CODE",
npi_number as "C111TT-PHARMACY-NPI-NUMBER",
rx_number as "C111TT-D0_RX-NUMBER",
other_coverage_code as "C111TT-OTHER-COVERAGE-CODE",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * deduct_amt ELSE deduct_amt end as "C111TT-DEDUCTIBLE-AMOUNT",
rtrim(card_number_on_card) as "C111TT-NUMBER-ON-CARD",
DATE_PART(year, dateofreversal) * 10000+ DATE_PART(month, dateofreversal) * 100+ DATE_PART(day, dateofreversal) as "C111TT-REVERSAL-DATE", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_applied_to_oop ELSE amount_applied_to_oop end as "C111TT-AMOUNT_APPLIED-TO-OOP",
CASE WHEN SkipLimitFlag between 1 and 99 THEN 'N'  ELSE 'Y' END as "C111TT-ACCUMULATOR-APPLIED-IND",
AMT_COINSURANCE as "C111TT-AMOUNT-COINSURANCE",
AMT_COPAY as "C111TT-AMOUNT-COPAY", 
PenaltyAmount as "C111TT-PENALTY-AMOUNT",
AdminFeeClaims as "C111TT-ADMIN-FEE",
filler_1 as "C111TT-FILLER-ONE",
FILLER_2 as "C111TT-FILLER-TWO"
from 
((SELECT    
  c.BATCH_NUMBER,  
  c.CLAIM_NUMBER,  
  c.CLAIM_KEY ,  
  c.CLAIM_TYPE,  
  c.PAYMENT_DIR,  
  p.NABP_NUMBER,  
  c.CHAIN_NUMBER,  
  p.PHARMACY_NAME,  
  0 as REJECT_CODE_1,  
  c.REJECT_CODE_2,  
  c.RX_NUMBER,  
  c.RX_DATE,  
  dd.NDC_TYPE_CODE,  
 RIGHT(LPAD(CAST(dd.ndc AS VARCHAR(11)), 11, '0'), 11) AS "NDC",  
  dd.PROD_ABBR,  
  CASE WHEN c.NEW_REFILL = 'N' THEN '0'  
    WHEN c.NEW_REFILL = 'R' THEN '1'
    ELSE '' END AS NEW_REFILL,  
  c.METRIC_QUANTITY,  
  c.DAYS_SUPPLY,  
  c.ING_BILLED,  
  c.ING_PAID - c.DIFF_ING_PAID as IngPaid,  
  c.DISP_FEE - c.DIFF_DISP_FEE as DispFee,  
  c.COPAY,  
  c.TAX,  
  c.AMOUNT_PAID,  
  c.UCR_AMOUNT,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.MEMBER_BIRTH ELSE chd.BIRTH_DATE END ,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.SEX ELSE chd.SEX END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ELSE chd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.MEMBER_NUMBER ELSE chd.MEMBER_NUMBER END,  
  chd.ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  
  chd.RELATIONSHIP_CODE,  
  CASE WHEN (c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X) = 1 THEN   
      (SELECT TOP 1 DEA FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE   
       WHERE NPI = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X)  
    ELSE c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X  
  END as DEA_NUMBER,  
  c.DIAGNOSIS_CODE,  
  gd.SYSTEM_NUMBER,  
  gd.SPONSOR_NUMBER,  
  gd.GROUP_NUMBER,  
  gd.ALT_GROUP_NUMBER,  
  c.GENERIC_CODE,  
  c.MAC_NUMBER,  
  c.DAW_INDICATOR,  
  c.THERA_CLASS,  
  c.RX_OTC,  
  c.GPI,  
  c.EXCEPTION_01,  
  c.OVERRIDE_1,  
  c.PERIOD_ENDING,  
  '' as PAID_DATE,  
  c.COMPOUND_CODE,  
  c.BATCH_DATE,  
   1 as CLAIMS_COUNTER,  
  c.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,  
  gd.GROUP_BENEFIT_CODE,  
  c.AWP_100_PERCENT,  
  'Y' as CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,  
  c.DRUG_PREF_IND,  
  c.PRICE_INDICATOR,  
  dd.MANUF_NAME_ABBR,  
  dd.DEA_CODE,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_LAST_NAME ELSE chd.LAST_NAME END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_FIRST_NAME ELSE chd.FIRST_NAME END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_MIDDLE_INITIAL ELSE chd.MIDDLE_INITIAL END,  
  c.THIRD_PARTY_CODE,  
  p.NPI_NUMBER,  
  c.OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,  
  c.DEDUCT_AMT,  
  chd.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,  
  ''  as filler_1, 
  '' as FILLER_2,  
  c.AMT_COPAY,  
  c.AMT_COINSURANCE,  
  c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X AS "Physician Number",  
  CASE
                WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X, '[^0-9]', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN
                    (SELECT RTRIM(LastName) || ', ' || RTRIM(FirstName) || ' ' || MiddleInitial
                     FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE
                     WHERE NPI = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X
                     LIMIT 1)
                ELSE
                    (SELECT RTRIM(LastName) || ', ' || RTRIM(FirstName) || ' ' || MiddleInitial
                     FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE
                     WHERE DEA = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X
                     LIMIT 1) end as "Physician Name",
  c.PROCESS_DATE,  
  NULL as DateofReversal,  
  'P' as PaidorReversalFlag,  
  0 as AdjClaimCount,  
  0.00 as AdjAmountPaid,  
  c.amount_applied_to_oop,  
  c.SKIP_LIMIT_FLAG as SkipLimitFlag,  
  p.State as PharmacyState ,  
  dd.DOSAGE_FORM as DosageForm ,  
  dd.METRIC_STRENGTH as MetricStrength ,  
  dd.SIZE_U_M as SizeUM ,  
  dd.ROUTE_ADMIN as RouteofAdministration ,  
  CASE WHEN c.GENERIC_CODE in ('Y', 'B') THEN 'GENERIC'  
    ELSE 'BRAND' END as BrandGeneric ,  
  rtrim(gd.GROUP_NAME) as GroupName,
    c.PENALTY_AMOUNT as PenaltyAmount,
  c.ADMIN_FEE as AdminFeeClaims
FROM (select BATCH_NUMBER,CLAIM_NUMBER, CLAIM_KEY , CLAIM_TYPE, PAYMENT_DIR,REJECT_CODE_1, REJECT_CODE_2, RX_NUMBER,  RX_DATE,  NEW_REFILL,METRIC_QUANTITY,  DAYS_SUPPLY,  ING_BILLED,  ING_PAID,DIFF_ING_PAID,  DISP_FEE,DIFF_DISP_FEE,  COPAY,  TAX,  AMOUNT_PAID,  UCR_AMOUNT,MEMBER_BIRTH,SEX,CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,MEMBER_NUMBER,PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X,DIAGNOSIS_CODE,   
GENERIC_CODE,  MAC_NUMBER,  DAW_INDICATOR,  THERA_CLASS,  RX_OTC,  GPI,  EXCEPTION_01,  OVERRIDE_1,  PERIOD_ENDING,  COMPOUND_CODE,  BATCH_DATE,  
MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,  AWP_100_PERCENT,  DRUG_PREF_IND,  PRICE_INDICATOR, PATIENT_LAST_NAME,PENALTY_AMOUNT,ADMIN_FEE, PATIENT_FIRST_NAME,  PATIENT_MIDDLE_INITIAL,  THIRD_PARTY_CODE,    DEDUCT_AMT,   
OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,  AMT_COPAY,  AMT_COINSURANCE, PROCESS_DATE,  amount_applied_to_oop,  SKIP_LIMIT_FLAG,GROUP_NUMBER,CARDHOLDER_KEY,DRUG_KEY,PHARMACY_NUMBER,CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,Date_of_Reversal, CHAIN_NUMBER
from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and (PROCESS_DATE= current_date -1) and REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' and sys_number= 218 and sponsor_number in (2999)) c
INNER JOIN (select CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG, SYSTEM_NUMBER, SPONSOR_NUMBER, GROUP_NUMBER,  ALT_GROUP_NUMBER, GROUP_BENEFIT_CODE, 
GROUP_NAME from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') gd
ON gd.GROUP_NUMBER = c.GROUP_NUMBER   
INNER JOIN (select BIRTH_DATE, SEX, CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ,MEMBER_NUMBER , ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  RELATIONSHIP_CODE, LAST_NAME ,  FIRST_NAME , MIDDLE_INITIAL ,CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
CARDHOLDER_KEY  from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') chd   
 ON chd.CARDHOLDER_KEY = c.CARDHOLDER_KEY   
INNER JOIN (select NDC_TYPE_CODE,  NDC, PROD_ABBR,MANUF_NAME_ABBR,DEA_CODE,DOSAGE_FORM, METRIC_STRENGTH, SIZE_U_M,  
ROUTE_ADMIN, DRUG_KEY from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') dd  
 ON dd.DRUG_KEY = c.DRUG_KEY   
INNER JOIN (select  gpi from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') g
 ON g.GPI = c.GPI   
INNER JOIN (select NABP_NUMBER, PHARMACY_NAME, NPI_NUMBER, State from cloud_data_warehouse.phdem where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and system_number=0) p
 ON p.NABP_NUMBER = c.PHARMACY_NUMBER       
ORDER BY c.Date_of_Reversal DESC , c.PROCESS_DATE desc)
union all 
(SELECT    
  c.BATCH_NUMBER,  
  c.CLAIM_NUMBER,  
  c.CLAIM_KEY ,  
  c.CLAIM_TYPE,  
  c.PAYMENT_DIR,  
  p.NABP_NUMBER,

cardholder_data as 
(select 
	distinct LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) cardholderkey
	from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
	where claims.process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	and claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'N'),

resultsstaging as
(select
	distinct 
	claims.systemnumber as sys_number,
	LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as cardholderkey,
	(select start_date from data_filters) as rollbegdate,
	(select end_Date from data_filters) as rollenddate,
	sum(case when claims.current_claim_indicator = 'R' then 0 else claims.client_amount_paid end) as amtpaid,
	sum(claims.patient_pay) as copay,
	sum(case when claims.current_claim_indicator = 'R' then 0 else 1 end) as claims,
	sum(case when reversal_key is not null then 1 else 0 end) as reversedinprogressclaims,
	sum(case when reversal_key is not null then claims.client_amount_paid else 0 end) as reversedinprogressamountpaid
	from
	(select claims.*,reversal.reversal_key, master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
	left join cloud_data_warehouse.reversal reversal on claims.claim_key = reversal.reversal_key
	WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' 
	
	 and systemnumber = 197 and    
	 
	((process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)) or
	(reversal.proc_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)))
	) claims
	
	group by
	claims.systemnumber,
	LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)),
	
tmp as
(select
	distinct 
	lpad(limit_daily.sponsor_nbr,8,0)+lpad(limit_daily.cardholder_nbr,10,0)+lpad(limit_daily.member_nbr,2,0) as cardholderkey,
	limit_daily.cardholder_nbr as cardholdernbr,
	limit_daily.member_nbr as membernbr,
	limit_daily.bin,
	limit_daily.system_nbr as systemnbr,
	max(limit_daily.roll_date) as rolldate
	from cloud_data_warehouse.limit_daily  limit_daily
	inner join cardholder_data
	on (lpad(limit_daily.sponsor_nbr,8,0)+lpad(limit_daily.cardholder_nbr,10,0)+lpad(limit_daily.member_nbr,2,0)) = cardholder_data.cardholderkey 
	group by
	(lpad(limit_daily.sponsor_nbr,8,0)+lpad(limit_daily.cardholder_nbr,10,0)+lpad(limit_daily.member_nbr,2,0)),
	limit_daily.cardholder_nbr,
	limit_daily.member_nbr,
	limit_daily.bin,
	limit_daily.system_nbr),

cardholderdata as
(
select
distinct 
cardholder_data.cardholder_key as cardholderkey,
group_data.group_number as groupnumber,
cardholder_data.roll_date_1 as rolldate1,
cardholder_data.roll_date_2 as rolldate2,
cardholder_data.roll_date_3 as rolldate3,
case when cardholder_data.roll_date_2 >= (select start_date from data_filters) then cardholder_data.roll_date_3
	 when cardholder_data.roll_date_2 is null then cardholder_data.roll_date_1
	 else cardholder_data.roll_date_2 end as currentrollperiodstartdate,
(select end_Date from data_filters) as currentrollperiodenddate,
limittabledaily.system_nbr,
limittabledaily.sponsor_nbr,
limittabledaily.group_nbr,
limittabledaily.cardholder_nbr,
limittabledaily.member_nbr,
limittabledaily.bin,
limittabledaily.claims,
limittabledaily.t_disp + limittabledaily.t_tax + limittabledaily.t_ing_paid - limittabledaily.t_copay as total,
limittabledaily.t_ing_bil,
limittabledaily.t_copay,
limittabledaily.t_disp,
limittabledaily.t_tax,
limittabledaily.t_ing_paid,
limittabledaily.troop_amt,
limittabledaily.add_to_troop,
limittabledaily.medical_deduct,
limittabledaily.add_to_max
from cloud_data_warehouse.limit_daily limittabledaily
join tmp 
on tmp.cardholdernbr = limittabledaily.cardholder_nbr and tmp.membernbr = limittabledaily.member_nbr and tmp.bin = limittabledaily.bin and tmp.rolldate = limittabledaily.roll_date
join subscriptions.vw_cardholder_data cardholder_data 
on cardholder_data.cardholder_key = (lpad(limittabledaily.sponsor_nbr,8,0)+lpad(limittabledaily.cardholder_nbr,10,0)+lpad(limittabledaily.member_nbr,2,0))
join subscriptions.vw_group_data group_data on
group_data.sponsor_number = cardholder_data.spon_number
and group_data.group_number = cardholder_data.grp_1),
	
finalaggregatedresults as
(
select
resultsstaging.sys_number,
resultsstaging.cardholderkey,
resultsstaging.rollbegdate,
resultsstaging.rollenddate,
(select max(plan_data.plan_max_single) as max_plan 
from cloud_data_warehouse.claims claims
join cloud_data_warehouse.plan_data plan_data on plan_data.plan_key = claims.plan_key
where claims.rx_date >= resultsstaging.rollbegdate and claims.rx_date <= resultsstaging.rollenddate and claims.cardholder_key = resultsstaging.cardholderkey
and claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'N' limit 1) as planmaxsingle,
resultsstaging.copay,
resultsstaging.claims,
resultsstaging.reversedinprogressclaims,
resultsstaging.claims - resultsstaging.reversedinprogressclaims as trueclaimcount,
cardholderdata.claims as limitclaims,
resultsstaging.amtpaid as amountpaid,
resultsstaging.amtpaid - resultsstaging.reversedinprogressamountpaid as trueamountpaid,
resultsstaging.reversedinprogressamountpaid,
cardholderdata.total as limittableamountpaid,
cardholderdata.add_to_max as addtomax
from resultsstaging
join cardholderdata 
on cardholderdata.cardholderkey = resultsstaging.cardholderkey and cardholderdata.system_nbr = resultsstaging.sys_number)


select

from finalaggregatedresults
join subscriptions.vw_cardholder_data cardholder_data on
cardholder_data.cardholder_key = finalaggregatedresults.cardholderkey
