_id: CARX_Bimonthly La Vida Hospice CMS PDM Master File
SubjectLine: Bimonthly La Vida Hospice CMS PDM Master File
Query:
with data_filters as (
select CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATEADD('day', 15,DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)))
ELSE date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) end as start_date,
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
ELSE date(DATEADD('day', 14, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))) end as end_date
),  

final_Data as (
select distinct 
claims.systemnumber as "Carrier Id",
claims.sponsornumber as "Account Id",
claims.sponsornumber as "Sponsor Number",
claims.master_group as "Master Group Number",
claims.groupnumber as "Group Number",
claims.cardholder_number as "Cardholder Number",
claims.member_number as "Member Number",
claims.card_number_on_card as "Card Number on Card",
claims.member_last_name as "Last Name",
claims.member_first_name as "First Name",
claims.member_birth_date as "Date of Birth",
claims.member_sex as "Gender",
'' as "Patient Zip Code",
claims.prod_abbreviation as "Product Name",
claims.dosage_form as "Dosage Form",
lpad(claims.ndc,11,0) as "NDC",
case when DRUG_DATA.ROUTE_ADMIN IN ('EP','IA','IC','ID','IJ','IL','IM','IO','IP','IS','IT','IV','IX','PL','SC') THEN '0294' ELSE '0250' END as "Revenue Code",
drug_data.ROUTE_ADMIN as "Route of Admin",
claims.metric_quantity as "Filled Quantity",
'' as "HCPCS Code",
'' as "HCPCS Quanity",
case WHEN DRUG_DATA.SIZE_U_M = 'EA' THEN 'UN' 
		WHEN DRUG_DATA.SIZE_U_M = 'GM' THEN 'GR' 
		WHEN DRUG_DATA.SIZE_U_M = 'MG' THEN 'ME'	
		ELSE DRUG_DATA.SIZE_U_M END as "Unit of Measure",
claims.client_amount_paid as "Charge",
'Y' as "Billed",
case when CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR IN ('Y','C') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as "Active",
CASE WHEN CLAIMS.COMPOUND_CODE = 2 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as "Compound",
cc.ing_number as "ING Number",
claims.RX_NUMBER as "Prescription Number",
claims.rx_Date as "Rx Date",
claims.process_Date as "Process Date",
claims.new_refill as "Refill",
claims.refill_number as "Refill Number",
drug_data.METRIC_STRENGTH as "Strength",
claims.days_supply as "Day Supply",
'' as "Frequency",
claims.physician_number as "Physician Number",
claims.physician_last_name || ',' || claims.physician_first_name as "Physician Name",
claims.pharmacy_npi_number as "Pharmacy NPI",
claims.pharmacy_name as "Pharmacy Name",
claims.claim_key as "Claim Key",
claims.process_Date as "Msg Time Date Stamp",
claims.rx_otc_code as "Rx OTC",
claims.current_claim_indicator as "Current Claim Indicator"
from 
(select *, master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND claims.NDC_TYPE_CODE IN (1,2,3)
AND CLAIMS.RX_OTC_CODE <> 'O' AND CLAIMS.RX_OTC_CODE <> 'P'

 and systemnumber = 136 and sponsornumber = 3720 and mastergroupnumber = 87291 and  

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
inner join 
(select distinct drug_key,dosage_form,route_Admin,SIZE_U_M,METRIC_STRENGTH from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' AND (TER_DATE IS NULL OR TER_DATE >= current_Date )) drug_data
on drug_data.drug_key = LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0)
left join 
(select distinct claim_key, ing_number from cloud_data_warehouse.claimcompound 
where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cc
on cc.claim_key = claims.claim_key
)

select * from final_Data
ExportName: Bimonthly La Vida Hospice CMS PDM Master File

_id: CARX_Bimonthly VNA Claremont San Bern HCHB CMS Report
SubjectLine: Bimonthly VNA Claremont San Bern HCHB CMS Report
Query:
with data_filters as (
select CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATEADD('day', 15,DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)))
ELSE date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) end as start_date,
CASE
WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 15 THEN date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
ELSE date(DATEADD('day', 14, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))) end as end_date
),     

claims_final as
(
select claims.*,route_Admin,SIZE_U_M,METRIC_STRENGTH,vendor_id,agency_id
from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif) claims
WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND claims.NDC_TYPE_CODE IN (1,2,3)
AND CLAIMS.RX_OTC_CODE <> 'O' AND CLAIMS.RX_OTC_CODE <> 'P'
and systemnumber = 136 and sponsornumber = 3864 and mastergroupnumber = 87184 and   

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
inner join 
(select distinct drug_key,route_Admin,SIZE_U_M,METRIC_STRENGTH from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' AND (TER_DATE IS NULL OR TER_DATE >= current_Date )) drug_data
on drug_data.drug_key = LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0)

left join 
(select distinct claim_key, ing_number from cloud_data_warehouse.claimcompound 
where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cc
on cc.claim_key = claims.claim_key

left join 
(select vendor_id,agency_id,pdm_group from cloud_data_warehouse.cms_hospice where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cmshps
on claims.groupnumber = cmshps.pdm_group
),

final_data as (
select 
claims_final.vendor_id as "Vendor ID",
claims_final.agency_id as "Agency ID",
claims_final.cardholder_number as "HCHB Medical Record Number",
claims_final.member_last_name as "Last Name",
claims_final.member_first_name as "First Name",
claims_final.member_birth_date as "Date of Birth",
claims_final.member_sex as "Gender",
claims_final.prod_abbreviation as "Medication Name",
claims_final.dosage_form as "Dosage",
lpad(claims_final.ndc,11,0) as "NDC",
case when claims_final.ROUTE_ADMIN IN ('EP','IA','IC','ID','IJ','IL','IM','IO','IP','IS','IT','IV','IX','PL','SC') THEN '0294' ELSE '0250' END as "Revenue Code",
claims_final.ROUTE_ADMIN as "Route Type",
case WHEN claims_final.SIZE_U_M = 'EA' THEN 'UN' 
		WHEN claims_final.SIZE_U_M = 'GM' THEN 'GR' 
		WHEN claims_final.SIZE_U_M = 'MG' THEN 'ME'	
		ELSE claims_final.SIZE_U_M END as "Unit of Measure",
'' as "HCPCS",
claims_final.METRIC_QUANTITY as "Filled Quantity",
claims_final.client_amount_paid as "Charge",
'Y' as "Billed",
CASE WHEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'R'  THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END as "Active",
'' as "Cost",
CASE WHEN claims_final.COMPOUND_CODE = 2 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as "Compound",
claims_final.RX_NUMBER as "Prescription Number",
claims_final.RX_DATE as "Fill Date",
claims_final.refill_number as "Rx Refill Number"
from claims_final
order by rx_number
)

select * from final_data
ExportName: Bimonthly VNA Claremont San Bern HCHB CMS Report

select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),  

final_data as
( 
Select	distinct
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
CLAIMS.PHARMACY_NUMBER as NCPDPNumber,
claims.pharmacy_name as pharmacy_name,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number as cardholdernumber,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER as MemberNumber,
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_first_name) as FirstName,
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_LAST_NAME)  as LastName,
CASE
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'R'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'S'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'O'::text THEN 'OTC'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'P'::text THEN 'OTC'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS rx_otc,
claims.ndc as ndc,
claims.prod_abbreviation as prod_abbr,
1 as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
to_char(claims.process_date,'mm/dd/yyyy') as process_date,
size_u_m
from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial) CLAIMS
left join (select distinct drug_key,size_u_m from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') drug_data
on LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) = drug_Data.drug_key
WHERE (CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D')
and systemnumber = 136 and sponsornumber = 3720 and mastergroupnumber = 87200 and  

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY 
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
claims.pharmacy_name,
CLAIMS.PHARMACY_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_first_name),
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_LAST_NAME),
CASE
WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'R'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'S'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'O'::text THEN 'OTC'::text
WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'P'::text THEN 'OTC'::text
ELSE NULL::text
END,
claims.ndc,
claims.prod_abbreviation,
claims.process_date,
size_u_m
)

select 
groupnumber Number,
groupname as "Patient Name",
prod_abbr as "Drug Name",
rx_otc as "Rx OTC",
process_date as "Process Date",
Rxdate as "Rx Date",
rxnumber as "Rx Number",
MetricQuantity as "Dispensed Quantity",
dayssupply as "D/S",
Claims as "Claims",
size_u_m as "Unit Of Measure",
amt_paid as "Amt Paid",
pharmacy_name as "Pharmacy Name"

from 
(

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
null as rx_otc,
null as rxdate,
null as rxnumber,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
null as process_date,
sum(claims) as Claims,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
null as pharmacy_name,
null as size_u_m,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(groupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname as groupname,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
null as rx_otc,
null as rxdate,
null as rxnumber,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
null as process_date,
sum(claims) as Claims,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
null as pharmacy_name,
null as size_u_m,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from final_data
group by 
groupnumber, 
groupname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)


union all 

select 
'' as groupnumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname as groupname,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
null as rx_otc,
null as rxdate,
null as rxnumber,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
null as process_date,
sum(claims) as Claims,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
null as pharmacy_name,
null as size_u_m,
'4.card' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from final_data
group by 
lastname || ', ' || firstname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(cardholdernumber || '-' || MemberNumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname as groupname,
cast(ndc as text) as ndc,
cast(prod_abbr as text) as prod_abbr,
cast(rx_otc as text) as rx_otc,
cast(rxdate as text) as rxdate,
cast(rxnumber as text) as rxnumber,
cast(sum(dayssupply) as int) as dayssupply,
cast(sum(metricquantity) as int) as metricquantity,
process_Date as process_Date,
sum(claims) as Claims,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
pharmacy_name as pharmacy_name,
size_u_m as size_u_m,
'5.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from final_data

group by 
cast(cardholdernumber || '-' || MemberNumber as varchar),
lastname || ', ' || firstname,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
rx_otc,
rxdate,
rxnumber,
process_Date,
pharmacy_name,
size_u_m,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,process_Date

  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_LAST_NAME ELSE chd.LAST_NAME END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_FIRST_NAME ELSE chd.FIRST_NAME END,  
  CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_MIDDLE_INITIAL ELSE chd.MIDDLE_INITIAL END,  
  c.THIRD_PARTY_CODE,  
  p.NPI_NUMBER,  
  c.OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,  
  c.DEDUCT_AMT,  
  chd.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,  
  null as FILLER_1,  
  null as FILLER_2,  
  c.AMT_COPAY,  
  c.AMT_COINSURANCE,  
  c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X AS "Physician Number",
  CASE
                WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X, '[^0-9]', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN
                    (SELECT RTRIM(LastName) || ', ' || RTRIM(FirstName) || ' ' || MiddleInitial
                     FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE
                     WHERE NPI = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X
                     LIMIT 1)
                ELSE
                    (SELECT RTRIM(LastName) || ', ' || RTRIM(FirstName) || ' ' || MiddleInitial
                     FROM cloud_data_warehouse.vw_HMS_PRACTITIONER_PROFILE
                     WHERE DEA = c.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X
                     LIMIT 1) end as "Physician Name",  
  c.PROCESS_DATE,
  NULL as DateofReversal,  
  CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'   
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' 
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND c.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J' THEN 'J'  
  ELSE 'U' END as PaidorReversalFlag,  
  1 as AdjClaimCount,  
  c.AMOUNT_PAID as AdjAmountPaid,  
  c.Amount_Applied_To_OOP,  
  c.SKIP_LIMIT_FLAG,  
   p.State as PharmacyState ,  
  dd.DOSAGE_FORM as DosageForm ,  
  dd.METRIC_STRENGTH as MetricStrength ,  
  dd.SIZE_U_M as SizeUM ,  
  dd.ROUTE_ADMIN as RouteofAdministration ,  
  CASE WHEN c.GENERIC_CODE in ('Y', 'B') THEN 'GENERIC' 
    ELSE 'BRAND' END as BrandGeneric ,  
  rtrim(gd.GROUP_NAME) as GroupName
FROM (select BATCH_NUMBER,CLAIM_NUMBER, CLAIM_KEY , CLAIM_TYPE, PAYMENT_DIR, REJECT_CODE_1, REJECT_CODE_2, RX_NUMBER,  RX_DATE,  NEW_REFILL,METRIC_QUANTITY,  DAYS_SUPPLY,  ING_BILLED,  ING_PAID,DIFF_ING_PAID,  DISP_FEE,DIFF_DISP_FEE,  COPAY,  TAX,  AMOUNT_PAID,  UCR_AMOUNT,MEMBER_BIRTH,SEX,CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,MEMBER_NUMBER,PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X,DIAGNOSIS_CODE,   
GENERIC_CODE,  MAC_NUMBER,  DAW_INDICATOR,  THERA_CLASS,  RX_OTC,  GPI,  EXCEPTION_01,  OVERRIDE_1,  PERIOD_ENDING,  COMPOUND_CODE,  BATCH_DATE,  
MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,  AWP_100_PERCENT,  DRUG_PREF_IND,  PRICE_INDICATOR, PATIENT_LAST_NAME,  PATIENT_FIRST_NAME,  PATIENT_MIDDLE_INITIAL,  THIRD_PARTY_CODE,    DEDUCT_AMT,   
OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,  AMT_COPAY,  AMT_COINSURANCE,CLAIMS_COUNTER, PROCESS_DATE, REVERSAL_CODE, amount_applied_to_oop,  SKIP_LIMIT_FLAG,GROUP_NUMBER,CARDHOLDER_KEY,DRUG_KEY,PHARMACY_NUMBER,CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,Date_of_Reversal, CHAIN_NUMBER
from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and sys_number= 173) c    
INNER JOIN (select reversal_key,proc_date,date_of_reversal from cloud_data_warehouse.reversal where meta_curr_ind ='Y') r  
 ON c.CLAIM_KEY = r.REVERSAL_KEY  
INNER JOIN (select CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG, SYSTEM_NUMBER, SPONSOR_NUMBER, GROUP_NUMBER,  ALT_GROUP_NUMBER, GROUP_BENEFIT_CODE, 
GROUP_NAME from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') gd    
 ON gd.GROUP_NUMBER = c.GROUP_NUMBER   
INNER JOIN (select BIRTH_DATE, SEX, CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ,MEMBER_NUMBER , ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  RELATIONSHIP_CODE, LAST_NAME ,  FIRST_NAME , MIDDLE_INITIAL ,CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
CARDHOLDER_KEY  from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') chd      
 ON chd.CARDHOLDER_KEY = c.CARDHOLDER_KEY   
INNER JOIN (select NDC_TYPE_CODE,  NDC, PROD_ABBR,MANUF_NAME_ABBR,DEA_CODE,DOSAGE_FORM, METRIC_STRENGTH, SIZE_U_M,  
ROUTE_ADMIN, DRUG_KEY from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') dd    
 ON dd.DRUG_KEY = c.DRUG_KEY   
INNER JOIN (select  gpi from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data where meta_curr_ind ='Y') g   
 ON g.GPI = c.GPI   
INNER JOIN (select NABP_NUMBER, PHARMACY_NAME, NPI_NUMBER, State from cloud_data_warehouse.phdem where meta_curr_ind ='Y' and system_number=0)  p 
 ON p.NABP_NUMBER = c.PHARMACY_NUMBER       
WHERE     (c.PROCESS_DATE = current_date -1)   
    AND REJECT_CODE_1 in (0)  
    AND (c.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'O' OR (c.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR  = 'Y' AND c.REVERSAL_CODE = '1'))      
ORDER BY c.Date_of_Reversal DESC , c.PROCESS_DATE desc))
ORDER BY Batch_Number;

CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number ,

select 

groupnumber "Rx Date",
groupname "Rx Number",
card_number_on_card "Card Number on Card",
ndc "NDC",
prod_abbr "Drug Description",
claims "Claims",
dayssupply "Day Supply",
MetricQuantity "Metric Quantity",
drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",
Copay "Copay",
amt_paid "Amount  Paid"

from 
(

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(altgroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')' as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
card_number_on_card as card_number_on_card,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
card_number_on_card,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,amt_paid desc

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5702 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

select 
groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",
AWP "AWP",
UCR "UCR"
from 
(
select
	'' as groupnumber,
	systemname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,

	sum(copay) as copay,

	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'0.System' as type,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by 
	systemname,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)
	
	union all 
	
select
	cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	sponsorname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'1.sponsor' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key

	final_data
group by
	sponsornumber,
	sponsorname,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)
	
union all


select
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	mastergroupname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'2.mastergroup' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key

from
	final_data

group by
	mastergroupnumber,
	mastergroupname,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  


select
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
	groupname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,

	final_data

cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar),
groupname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  

select
	cast(CardholderNumber as varchar) groupnumber,
	lastname || ', ' || firstname  as groupname,
	age as age,
	gender as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'4.cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
CardholderNumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname,
age,
gender,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar)

union all  
select
	ndc as groupnumber,
	cast(PROD_ABBR as varchar)  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	cast(rxdate as varchar) as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	max(MetricQuantity) as MetricQuantity,
	max(DaysSupply) as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'5.drug' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
ndc,
PROD_ABBR,
rxdate,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar)
)
order by key,type asc

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
 
group_term_data as (
select distinct group_number  from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data 
where (group_ter_date IS NULL or group_ter_date = '1801-01-01' or group_ter_date >= (select end_date from data_filters))
),

vw_final_data as (
select distinct
members.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
members.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
members.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
members.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
members.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
members.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
members.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
members.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
alternate_cardholder_number as altcardholdernumber,
cardholder_number || '-' || member_number cardholdernumber,
to_char(date_of_birth,'mm/dd/yyyy') birthdate,
to_char(effective_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  effdate,
to_char(term_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  termdate,
first_name firstname,
last_name lastname,
members.MEMBER_NUMBER,
(case when MEMBER_NUMBER = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS pri_memb,
(CASE WHEN MEMBER_NUMBER <> '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS dependent
from
(select systemnumber, system_name, sponsornumber, sponsor_name, master_group, master_group_name, groupnumber, group_name, cardholder_number, member_number, relationship_code, card_number_on_card, alternate_cardholder_number, last_name, first_name, middle_initial, date_of_birth, sex, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, zip, team, coverage_type, cobra_flag, effective_date, term_date from  subscriptions.vw_member_extract 
where (term_date IS NULL or term_date = '1801-01-01' or term_date > (select end_date from data_filters))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5677 and 
systemnumber is not null ) members
inner join group_term_data on group_term_data.group_number = members.groupnumber
)

),  

final_Data as (
select 
claims.claim_key as ClaimBatchNumber,
to_char(claims.PERIOD_ENDING,'yyyymmdd') as PeriodEnding,
claims.rx_number as PBMClaimReference,
claims1.claims_counter as ClaimCounter,
claims.current_claim_indicator as ClaimIndicator,
to_char(claims.rx_Date,'yyyymmdd') as RxDate,
claims.cardholder_number as HTHPolicyID,
claims.member_number as HTHMemberSequence,
claims.card_id_sent_from_pharm as GeoBlueMemberID,
claims.alt_cardholder_number as AltCardNumber,
cards.last_name as PatientLastName,
cards.first_name as PatientFirstName,
cards.middle_initial as PatientMiddleInitial,
to_char(member_birth_date,'yyyymmdd') as PatientDOB,
CASE claims.Member_SEX  WHEN 'M' THEN '1'  WHEN 'F' THEN '2' WHEN 'U' THEN '0' ELSE claims.Member_SEX end as PatientGender,
claims.member_relationship_code as MemberRelationship,
claims.alt_group_number as GroupNoPlanCode,
claims.groupnumber as PDMGroupNumber,
claims.sponsornumber as SponsorNumber,
cast(left(claims.pharmacy_number,length(claims.pharmacy_number)-1) as int) as PharmacyNumber,
claims.pharmacy_npi_number as PharmacyNPI,
claims.physician_number as PhysicianNumber,
lpad(claims.ndc,11,0) as NationalDrugCode,
claims.therapeutic_class_category as NDCDrugClassification,
claims.prod_abbreviation as ProductName,
claims.compound_code as CompoundCode,
claims.generic_code as GenericCode,
lpad(claims.gpi,14,0) as GPI,
CASE Claims.NEW_REFILL  WHEN 'N' THEN '0' WHEN 'R' THEN '1' ELSE Claims.NEW_REFILL END as NewRefillIndicator,
claims.metric_quantity as MetricQuantity,
claims.days_supply as DaysSupply,
claims.mail_order_flag as MailOrderIndicator,
claims.ucr_amount as IngredientCostBilled,
claims.client_ingredient_paid as IngredientCostPaid,
claims.client_dispensing_fee as DispensingFee,
claims.patient_pay as Copay,
claims.tax as Tax,
claims.deduct_amount as DeductibleAmount,
claims.client_amount_paid as TotalAmountPaid,
case WHEN LEFT(CLAIMS.GPI ,10) = '9999999999' THEN 0 WHEN (GROUP_DATA.BROKER = 'EPS' OR CLAIMS1.NETWORK_NUMBER  IN ('1080', '286')) THEN 5 
	when CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG = 'M' then admin1.Mail_3 else admin1.Direct_3 end as "Admin Fee" ,
CASE WHEN claims.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG = 'D' THEN 'M'  ELSE 'P' END as Payee,
claims.drug_pref_indicator as DrugPrefInd,
claims.pharmacy_name as PharmacyName,
CASE WHEN claims.Process_Date between gpi.GPIEffectiveDate and gpi.GPITermDate THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END as SpecialtyInd,
group_Data.broker as BrokerName,
claims.process_Date as ProcessDate

from
(select *, master_group as mastergroupnumber from  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif
WHERE (CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N'and CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D')

 and systemnumber = 58 and sponsornumber = 1770 and   

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)) claims
left join (select claim_key,claims_counter,network_number from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key
left join (select distinct group_number, broker, adm_eff_date_1,adm_eff_date_2,adm_eff_date_3,adm_eff_date_4,adm_eff_date_5,adm_schedule_number_1,
				adm_schedule_number_2,adm_schedule_number_3,adm_schedule_number_4,adm_schedule_number_5 from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') group_data
on claims.groupnumber = group_Data.group_number
left join (select * from cloud_data_warehouse."admin" where meta_curr_ind = 'Y' ) admin1
ON CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER = admin1.System_Number               
   AND CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER = admin1.Sponsor_Number               
   AND (CASE WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_5, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_4, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_5        
	   		 WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_4, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_3, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_4        
			 WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_3, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_2, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_3        
			 WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_2, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_1, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_2        
			 ELSE GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_1       
			 END) = admin1.Schedule_Number
left join (select gpi,CASE WHEN GPI is NOT NULL AND gpi_add_date IS NULL THEN '1-1-1900' ELSE ss_gen_term_date END as GPIEffectiveDate,
		CASE WHEN GPI is NOT NULL AND gpi_add_date IS NULL THEN '12-31-2999' ELSE ss_gen_term_date END as GPITermDate 
		from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') gpi
on claims.gpi = gpi.gpi
left join (select cardholder_key, last_name,first_name, middle_initial from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') cards
on LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) = cards.CARDHOLDER_KEY
)

WHEN substring(N1ClaimKEY ,5,1) <> 'N' and Reject_Code_1 = '0'  -- N1 Paid Claim
THEN COPAY - (SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)

(SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS  WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)

	when CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG = 'M' then admin1.Mail_3 else admin1.Direct_3 end as "Admin Fee" ,

	   		 WHEN CLAIMS.RX_DATE between ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_4, '1/1/1900') AND ISNULL(GROUP_DATA.ADM_EFF_DATE_3, '1/1/1900')-1 THEN GROUP_DATA.ADM_SCHEDULE_NUMBER_4

left join (select gpi,CASE WHEN GPI is NOT NULL AND gpi_add_date IS NULL THEN '1-1-1900' ELSE ss_gen_term_date END as GPIEffectiveDate,
		CASE WHEN GPI is NOT NULL AND gpi_add_date IS NULL THEN '12-31-2999' ELSE ss_gen_term_date END as GPITermDate 
		from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') gpi
on claims.gpi = gpi.gpi

on LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) = cards.CARDHOLDER_KEY
)

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1

	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3928 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,

Query:
with data_filters as (
select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
),     

claims as 
(select claims.*,claims_counter,reversal_code  from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif)
WHERE systemnumber is not null
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3114 and  

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
left join 
(select distinct claim_key,claims_counter,reversal_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key),

final_data as
(
SELECT 

CLAIMS.REJECT_CODE_1 AS Reject_Code_1 ,
-1 AS Claims_counter ,
CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR AS CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR ,
CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal AS DateofReversal ,
'R' AS PaidorReversalFlag ,
1 AS AdjClaimCount ,
-1 * (CLAIMS.CLIENT_AMOUNT_PAID) AS AdjAmountPaid,
CLAIMS.REJECT_CODE_2 AS Reject_Code_2 ,
left(CLAIMS.claim_key,8) as BatchNumber,
cast(right(CLAIMS.claim_key,6) as int) as ClaimNumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY AS CLAIM_KEY ,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER AS SPONSOR_NUMBER ,
CLAIMS.pharmacy_number AS NABP_NUMBER ,
CLAIMS.PHARMACY_NAME AS PHARMACY_NAME ,
CLAIMS.pharmacy_address_1 AS STREET_1 ,
CLAIMS.pharmacy_address_2 AS STREET_2 ,
CLAIMS.pharmacy_city AS CITY ,
CLAIMS.pharmacy_state AS STATEABBR ,
CLAIMS.pharmacy_zip_code AS ZIP ,
CLAIMS.pharmacy_phone AS PHONE ,
'' AS FEDERAL_TAX_ID_NUMBER ,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER AS RX_NUMBER ,
CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE AS PROCESS_DATE ,
CLAIMS.NDC AS NDC ,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation AS PROD_ABBR ,
CLAIMS.NEW_REFILL AS NEW_REFILL ,
CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY AS METRIC_QUANTITY ,
CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY AS DAYS_SUPPLY ,
'' AS BASIS_OF_COST_DETERMINATION ,
CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid - CLAIMS.diff_ingredient_paid AS ING_PAID ,
CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee - CLAIMS.diff_dispensing_fee AS DISP_FEE ,
CLAIMS.patient_pay AS COPAY ,
CLAIMS.deduct_amount AS DEDUCT_AMT ,
CLAIMS.patient_pay AS COPAY2 ,
CLAIMS.TAX AS TAX ,
CLAIMS.client_amount_paid AS AMOUNT_PAID ,
CLAIMS.AWP_100_PERCENT AS AWP_100_PERCENT ,
CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT AS UCR_AMOUNT ,
CLAIMS.admin_fee_on_claim AS ADMIN_FEE ,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_FIRST_NAME ,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_LAST_NAME AS PATIENT_LAST_NAME ,
CLAIMS.cardholderbirthdate AS BIRTH_DATE ,
CLAIMS.cardholder_sex AS SEX ,
CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER AS CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ,
CLAIMS.member_relationship_code AS RELATIONSHIP_CODE ,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number AS ALT_GROUP_NUMBER ,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME ,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME ,
CLAIMS.DAW_INDICATOR AS DAW_INDICATOR ,
CLAIMS.COMPOUND_CODE AS COMPOUND_CODE ,
CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE AS GENERIC_CODE ,
CASE WHEN CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS DRUG_PREF_IND ,
CLAIMS.gpi_name AS GPI_DESCRIPTION_2 ,
'' AS DISPENSER_TYPE_CODE ,
CLAIMS.PRICE_INDICATOR AS PRICE_INDICATOR,
CLAIMS.amount_applied_to_oop AS OOP,
CLAIMS.PENALTY_AMOUNT AS Penalty_Amount,
CLAIMS.original_claim_key AS N1ClaimKey,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE AS RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD AS CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD
FROM claims
WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R'

UNION all

SELECT 

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0  
	 else claims.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     else claims.CLAIMS_COUNTER
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
	else claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
     else claims.date_of_reversal
     END as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     else
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
     END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     else 1
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     else CLAIMS.client_amount_paid
     END as  AdjAmountPaid,
CLAIMS.REJECT_CODE_2 AS Reject_Code_2 ,
left(CLAIMS.claim_key,8) as BatchNumber,
cast(right(CLAIMS.claim_key,6) as int) as ClaimNumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY AS CLAIM_KEY ,

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),  

final_data as
( 
Select	distinct
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
CLAIMS.PHARMACY_NUMBER as NCPDPNumber,
claims.pharmacy_name as pharmacy_name,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number as cardholdernumber,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER as MemberNumber,
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_first_name) as FirstName,
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_LAST_NAME)  as LastName,
CASE
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'R'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'S'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'O'::text THEN 'OTC'::text
            WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'P'::text THEN 'OTC'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS rx_otc,
claims.ndc as ndc,
claims.prod_abbreviation as prod_abbr,
1 as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
to_char(claims.process_date,'mm/dd/yyyy') as process_date,
size_u_m
from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial) CLAIMS
left join (select distinct drug_key,size_u_m from cloud_data_warehouse.drug_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') drug_data
on LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) = drug_Data.drug_key
WHERE (CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D')
and systemnumber = 136 and sponsornumber = 3720 and mastergroupnumber = 87344 and  

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
claims.pharmacy_name,
CLAIMS.PHARMACY_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_first_name),
Rtrim(CLAIMS.member_LAST_NAME),
CASE
WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'R'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'S'::text THEN 'Rx'::text
WHEN CLAIMS.rx_otc_code::text = 'O'::text THEN 'OTC'::text

ELSE NULL::text
END,
claims.ndc,
claims.prod_abbreviation,
claims.process_date,
size_u_m
)

claims.alt_group_number as GroupNoPlanCode,

	when CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG = 'M' then admin1.Mail_3 else admin1.Direct_3 end as "Admin Fee" ,

final_data as
(
SELECT

-1 AS Claims_counter ,
CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR AS CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR ,
CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal AS DateofReversal ,
'R' AS PaidorReversalFlag ,
1 AS AdjClaimCount ,
-1 * (CLAIMS.CLIENT_AMOUNT_PAID) AS AdjAmountPaid,

left(CLAIMS.claim_key,8) as BatchNumber,

CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY AS CLAIM_KEY ,

CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE AS PROCESS_DATE ,
CLAIMS.NDC AS NDC ,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation AS PROD_ABBR ,
CLAIMS.NEW_REFILL AS NEW_REFILL ,
CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY AS METRIC_QUANTITY ,
CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY AS DAYS_SUPPLY ,
'' AS BASIS_OF_COST_DETERMINATION ,
CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid - CLAIMS.diff_ingredient_paid AS ING_PAID ,
CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee - CLAIMS.diff_dispensing_fee AS DISP_FEE ,
CLAIMS.patient_pay AS COPAY ,
CLAIMS.deduct_amount AS DEDUCT_AMT ,
CLAIMS.patient_pay AS COPAY2 ,

CLAIMS.cardholder_sex AS SEX ,
CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER AS CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ,

UNION all

SELECT 

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0  
	 else claims.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     else claims.CLAIMS_COUNTER
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
	else claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
     else claims.date_of_reversal
     END as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     else
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
     END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     else 1
     END as  AdjClaimCount,

WHEN substring(N1ClaimKEY ,5,1) <> 'N' and Reject_Code_1 = '0'  -- N1 Paid Claim
THEN COPAY - (SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)

(SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS  WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)

	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,

     else claims.CLAIMS_COUNTER
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,

	else claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,

     else claims.date_of_reversal
     END as date_of_reversal,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END

     END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     else 1
     END as  AdjClaimCount,

CLAIMS.client_amount_paid AS AMOUNT_PAID ,
CLAIMS.AWP_100_PERCENT AS AWP_100_PERCENT ,
CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT AS UCR_AMOUNT ,
CLAIMS.admin_fee_on_claim AS ADMIN_FEE ,

CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * DISP_FEE ELSE DISP_FEE END as "Dispensing Fee",

CASE 
WHEN substring(N1ClaimKEY ,5,1) <> 'N' and Reject_Code_1 = '0'  -- N1 Paid Claim
THEN COPAY - (SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)
WHEN (N1ClaimKey is NULL OR  SUBSTRING(Claim_Key, 1, 4) = substring(N1ClaimKey, 1, 4))THEN (CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * COPAY ELSE COPAY END) --Normal Claim

DISPENSER_TYPE_CODE as "Pharmacy Type",
DISPENSER_TYPE_CODE,

	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid

	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR

null as date_of_reversal,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then

    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00

select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
),    

claims_final as
(select claims.*,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif)
WHERE systemnumber is not null
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber in ( 3901,3654,3973,5554,5560,5563) and 
process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
left join 
(select distinct claim_key,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key),

result_data as (
SELECT   
left(claims_final.claim_key,8) as batch_number,
cast(right(claims_final.claim_key,6) as int) as claim_number,
claims_final.CLAIM_KEY ,
claims_final.claim_type,
claims_final.PAYMENT_DIR,
claims_final.pharmacy_number,
claims_final.CHAIN_NUMBER,
claims_final.PHARMACY_NAME,
claims_final.REJECT_CODE_2,
claims_final.RX_NUMBER,
claims_final.RX_DATE,
claims_final.NDC_TYPE_CODE,
LPAD(claims_final.NDC,0,11) as NDC,
claims_final.prod_abbreviation,
claims_final.NEW_REFILL,
claims_final.METRIC_QUANTITY,
claims_final.DAYS_SUPPLY,
claims_final.ingredient_billed,
claims_final.client_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid as ING_PAID,
claims_final.client_dispensing_fee - claims_final.diff_dispensing_fee as DISP_FEE,
claims_final.patient_pay,
claims_final.TAX,
claims_final.client_amount_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_dispensing_fee as AMOUNT_PAID,
claims_final.UCR_AMOUNT,
claims_final.member_birth_date,
claims_final.member_sex,
claims_final.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
claims_final.MEMBER_NUMBER,
claims_final.ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
claims_final.member_relationship_code,
claims_final.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,
claims_final.diagnosis_code,
claims_final.systemnumber,
claims_final.sponsornumber,
claims_final.groupnumber,
claims_final.alt_group_number,
claims_final.GENERIC_CODE,
claims_final.MAC_NUMBER,
claims_final.DAW_INDICATOR,
claims_final.therapeutic_class_name,
claims_final.RX_OTC_CODE,
claims_final.GPI,
claims_final.EXCEPTION_01,
claims_final.OVERRIDE_1,
claims_final.PERIOD_ENDING,
'' as PAID_DATE,
claims_final.COMPOUND_CODE,
claims_final.batch_date,
claims_final.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,
claims_final.benefit_code,
claims_final.AWP_100_PERCENT,
claims_final.drug_pref_indicator,
claims_final.PRICE_INDICATOR,
claims_final.manuf_name_abbr,
claims_final.member_first_name,
claims_final.member_last_name,
claims_final.member_middle_initial,
claims_final.third_party_code,
claims_final.pharmacy_npi_number,
claims_final.OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,
claims_final.deduct_amount,
claims_final.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
'' FILLER_1,
'' FILLER_2,
claims_final.amount_co_insurance,
claims_final.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,
(physician_last_name || ',' || physician_first_name) as physician_name,
claims_final.PROCESS_DATE,
claims_final.amount_applied_to_oop,
claims_final.skip_limit_flag,
claims_final.penalty_amount,
claims_final.admin_fee_on_claim,
claims_final.specialty_flag,
controlled_substance_indicator as dea_code,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0  
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

SELECT

Claim_Number AS "C111TT-CLAIM-NUMBER",
Claim_Type AS "C111TT-CLAIM-TYPE",
Payment_Dir AS "C111TT-PAYMENT-DIRECT",
lpad(pharmacy_number,6,0) AS "C111TT-PHARMACY-NUMBER",
Chain_Number AS "C111TT-CHAIN-NUMBER",
RTRIM(Pharmacy_Name) AS "C111TT-PHARMACY-NAME",
Reject_Code_1 AS "C111TT-REJECT-CODE-01",
Reject_Code_2 AS "C111TT-REJECT-CODE-02",
'' AS "C111TT-DIAGNOSIS-CODE-ICD10",
date_part_year(trunc(Rx_Date)) * 10000 + date_part(month,Rx_Date) * 100 + date_part(day,Rx_Date) AS "C111TT-RX-DATE",
NDC_Type_Code AS "C111TT-DRUG-TYPE-CODE",
NDC AS "C111TT-NATIONAL-DRUG-CODE",
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(prod_abbreviation), '"', ''), '', ''), '|', ''), ',', '') AS "C111TT-PRODUCT-NAME",
CASE NEW_REFILL WHEN 'N' THEN 0 WHEN 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS "C111TT-NEW-REFILL-IND",
Metric_Quantity AS "C111TT-METRIC-QUANTITY",
Days_Supply AS "C111TT-DAYS-SUPPLY",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ingredient_billed ELSE ingredient_billed END AS "C111TT-INGREDIENT-COST-BILLED",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * Disp_Fee ELSE Disp_Fee END AS "C111TT-DISPENSING-FEE",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * patient_pay ELSE patient_pay END AS "C111TT-COPAY",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * Tax ELSE Tax END AS "C111TT-TAX",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * UCR_Amount ELSE UCR_Amount END AS "C111TT-UCR-AMOUNT",
(date_part_year(trunc(member_birth_date))*10000 + date_part(month,member_birth_date)*100 + date_part(day,member_birth_date)) AS "C111TT-MEMBER-BIRTHDATE",
CASE member_sex WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 WHEN 'U' THEN 0 ELSE 3 END AS "C111TT-MEMBER-SEX",
RTRIM(Cardholder_Number) AS "C111TT-CARDHOLDER-NUMBER",
RTRIM(Member_Number) AS "C111TT-MEMBER-NUMBER",
RTRIM(Alt_Cardholder_Number) AS "C111TT-ALTERNATE-CARD-NUMBER",
RTRIM(member_relationship_code) AS "C111TT-PATIENT-RELATIONSHIP",
Diagnosis_Code AS "C111TT-DIAGNOSIS-CODE",
SystemNumber AS "C111TT-PDM-SYSTEM-NUMBER",
SponsorNumber AS "C111TT-PDM-SPONSOR-NUMBER",
GroupNumber AS "C111TT-PDM-GROUP-NUMBER",
RTRIM(Alt_Group_Number) AS "C111TT-GROUP-NUMBER",
Generic_Code AS "C111TT-GENERIC-CODE",
Mac_Number AS "C111TT-MAC-NUMBER",
Daw_Indicator AS "C111TT-DAW-IND",
therapeutic_class_name AS "C111TT-THERAPEUTIC-CLASS-CODE",
Rx_OTC_CODE AS "C111TT-RX-OTC-CODE",
RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', 14) + CAST (GPI as varchar(14)), 14) AS "C111TT-GPI",
date_part_year(trunc(PERIOD_ENDING)) * 10000 + date_part(month,PERIOD_ENDING) * 100 + date_part(day,PERIOD_ENDING) AS "C111TT-PERIOD-ENDING-DATE",
'' AS "C111TT-PAID-DATE",
Compound_Code AS "C111TT-COMPOUND-CODE",
(date_part_year(trunc(Batch_Date))*10000 + date_part(month,Batch_Date)*100 + date_part(day,Batch_Date)) AS "C111TT-BATCH-DATE",
Claims_Counter AS "C111TT-CLAIM-COUNTER",
Mail_Order_Flag AS "C111TT-MAIL-ORDER",
benefit_code AS "C111TT-BENEFIT-CODE",
PaidorReversalFlag AS "C111TT-CLAIM-IND",
drug_pref_indicator AS "C111TT-DRUG-PREFERENCE-IND",
Price_Indicator AS "C111TT-PRICING-IND",
Manuf_Name_Abbr AS "C111TT-DRUG-MANUFACTURER",
Dea_Code AS "C111TT-CONTROLLED-SUBSTANCE",
RTRIM(member_last_name) AS "C111TT-PATIENT-LAST-NAME",
RTRIM(member_first_name) AS "C111TT-PATIENT-FIRST-NAME",
RTRIM(member_Middle_Initial) AS "C111TT-PATIENT-MIDDLE-INIT",
Third_Party_Code AS "C111TT-THIRD-PARTY-CODE",
pharmacy_npi_number AS "C111TT-PHARMACY-NPI-NUMBER",
Rx_Number AS "C111TT-RX-NUMBER",
Other_Coverage_Code AS "C111TT-OTHER-COVERAGE-CODE",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * deduct_amount ELSE deduct_amount END AS "C111TT-DEDUCTIBLE-AMOUNT",
RTRIM(Card_Number_on_Card) AS "C111TT-NUMBER-ON-CARD",
(date_part_year(trunc(date_of_reversal))*10000 + date_part(month,date_of_reversal)*100 + date_part(day,date_of_reversal)) AS "C111TT-REVERSAL-DATE",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_applied_to_oop ELSE amount_applied_to_oop END AS "C111TT-AMOUNT-APPLIED-TO-OOP",
CASE WHEN result_data.Skip_Limit_Flag between 1 and 99 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "C111TT-ACCUMULATOR-APPLIED-IND",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_co_insurance ELSE amount_co_insurance END AS "C111TT-AMOUNT-COINSURANCE",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * patient_pay ELSE patient_pay END AS "C111TT-AMOUNT-COPAY",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * penalty_amount ELSE penalty_amount END AS "C111TT-PENALTY-AMOUNT",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * admin_fee_on_claim ELSE admin_fee_on_claim END AS "C111TT-ADMIN-FEE",
result_data.specialty_flag AS "C111TT-FILLER-ONE",
RPAD(' ', 30, ' ') AS "C111TT-FILLER-TWO"
	FROM result_data
ORDER BY 
	result_data.Claim_Key, PaidorReversalFlag

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'

     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,

--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0

	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER

	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'

null as date_of_reversal,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then

    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1

case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00

		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,

		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,

		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,

	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5770 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,

)
