--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5533 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

(date_part_year(trunc(member_birth_date))*10000 + date_part(month,member_birth_date)*100 + date_part(day,member_birth_date)) AS "C111TT-MEMBER-BIRTHDATE",

therapeutic_class_name AS "C111TT-THERAPEUTIC-CLASS-CODE",

'' AS "C111TT-PAID-DATE",

benefit_code AS "C111TT-BENEFIT-CODE",

drug_pref_indicator AS "C111TT-DRUG-PREFERENCE-IND",
Price_Indicator AS "C111TT-PRICING-IND",

RTRIM(member_last_name) AS "C111TT-PATIENT-LAST-NAME",
RTRIM(member_first_name) AS "C111TT-PATIENT-FIRST-NAME",

pharmacy_npi_number AS "C111TT-PHARMACY-NPI-NUMBER",
Rx_Number AS "C111TT-RX-NUMBER",

CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * deduct_amount ELSE deduct_amount END AS "C111TT-DEDUCTIBLE-AMOUNT",
RTRIM(Card_Number_on_Card) AS "C111TT-NUMBER-ON-CARD",
(date_part_year(trunc(date_of_reversal))*10000 + date_part(month,date_of_reversal)*100 + date_part(day,date_of_reversal)) AS "C111TT-REVERSAL-DATE",
CASE WHEN result_data.PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * amount_applied_to_oop ELSE amount_applied_to_oop END AS "C111TT-AMOUNT-APPLIED-TO-OOP",
CASE WHEN result_data.Skip_Limit_Flag between 1 and 99 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "C111TT-ACCUMULATOR-APPLIED-IND",

RPAD(' ', 30, ' ') AS "C111TT-FILLER-TWO"

		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY,

		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,

		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5619 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

groupnumber "Number",

age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",
AWP "AWP",
UCR "UCR"
from 
(
select
	'' as groupnumber,
	systemname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'0.System' as type,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5700 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

with data_filters as (
select current_date - 1 as start_date,
current_date - 1 as end_date
),    

claims_final as
(select claims.*,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif)
WHERE systemnumber is not null
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5627 and 
process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
left join 
(select distinct claim_key,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,reversal_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key),

result_data as (
SELECT   
left(claims_final.claim_key,8) as batch_number,
cast(right(claims_final.claim_key,6) as int) as claim_number,
claims_final.CLAIM_KEY ,
claims_final.claim_type,
claims_final.PAYMENT_DIR,
claims_final.pharmacy_number,
claims_final.CHAIN_NUMBER,
claims_final.PHARMACY_NAME,
claims_final.REJECT_CODE_2,
claims_final.RX_NUMBER,
claims_final.RX_DATE,
claims_final.NDC_TYPE_CODE,
LPAD(claims_final.NDC,0,11) as NDC,
claims_final.prod_abbreviation,
claims_final.NEW_REFILL,
claims_final.METRIC_QUANTITY,
claims_final.DAYS_SUPPLY,
claims_final.ingredient_billed,
claims_final.client_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid as ING_PAID,
claims_final.client_dispensing_fee - claims_final.diff_dispensing_fee as DISP_FEE,
claims_final.patient_pay,
claims_final.TAX,
claims_final.client_amount_paid - claims_final.diff_ingredient_paid - claims_final.diff_dispensing_fee as AMOUNT_PAID,
claims_final.UCR_AMOUNT,
claims_final.member_birth_date,
claims_final.member_sex,
claims_final.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
claims_final.MEMBER_NUMBER,
claims_final.ALT_CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
claims_final.member_relationship_code,
claims_final.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,
claims_final.diagnosis_code,
claims_final.systemnumber,
claims_final.sponsornumber,
claims_final.groupnumber,
claims_final.alt_group_number,
claims_final.GENERIC_CODE,
claims_final.MAC_NUMBER,
claims_final.DAW_INDICATOR,
claims_final.therapeutic_class_name,
claims_final.RX_OTC_CODE,
claims_final.GPI,
claims_final.EXCEPTION_01,
claims_final.OVERRIDE_1,
claims_final.PERIOD_ENDING,
'' as PAID_DATE,
claims_final.COMPOUND_CODE,
claims_final.batch_date,
claims_final.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,
claims_final.benefit_code,
claims_final.AWP_100_PERCENT,
claims_final.drug_pref_indicator,
claims_final.PRICE_INDICATOR,
claims_final.manuf_name_abbr,
claims_final.member_first_name,
claims_final.member_last_name,
claims_final.member_middle_initial,
claims_final.third_party_code,
claims_final.pharmacy_npi_number,
claims_final.OTHER_COVERAGE_CODE,
claims_final.deduct_amount,
claims_final.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,
'' FILLER_1,
'' FILLER_2,
claims_final.amount_co_insurance,
claims_final.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,
(physician_last_name || ',' || physician_first_name) as physician_name,
claims_final.PROCESS_DATE,
claims_final.amount_applied_to_oop,
claims_final.skip_limit_flag,
claims_final.penalty_amount,
claims_final.admin_fee_on_claim,
claims_final.specialty_flag,
controlled_substance_indicator as dea_code,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0  
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.REJECT_CODE_1
	END as  REJECT_CODE_1,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1 
	 when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then -1
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,
--case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)))

		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,

		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,

		COUNT(*) AS Claims,

		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity,

benefit_code AS "C111TT-BENEFIT-CODE",

from vw_final_data

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5771 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

select 
groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",
AWP "AWP",
UCR "UCR"
from 
(
select
	'' as groupnumber,
	systemname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'0.System' as type,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by 
	systemname,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)
	
	union all 
	
select
	cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	sponsorname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,

1 as AdjClaimCount,
claims_final.client_amount_paid as AdjAmountPaid

from claims_final
inner join cloud_data_warehouse.reversal r 
on claims_final.claim_key = r.reversal_key
WHERE  REJECT_CODE_1 in (0)
		  AND claims_final.Date_of_Reversal >= (select start_date from data_filters)
		  AND (claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'O' OR (claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR  = 'Y' AND claims_final.REVERSAL_CODE = '1'))
)

RTRIM(member_relationship_code) AS "C111TT-PATIENT-RELATIONSHIP",

GroupNumber AS "C111TT-PDM-GROUP-NUMBER",

therapeutic_class_name AS "C111TT-THERAPEUTIC-CLASS-CODE",

'' AS "C111TT-PAID-DATE",

benefit_code AS "C111TT-BENEFIT-CODE",
PaidorReversalFlag AS "C111TT-CLAIM-IND",
drug_pref_indicator AS "C111TT-DRUG-PREFERENCE-IND",

CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,

CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1

	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR

--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL

null as date_of_reversal,

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0

     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid
     
FROM claims_final
where ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or  
	 (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
     (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or

), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,

		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5682 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",

CardholderNumber,

ndc,

), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3076 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",
AWP "AWP",
UCR "UCR"
from 
(
select
	'' as groupnumber,
	systemname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'0.System' as type,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by 
	systemname,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)
	
	union all 
	
select
	cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	sponsorname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,

	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'1.sponsor' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
	sponsornumber,
	sponsorname,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)
	
union all


select
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	mastergroupname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'2.mastergroup' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key

from
	final_data

group by
	mastergroupnumber,
	mastergroupname,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  


select
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
	groupname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,

	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,

	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,

	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'3.group' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar),
groupname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all

	cast(CardholderNumber as varchar) groupnumber,
	lastname || ', ' || firstname  as groupname,

	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'4.cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
CardholderNumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname,
age,
gender,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar)

union all

	ndc as groupnumber,
	cast(PROD_ABBR as varchar)  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	cast(rxdate as varchar) as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	max(MetricQuantity) as MetricQuantity,
	max(DaysSupply) as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,

	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'5.drug' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
ndc,
PROD_ABBR,
rxdate,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar)
)

		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5532 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",

(

union all


select

	null as DaysSupply,

	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key

from
	final_data

group by
	mastergroupnumber,
	mastergroupname,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  


select
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,

cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar),
groupname,

	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'4.cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
CardholderNumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname,
age,
gender,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar)

union all  
select
	ndc as groupnumber,
	cast(PROD_ABBR as varchar)  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	cast(rxdate as varchar) as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	max(MetricQuantity) as MetricQuantity,
	max(DaysSupply) as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'5.drug' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
ndc,
PROD_ABBR,
rxdate,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar)
)
order by key,type asc

(select

sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",

Null as "Act Mbrs"
from
(select * from ( select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
sum(ingpaid) as ingpaid,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as copay,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid
from final_view
group by short_drugname

)
order by claims desc 
--limit 100
)
)

select
drug,
claims,
null as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
null as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from total_data

union all

select 
drug,
claims,
cast(round((cast(claims as float)/cast(t_claims as float))*100, 4) as decimal(10,2)) || ' %'  as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
round(("Amt paid"*100/t_amt_paid),2) || ' %' as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from 
(select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
round(avg(cast(dayssupply as float)),0) as "D/S",
avg(metricquantity) as "Met Qua",
sum(ingpaid) as "Ing Paid",

sum(copay) as "Copay",
round(sum(copay)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Copay",
sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",
round(sum(amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Amt paid",
count(distinct CARDHOLDER_KEY) as "Act Mbrs"  
from
final_view
group by short_drugname
)
cross join (select claims as t_claims,"Amt paid" as t_amt_paid from total_Data)
order by claims desc

with data_filters as (

vw_final_data as (

LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,

sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5532 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),

CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,

CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

groupname "Rx Number",

ndc "NDC",
prod_abbr "Drug Description",

dayssupply "Day Supply",

cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber,

sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
card_number_on_card as card_number_on_card,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
card_number_on_card,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,amt_paid desc

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),    

claims_final as
(select claims.*,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,generic_table,
case when (Claims1.REVERSAL_CODE = 1 OR CLAIMS.REJECT_CODE_1 = 601) AND CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' else 'N' end as RR_flag,
case when CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR in ('Y','C') then 'Y' else 'N' end as P_flag,
case when (CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N') then 'Y' else 'N' end as NR_flag
from 
(select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif
WHERE systemnumber is not null 

 and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5589 and   

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
left join 
(select distinct claim_key,mac_number,benefit_code,batch_Date,claims_counter,claim_Type,diagnosis_code,payment_dir,generic_table,reversal_code
	from cloud_data_warehouse.claims
WHERE meta_Curr_ind = 'Y' 
) claims1
on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key
),

final_Data as (
select distinct 
left(claim_key,8) as "Claim Batch Number",

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3166 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

select 
groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",
AWP "AWP",
UCR "UCR"
from 
(
select
	'' as groupnumber,
	systemname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'0.System' as type,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by 
	systemname,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)
	
	union all 
	
select
	cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	sponsorname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'1.sponsor' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
	sponsornumber,
	sponsorname,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3071 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

select 
groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",
AWP "AWP",
UCR "UCR"
from 
(
select
	'' as groupnumber,
	systemname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'0.System' as type,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by 
	systemname,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)
	
	union all 
	
select
	cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	sponsorname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,

	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
	sponsornumber,
	sponsorname,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)
	
union all


select
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	mastergroupname  as groupname,

	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,

	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'2.mastergroup' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key

from
	final_data

group by
	mastergroupnumber,
	mastergroupname,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  


select
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
	groupname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'3.group' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar),
groupname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,

	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,

from
	final_data
group by
CardholderNumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname,
age,
gender,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar)

union all

	cast(rxdate as varchar) as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	max(MetricQuantity) as MetricQuantity,

	'5.drug' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
ndc,
PROD_ABBR,
rxdate,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar)
)

), 

vw_final_data as (
select
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number as altgroupnumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5518 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number ,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

groupnumber "Rx Date",

ndc "NDC",

drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",

amt_paid "Amount  Paid"

from

cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,

null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,

sum(claims) as Claims,

cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,

claims,
null as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
null as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from total_data

union all

select 
drug,
claims,
cast(round((cast(claims as float)/cast(t_claims as float))*100, 4) as decimal(10,2)) || ' %'  as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
round(("Amt paid"*100/t_amt_paid),2) || ' %' as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from 
(select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
round(avg(cast(dayssupply as float)),0) as "D/S",
avg(metricquantity) as "Met Qua",
sum(ingpaid) as "Ing Paid",
round(sum(ingpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Ing Paid",
sum(copay+amtpaid) as "Total",
round(sum(copay+amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Total",
sum(copay) as "Copay",
round(sum(copay)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Copay",
sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",
round(sum(amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Amt paid",
count(distinct CARDHOLDER_KEY) as "Act Mbrs"  
from
final_view
group by short_drugname
)
cross join (select claims as t_claims,"Amt paid" as t_amt_paid from total_Data)
order by claims desc

_id: TSC_Morales Internal Staff Active Cardholder Listing
SubjectLine: Morales Internal Staff Active Cardholder Listing
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
 
group_term_data as (
select distinct group_number  from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data 
where (group_ter_date IS NULL or group_ter_date = '1801-01-01' or group_ter_date >= (select end_date from data_filters))
),

vw_final_data as (
select distinct
members.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
members.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
members.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
members.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
members.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
members.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
members.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
members.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
alternate_cardholder_number as altcardholdernumber,
cardholder_number || '-' || member_number cardholdernumber,
to_char(date_of_birth,'mm/dd/yyyy') birthdate,
to_char(effective_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  effdate,
to_char(term_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  termdate,
first_name firstname,
last_name lastname,
members.MEMBER_NUMBER,
(case when MEMBER_NUMBER = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS pri_memb,
(CASE WHEN MEMBER_NUMBER <> '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS dependent
from
(select systemnumber, system_name, sponsornumber, sponsor_name, master_group, master_group_name, groupnumber, group_name, cardholder_number, member_number, relationship_code, card_number_on_card, alternate_cardholder_number, last_name, first_name, middle_initial, date_of_birth, sex, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, zip, team, coverage_type, cobra_flag, effective_date, term_date from  subscriptions.vw_member_extract 
where (term_date IS NULL or term_date = '1801-01-01' or term_date > (select end_date from data_filters))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3144 and 
systemnumber is not null ) members
inner join group_term_data on group_term_data.group_number = members.groupnumber
)

select 
groupnumber "Group Numbers",
groupname "Group Names",
team_member "Team Member",
cardholdernumber "Cardholder Number",
altcardholdernumber "Alternate Cardholder Number",
cardholdername "Cardholder Name",
pri_memb "COUNT OF PRIMARY MEMBERS",
dependent "COUNT OF DEPENDENTS",
birthdate "Birth Date",
effdate "Effective Date",
termdate "Term Date"

from 
(
select 
cast(systemnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
systemname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. systemnumber' as type,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
systemnumber, 
systemname,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(groupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
groupnumber, 
groupname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(groupname as varchar) as groupname,
null as team_member,
cardholdernumber as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname as cardholdername,
null as pri_memb,
null as dependent,
cast(birthdate as varchar) as birthdate,
cast(effdate as varchar) as effdate,
cast(termdate as varchar) as effdate,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

)
order by key,type

_id: TSC_NW Allen County Schools Invoice Detail
SubjectLine: NW Allen County Schools Invoice Detail
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 

vw_final_data as (
select
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number as altgroupnumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5623 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number ,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

select 

groupnumber "Rx Date",
groupname "Rx Number",
card_number_on_card "Card Number on Card",
ndc "NDC",
prod_abbr "Drug Description",
claims "Claims",
dayssupply "Day Supply",
MetricQuantity "Metric Quantity",
drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",
Copay "Copay",
amt_paid "Amount  Paid"

from 
(

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(altgroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')' as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
card_number_on_card as card_number_on_card,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
card_number_on_card,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,amt_paid desc

SubjectLine: Northwest Indian Fisheries Commission Invoice Detail
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 

vw_final_data as (
select
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number as altgroupnumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5644 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number ,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

select 

groupnumber "Rx Date",
groupname "Rx Number",
cardholdernumber "Cardholder Number",
ndc "NDC",
prod_abbr "Drug Description",
claims "Claims",
dayssupply "Day Supply",
MetricQuantity "Metric Quantity",
drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",
Copay "Copay",
amt_paid "Amount  Paid"

from 
(

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(altgroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')' as groupname,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
cardholdernumber as cardholdernumber,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
CardholderNumber,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,amt_paid desc

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5527 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,

		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,

		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)
