CLAIMS.patient_pay AS COPAY2 ,
CLAIMS.TAX AS TAX ,
CLAIMS.client_amount_paid AS AMOUNT_PAID ,
CLAIMS.AWP_100_PERCENT AS AWP_100_PERCENT ,
CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT AS UCR_AMOUNT ,
CLAIMS.admin_fee_on_claim AS ADMIN_FEE ,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_FIRST_NAME ,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_LAST_NAME AS PATIENT_LAST_NAME ,
CLAIMS.cardholderbirthdate AS BIRTH_DATE ,
CLAIMS.cardholder_sex AS SEX ,
CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER AS CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ,
CLAIMS.member_relationship_code AS RELATIONSHIP_CODE ,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number AS ALT_GROUP_NUMBER ,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME ,
CLAIMS.MEMBER_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME ,
CLAIMS.DAW_INDICATOR AS DAW_INDICATOR ,
CLAIMS.COMPOUND_CODE AS COMPOUND_CODE ,
CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE AS GENERIC_CODE ,
CASE WHEN CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS DRUG_PREF_IND ,
CLAIMS.gpi_name AS GPI_DESCRIPTION_2 ,
'' AS DISPENSER_TYPE_CODE ,
CLAIMS.PRICE_INDICATOR AS PRICE_INDICATOR,
CLAIMS.amount_applied_to_oop AS OOP,
CLAIMS.PENALTY_AMOUNT AS Penalty_Amount,
CLAIMS.original_claim_key AS N1ClaimKey,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE AS RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD AS CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD

FROM claims
WHERE  ((REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
	   (REJECT_CODE_1 in (601)) or 
	   (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims.date_of_reversal is null AND claims.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R') or
	   (REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND (CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'O' OR (CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR  = 'Y' AND CLAIMS.REVERSAL_CODE = '1'))))
)

SELECT
BatchNumber as "Batch Number",
ClaimNumber as "Claim Number",
CLAIM_KEY AS "CLAIM KEY",
SPONSOR_NUMBER AS "SPONSOR NUMBER",
RIGHT(REPLICATE('0',6) + CAST(NABP_NUMBER AS VARCHAR(6)),6) AS "Pharmacy Number",
RTRIM(PHARMACY_NAME) AS "Pharmacy Name",
RTRIM(STREET_1) AS "Pharmacy Address",
RTRIM(STREET_2) AS "Pharmacy Address2",
RTRIM(CITY) AS "Pharmacy Location City",
STATEABBR AS "Pharmacy Location State",
ZIP AS "Pharmacy Location Zip",
PHONE AS "Pharmacy Telephone Number",
rtrim(FEDERAL_TAX_ID_NUMBER) AS "Federal Tax ID",
RX_NUMBER AS "Prescription Number",
date_part_year(trunc(Rx_Date)) * 10000 + date_part(month,Rx_Date) * 100 + date_part(day,Rx_Date) AS "Date Filled",
RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', 11) + CAST (NDC as varchar(11)), 11) AS "NDC Number",
RTRIM(PROD_ABBR) AS "Drug Description",
CASE NEW_REFILL  WHEN 'N' THEN '0' WHEN 'R' THEN '1' ELSE NEW_REFILL END AS "New/Refill Code",			
METRIC_QUANTITY AS "Metric Quantity",
DAYS_SUPPLY AS "Days Supply",
CASE PRICE_INDICATOR WHEN 'A' THEN '01' WHEN 'B' THEN '05' WHEN 'M' THEN '06' WHEN 'U' THEN '07' ELSE '09' END AS "Basis of Cost Determination", 
PRICE_INDICATOR,
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ING_PAID ELSE ING_PAID END as "Ingredient Cost",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * DISP_FEE ELSE DISP_FEE END as "Dispensing Fee",

CASE 
WHEN substring(N1ClaimKEY ,5,1) <> 'N' and Reject_Code_1 = '0'  -- N1 Paid Claim
THEN COPAY - (SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)
WHEN (N1ClaimKey is NULL OR  SUBSTRING(Claim_Key, 1, 4) = substring(N1ClaimKey, 1, 4))THEN (CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * COPAY ELSE COPAY END) --Normal Claim
WHEN N1ClaimKEY is not null and Reject_Code_1= 601 THEN -- N1 Reversed Claim always 601 Reject Code, not a true reversal
(SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS  WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey)  
end as "Co-Pay Amount",
N1ClaimKey,
COPAY as TestClaimCopay,
(SELECT COPAY FROM cloud_data_warehouse.CLAIMS CLAIMS WHERE CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY = N1ClaimKey) as TestN1Copay,
--- END COPAY LOGIC CHANGES
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' then -1 * DEDUCT_AMT ELSE DEDUCT_AMT END as "Deductible Amount",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * COPAY ELSE COPAY END as "Patient Paid Amount",
'0' AS "Ineligible Member Payment", 
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * TAX ELSE TAX END as "Sales Tax",
-- Calculation if Sponsor has differentials.
CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 Differential_Flag FROM cloud_data_warehouse.sponsor WHERE Sponsor.Sponsor_Number = SPONSOR_NUMBER) = 'Y' THEN 0
        ELSE -- Still negate dollars when needed.
        CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * AMOUNT_PAID ELSE AMOUNT_PAID END END as "Amount Billed",
-- End Special Amount Paid calculation
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * AWP_100_PERCENT ELSE AWP_100_PERCENT END as "Full AWP",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * UCR_AMOUNT ELSE UCR_AMOUNT END as "Usual & Customary Charge",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * ADMIN_FEE ELSE ADMIN_FEE END as "Admin Fee",
RTRIM(PATIENT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient First Name",
RTRIM(PATIENT_LAST_NAME) AS "Patient Last Name",
date_part_year(trunc(Birth_Date))*10000 + date_part(month,Birth_Date)*100 + date_part(day,Birth_Date) AS "Date of Birth",
CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 else 0 END AS "Sex Code",
RTRIM(CARDHOLDER_NUMBER) AS "Cardholder ID Number",
RTRIM(RELATIONSHIP_CODE) AS "Relationship Code",
RTRIM(ALT_GROUP_NUMBER) AS "Group Number",
PATIENT_FIRST_NAME as "Cardholder First Name",
PATIENT_LAST_NAME as "Cardholder Last Name",
CASE DAW_INDICATOR WHEN 'A' THEN '1' WHEN 'B' THEN '2' WHEN 'C' THEN '3' WHEN 'D' THEN '4' WHEN 'E' THEN '5' WHEN 'F' THEN '6' 
				   WHEN 'G' THEN '7' WHEN 'H' THEN '8' WHEN 'I' THEN '9'
				ELSE DAW_INDICATOR END AS "Dispense As Written / Product Selection Code",
DAW_INDICATOR,
COMPOUND_CODE AS "Compound Code",
CASE GENERIC_CODE  WHEN 'M' THEN 5 WHEN 'Y' THEN 3 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'N' THEN 1 WHEN 'O' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS "Drug Type",
PaidorReversalFlag AS "Claim Type",
CASE WHEN DRUG_PREF_IND = 'N' THEN 'N'  ELSE 'Y' END AS "Formulary Flag",
''  as "GCN - Generic Classification Number",
RTRIM(GPI_DESCRIPTION_2) AS "Theraputic Class-AHFS",
--CASE DISPENSER_TYPE_CODE 
--	WHEN 1 THEN 'R'
--	WHEN 2 THEN 'G'
--	WHEN 3 THEN 'O'
--	WHEN 4 THEN 'L'
--	WHEN 5 THEN 'M'
--	WHEN 6 THEN 'B'
--	WHEN 7 THEN 'D'
--	WHEN 8 THEN 'S'
--	WHEN 9 THEN 'A'
--	WHEN 10 THEN 'I'
--	WHEN 11 THEN 'C'
--	WHEN 12 THEN 'P'
--	ELSE 'O'
--END as
DISPENSER_TYPE_CODE as "Pharmacy Type",
DISPENSER_TYPE_CODE,
Reject_Code_1 AS "Reject Code 01",
Reject_Code_2 AS "Reject Code 02",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * Claims_counter ELSE Claims_counter END AS "Claim Counter",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * OOP ELSE OOP END AS "OOP",
CASE WHEN PaidorReversalFlag = 'R' THEN -1 * Penalty_Amount ELSE Penalty_Amount END AS "Penalty_Amount",
date_part_year(trunc(Process_Date))*10000 + date_part(month,Process_Date)*100 + date_part(day,Process_Date) AS "Process Date",
CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD as "Card Number on Card"

Claim_Key, PaidorReversalFlag

		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3901 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

select 
groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",
AWP "AWP",

(
select
	'' as groupnumber,
	systemname  as groupname,

	null as gender,

	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,

	'0.System' as type,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key

group by

select
	cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	sponsorname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,

	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
	sponsornumber,
	sponsorname,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)
	
union all


select
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	mastergroupname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'2.mastergroup' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key

from
	final_data

group by
	mastergroupnumber,
	mastergroupname,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  


select
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
	groupname  as groupname,

union all

	gender as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,

	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'4.cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
CardholderNumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname,
age,
gender,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar)

union all  
select
	ndc as groupnumber,
	cast(PROD_ABBR as varchar)  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	cast(rxdate as varchar) as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	max(MetricQuantity) as MetricQuantity,
	max(DaysSupply) as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'5.drug' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
ndc,
PROD_ABBR,
rxdate,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar)
)
order by key,type asc

		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,

		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,

		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,

		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,

			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))

)

SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))

CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,

CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,

sum(claims) as Claims,

null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,

cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by

cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

from vw_final_data

LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,

SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,

SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3144 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,

CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

SubjectLine: Weekly Electro Prime Group Member Detail
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3918 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

select 
groupnumber "Number",
groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",
NonFormularyClaims "Non-Form",
total  "Total",
copay "Copay",
case when claims = 0 then null else copay/claims end "Avg Copay",
amntpaid  "Amt Paid",
case when claims = 0 then null else amntpaid/claims end "Avg Amt Paid",
AWP "AWP",
UCR "UCR"
from 
(
select
	'' as groupnumber,
	systemname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'0.System' as type,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by 
	systemname,
	cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)
	
	union all 
	
select
	cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	sponsorname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'1.sponsor' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
	sponsornumber,
	sponsorname,
	cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)
	
union all


select
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
	mastergroupname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'2.mastergroup' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key

from
	final_data

group by
	mastergroupnumber,
	mastergroupname,
	cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  


select
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
	groupname  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	null as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'3.group' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar),
groupname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all  

select
	cast(CardholderNumber as varchar) groupnumber,
	lastname || ', ' || firstname  as groupname,
	age as age,
	gender as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	null as MetricQuantity,
	null as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'4.cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
CardholderNumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname,
age,
gender,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber)  as varchar)

union all  
select
	ndc as groupnumber,
	cast(PROD_ABBR as varchar)  as groupname,
	Null as age,
	cast(rxdate as varchar) as gender,
	sum(claims) as claims,
	max(MetricQuantity) as MetricQuantity,
	max(DaysSupply) as DaysSupply,
	sum(GenericClaims) as GenericClaims,
	sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
	sum(AmtPaid+copay) as total,
	sum(copay) as copay,
	sum(AmtPaid) as amntpaid,
	sum(AWP100Pcnt) as AWP,
	sum(UCRAmount) as UCR,
	'5.drug' as type,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar) as key
from
	final_data
group by
ndc,
PROD_ABBR,
rxdate,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || CardholderNumber || ndc)  as varchar)
)
order by key,type asc

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 

vw_final_data as (
select
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,

CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3185 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number ,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

groupnumber "Rx Date",
groupname "Rx Number",
card_number_on_card "Card Number on Card",
ndc "NDC",

claims "Claims",
dayssupply "Day Supply",
MetricQuantity "Metric Quantity",
drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",
Copay "Copay",
amt_paid "Amount  Paid"

from 
(

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,

'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(altgroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')' as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
card_number_on_card as card_number_on_card,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
card_number_on_card,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,amt_paid desc

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
 
group_term_data as (
select distinct group_number  from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data 
where (group_ter_date IS NULL or group_ter_date = '1801-01-01' or group_ter_date >= (select end_date from data_filters))
),

vw_final_data as (
select distinct
members.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
members.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
members.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
members.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
members.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
members.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
members.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
members.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
alternate_cardholder_number as altcardholdernumber,
cardholder_number || '-' || member_number cardholdernumber,
to_char(date_of_birth,'mm/dd/yyyy') birthdate,
to_char(effective_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  effdate,
to_char(term_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  termdate,
first_name firstname,
last_name lastname,
members.MEMBER_NUMBER,
(case when MEMBER_NUMBER = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS pri_memb,
(CASE WHEN MEMBER_NUMBER <> '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS dependent
from
(select systemnumber, system_name, sponsornumber, sponsor_name, master_group, master_group_name, groupnumber, group_name, cardholder_number, member_number, relationship_code, card_number_on_card, alternate_cardholder_number, last_name, first_name, middle_initial, date_of_birth, sex, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, zip, team, coverage_type, cobra_flag, effective_date, term_date from  subscriptions.vw_member_extract 
where (term_date IS NULL or term_date = '1801-01-01' or term_date > (select end_date from data_filters))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3292 and 
systemnumber is not null ) members
inner join group_term_data on group_term_data.group_number = members.groupnumber
)

select 
groupnumber "Group Numbers",
groupname "Group Names",
team_member "Team Member",
cardholdernumber "Cardholder Number",
altcardholdernumber "Alternate Cardholder Number",
cardholdername "Cardholder Name",
pri_memb "COUNT OF PRIMARY MEMBERS",
dependent "COUNT OF DEPENDENTS",
birthdate "Birth Date",
effdate "Effective Date",
termdate "Term Date"

from 
(
select 
cast(systemnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
systemname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. systemnumber' as type,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
systemnumber, 
systemname,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

with data_filters as (

),  

vw_final_data as (
select
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number as altgroupnumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))

and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3186 and  

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number ,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

select 

groupnumber "Rx Date",
groupname "Rx Number",
ClaimKey "Claim Key",
cardholdernumber "Cardholder Number",
ndc "NDC",
prod_abbr "Drug Description",
claims "Claims",
dayssupply "Day Supply",
MetricQuantity "Metric Quantity",
drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",
Copay "Copay",
amt_paid "Amount  Paid"

from 
(

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as claimkey,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as claimkey,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(altgroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')' as groupname,
null as claimkey,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
claimkey as claimkey,
cardholdernumber as cardholdernumber,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
claimkey,
CardholderNumber,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,amt_paid desc

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
 
group_term_data as (
select distinct group_number  from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data 
where (group_ter_date IS NULL or group_ter_date = '1801-01-01' or group_ter_date >= (select end_date from data_filters))
),

vw_final_data as (
select distinct
members.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
members.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
members.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
members.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
members.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
members.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
members.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
members.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
alternate_cardholder_number as altcardholdernumber,
cardholder_number || '-' || member_number cardholdernumber,
to_char(date_of_birth,'mm/dd/yyyy') birthdate,
to_char(effective_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  effdate,
to_char(term_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  termdate,
first_name firstname,
last_name lastname,
members.MEMBER_NUMBER,
(case when MEMBER_NUMBER = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS pri_memb,
(CASE WHEN MEMBER_NUMBER <> '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS dependent
from
(select systemnumber, system_name, sponsornumber, sponsor_name, master_group, master_group_name, groupnumber, group_name, cardholder_number, member_number, relationship_code, card_number_on_card, alternate_cardholder_number, last_name, first_name, middle_initial, date_of_birth, sex, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, zip, team, coverage_type, cobra_flag, effective_date, term_date from  subscriptions.vw_member_extract 
where (term_date IS NULL or term_date = '1801-01-01' or term_date > (select end_date from data_filters))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5554 and 
systemnumber is not null ) members
inner join group_term_data on group_term_data.group_number = members.groupnumber
)

select 
groupnumber "Group Numbers",
groupname "Group Names",
team_member "Team Member",
cardholdernumber "Cardholder Number",
altcardholdernumber "Alternate Cardholder Number",
cardholdername "Cardholder Name",
pri_memb "COUNT OF PRIMARY MEMBERS",
dependent "COUNT OF DEPENDENTS",
birthdate "Birth Date",
effdate "Effective Date",
termdate "Term Date"

from 
(
select 
cast(systemnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
systemname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. systemnumber' as type,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
systemnumber, 
systemname,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(groupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
groupnumber, 
groupname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(groupname as varchar) as groupname,
null as team_member,
cardholdernumber as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname as cardholdername,
null as pri_memb,
null as dependent,
cast(birthdate as varchar) as birthdate,
cast(effdate as varchar) as effdate,
cast(termdate as varchar) as effdate,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

)
order by key,type

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 

vw_final_data as (
select
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number as altgroupnumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3235 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,

SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3242 and  

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)

CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),

)

drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",

null as claim_key,
null as cardholdernumber,

select

sum(claims) as Claims,

cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

select

null as cardholdernumber,

null as prod_abbr,

sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
ClaimKey as claim_key,
cardholdernumber as cardholdernumber,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
claim_key,
cardholdernumber,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,amt_paid desc

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
 
group_term_data as (
select distinct group_number  from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data 
where (group_ter_date IS NULL or group_ter_date = '1801-01-01' or group_ter_date >= (select end_date from data_filters))
),

vw_final_data as (
select distinct
members.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
members.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
members.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
members.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
members.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
members.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
members.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
members.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
alternate_cardholder_number as altcardholdernumber,
cardholder_number || '-' || member_number cardholdernumber,
to_char(date_of_birth,'mm/dd/yyyy') birthdate,
to_char(effective_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  effdate,
to_char(term_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  termdate,
first_name firstname,
last_name lastname,
members.MEMBER_NUMBER,
(case when MEMBER_NUMBER = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS pri_memb,
(CASE WHEN MEMBER_NUMBER <> '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS dependent
from
(select systemnumber, system_name, sponsornumber, sponsor_name, master_group, master_group_name, groupnumber, group_name, cardholder_number, member_number, relationship_code, card_number_on_card, alternate_cardholder_number, last_name, first_name, middle_initial, date_of_birth, sex, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, zip, team, coverage_type, cobra_flag, effective_date, term_date from  subscriptions.vw_member_extract 
where (term_date IS NULL or term_date = '1801-01-01' or term_date > (select end_date from data_filters))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5589 and 
systemnumber is not null ) members
inner join group_term_data on group_term_data.group_number = members.groupnumber
)

select 
groupnumber "Group Numbers",
groupname "Group Names",
team_member "Team Member",
cardholdernumber "Cardholder Number",
altcardholdernumber "Alternate Cardholder Number",
cardholdername "Cardholder Name",
pri_memb "COUNT OF PRIMARY MEMBERS",
dependent "COUNT OF DEPENDENTS",
birthdate "Birth Date",
effdate "Effective Date",
termdate "Term Date"

from 
(
select 
cast(systemnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
systemname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. systemnumber' as type,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
systemnumber, 
systemname,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(groupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
groupnumber, 
groupname,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(substring(groupnumber,1,len(groupnumber)-3)|| '-' || substring(groupnumber,len(groupnumber)-2,3) as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(groupname as varchar) as groupname,
null as team_member,
cardholdernumber as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
lastname || ', ' || firstname as cardholdername,
null as pri_memb,
null as dependent,
cast(birthdate as varchar) as birthdate,
cast(effdate as varchar) as effdate,
cast(termdate as varchar) as effdate,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

)
order by key,type

select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 

vw_final_data as (
select
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number as altgroupnumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3200 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number ,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

select 

groupnumber "Rx Date",
groupname "Rx Number",
cardholdernumber "Cardholder Number",
ndc "NDC",
prod_abbr "Drug Description",
claims "Claims",
dayssupply "Day Supply",
MetricQuantity "Metric Quantity",
drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",
Copay "Copay",
amt_paid "Amount  Paid"

from 
(

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
mastergroupnumber, 
mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(altgroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')' as groupname,
null as cardholdernumber,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
cardholdernumber as cardholdernumber,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
CardholderNumber,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

)
order by key,type,amt_paid desc

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
 
group_term_data as (
select distinct group_number  from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data 
where (group_ter_date IS NULL or group_ter_date = '1801-01-01' or group_ter_date >= (select end_date from data_filters))
),

vw_final_data as (
select distinct
members.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
members.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
members.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
members.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
members.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
members.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
members.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
members.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
alternate_cardholder_number as altcardholdernumber,
cardholder_number || '-' || member_number cardholdernumber,
to_char(date_of_birth,'mm/dd/yyyy') birthdate,
to_char(effective_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  effdate,
to_char(term_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')  termdate,
first_name firstname,
last_name lastname,
members.MEMBER_NUMBER,
(case when MEMBER_NUMBER = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS pri_memb,
(CASE WHEN MEMBER_NUMBER <> '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) AS dependent
from
(select systemnumber, system_name, sponsornumber, sponsor_name, master_group, master_group_name, groupnumber, group_name, cardholder_number, member_number, relationship_code, card_number_on_card, alternate_cardholder_number, last_name, first_name, middle_initial, date_of_birth, sex, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, zip, team, coverage_type, cobra_flag, effective_date, term_date from  subscriptions.vw_member_extract 
where (term_date IS NULL or term_date = '1801-01-01' or term_date > (select end_date from data_filters))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 5569 and 
systemnumber is not null ) members
inner join group_term_data on group_term_data.group_number = members.groupnumber
)

select 
groupnumber "Group Numbers",
groupname "Group Names",
team_member "Team Member",
cardholdernumber "Cardholder Number",
altcardholdernumber "Alternate Cardholder Number",
cardholdername "Cardholder Name",
pri_memb "COUNT OF PRIMARY MEMBERS",
dependent "COUNT OF DEPENDENTS",
birthdate "Birth Date",
effdate "Effective Date",
termdate "Term Date"

from 
(
select 
cast(systemnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
systemname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. systemnumber' as type,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
systemnumber, 
systemname,
cast((systemnumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as team_member,
'Active Members:' as cardholdernumber,
null as altcardholdernumber,
cast(sum(pri_memb+dependent) as varchar) as cardholdername,
sum(pri_memb) as pri_memb,
sum(dependent) as dependent,
null as birthdate,
null as effdate,
null as termdate,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by

CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,

CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,

sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,

SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,

CLAIMS.alt_group_number,

CLAIMS.NDC,

)

left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,

rxnumber,

SubjectLine: YTD 3067 Top 25 Therapeutic Class by Cost
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),  

final_data as (
SELECT	claims.system_link as systemlink,
		claims.systemnumber as systemnumber,
		claims.sponsornumber as sponsornumber,
		claims.master_group as mastergroupnumber,
		claims.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.therapeutic_class_name,
		claims.therapeutic_class_category,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,  
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CASE drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		Count(distinct LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)) as ActiveMembers,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'N' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as TradeClaims
		
		FROM	
		(select *, master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
		where claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'N' and claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
			
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3067 and 
			
			process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
			) claims
		group by 
		claims.system_link,
		claims.systemnumber,
		claims.sponsornumber,
		claims.master_group,
		claims.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.therapeutic_class_name,
		claims.therapeutic_class_category

		
)

select 
product_num as " ",
product as "product",
Claims,
Total,
amtpaid as "Amt Paid",
UCRAmount as UCR,
genericclaims as "Generic Claims",
concat(round(genericclaims*100/claims,2),' %') as "Generic Claims %",
TradeClaims as "Trade Claims",
concat(round(TradeClaims*100/claims,2),' %') as "Trade Claims %",
NonFormularyClaims as "Non-Form Claims",
concat(round(NonFormularyClaims*100/claims,2),' %') as "Non-Form Claims %",
ActiveMembers as "Member Utilizing",
round(Total/activemembers,2) as "PM/PM",
round(claims/activemembers,2) as "PM/PM avg"

from 
(
select 
null as product_num,
'Total' as product,
sum(Claims) as claims,
sum(amtpaid+copay) as Total,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid,
sum(UCRAmount) UCRAmount,
sum(genericclaims) as genericclaims,
sum(TradeClaims) as TradeClaims,
sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
sum(ActiveMembers) ActiveMembers,
'0.Total' as type,
cast(0 as varchar) as key

from final_Data


union all

select 
therapeutic_class_category as product_num,
therapeutic_class_name as product,
sum(Claims) as claims,
sum(amtpaid+copay) as Total,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid,
sum(UCRAmount) UCRAmount,
sum(genericclaims) as genericclaims,
sum(TradeClaims) as TradeClaims,
sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
sum(ActiveMembers) ActiveMembers,
'1.TC' as type,
cast(therapeutic_class_category as varchar) as key

from final_Data
group by therapeutic_class_category,
therapeutic_class_name,
cast(therapeutic_class_category as varchar)

union all 

select
null as product_num,
prod_abbreviation as product,
sum(Claims) as claims,
sum(amtpaid+copay) as Total,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid,
sum(UCRAmount) UCRAmount,
sum(genericclaims) as genericclaims,
sum(TradeClaims) as TradeClaims,
sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
sum(ActiveMembers) ActiveMembers,
'2.prod' as type,
cast(prod_abbreviation as varchar) as key

from final_Data
group by 
prod_abbreviation,
cast(prod_abbreviation as varchar)
)
order by claims desc,key,type

_id: TSC_Year to Date Graber Post Claims Summary by Formulary
SubjectLine: Year to Date Graber Post Claims Summary by Formulary
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),   

final_data as (
SELECT 
claims.system_link,
claims.systemnumber,
claims.system_name as systemname,
claims.sponsor_name as sponsorname,
claims.sponsornumber,
claims.master_group as mastergroupnumber,
claims.master_Group_name as mastergroupname,
claims.group_name as groupname,
claims.groupnumber,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
Case CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG when 'M' then 'Mail'
				when 'D' then 'DMR'
				else 'Retail' end as MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,
case grp.FORMULARY_STRUCTURE  
			WHEN '4' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '4T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '4T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '4T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '4T - Tier 4 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '4T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '4T - Preferred' 
				END)
			when '3' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '3T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '3T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '3T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '3T - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '3T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '3T - Preferred' 
				END)
			when 'M' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then 'M - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then 'M - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then 'M - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then 'M - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then 'M - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else 'MT - Preferred' 
				END) end as FormularyGroup,
COUNT(*) AS Claims,
SUM(client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid, 
SUM(patient_pay) AS Copay,
SUM(client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
SUM(TAX) AS Tax,
SUM(client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
SUM(UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
SUM(AWP_100_PERCENT) AS AWP100Pcnt,
COUNT( DISTINCT LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)) AS ActiveMembers
from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif) claims
WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'Y'

and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3154 and    


process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims

left join 
(select group_number, formulary_structure from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') grp
on claims.groupnumber = grp.group_number

group by
claims.system_link,
claims.systemnumber,
claims.system_name,
claims.sponsor_name,
claims.sponsornumber,
claims.master_group,
claims.master_Group_name,
claims.group_name,
claims.groupnumber,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
Case CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG when 'M' then 'Mail'
				when 'D' then 'DMR'
				else 'Retail' end,
case grp.FORMULARY_STRUCTURE  
			WHEN '4' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '4T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '4T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '4T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '4T - Tier 4 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '4T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'

			when '3' then

					when 'G' then '3T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '3T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '3T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '3T - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '3T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '3T - Preferred'

			when 'M' then

					when 'P' then 'M - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then 'M - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then 'M - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then 'M - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else 'MT - Preferred'

SELECT	claims.system_link as systemlink,

		claims.master_group as mastergroupnumber,
		claims.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.therapeutic_class_name,

		Count(distinct LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)) as ActiveMembers,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'N' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as TradeClaims
		
		FROM	
		(select *, master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
		where claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'N' and claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
			
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3059 and 
			
			process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
			) claims
		group by 
		claims.system_link,
		claims.systemnumber,
		claims.sponsornumber,
		claims.master_group,
		claims.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.therapeutic_class_name,
		claims.therapeutic_class_category

		
)

Claims,
Total,

from 
(

)

_id: TSC_Year to Date Shelby Materials Top 25 by Amount Paid
SubjectLine: Year to Date Shelby Materials Top 25 by Amount Paid
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),  

final_view as
(select * from subscriptions.vw_subs_claims_drug_summary
where systemnumber is not null 
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3071 and 

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
),

total_data as
(select 
'Total' as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
Null as "D/S",
Null as "Met Qua",
sum(ingpaid) as "Ing Paid",
round(sum(ingpaid)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Ing Paid",
sum(Total) as "Total",
round(sum(Total)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Total",
sum(copay) as "Copay",
round(sum(copay)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Copay",
sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",
round(sum(amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Amt paid",
Null as "Act Mbrs"
from
(select * from ( select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
sum(ingpaid) as ingpaid,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as copay,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid
from final_view
group by short_drugname

)
order by claims desc 
--limit 100
)
)

select
drug,
claims,
null as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
null as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from total_data

union all

select 
drug,
claims,
cast(round((cast(claims as float)/cast(t_claims as float))*100, 4) as decimal(10,2)) || ' %'  as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
round(("Amt paid"*100/t_amt_paid),2) || ' %' as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from 
(select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
round(avg(cast(dayssupply as float)),0) as "D/S",
avg(metricquantity) as "Met Qua",
sum(ingpaid) as "Ing Paid",
round(sum(ingpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Ing Paid",
sum(copay+amtpaid) as "Total",
round(sum(copay+amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Total",
sum(copay) as "Copay",
round(sum(copay)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Copay",
sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",
round(sum(amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Amt paid",
count(distinct CARDHOLDER_KEY) as "Act Mbrs"  
from
final_view
group by short_drugname
)
cross join (select claims as t_claims,"Amt paid" as t_amt_paid from total_Data)
order by claims desc
--limit 100

_id: TSC_Year to Date Greene County Top 25 by Amount Paid
SubjectLine: Year to Date Greene County Top 25 by Amount Paid
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),  

final_view as
(select * from subscriptions.vw_subs_claims_drug_summary
where systemnumber is not null 
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3166 and 

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
),

total_data as
(select 
'Total' as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
Null as "D/S",
Null as "Met Qua",
sum(ingpaid) as "Ing Paid",
round(sum(ingpaid)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Ing Paid",
sum(Total) as "Total",
round(sum(Total)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Total",
sum(copay) as "Copay",
round(sum(copay)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Copay",
sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",
round(sum(amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Amt paid",
Null as "Act Mbrs"
from
(select * from ( select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
sum(ingpaid) as ingpaid,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as copay,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid
from final_view
group by short_drugname

)
order by claims desc 
--limit 100
)
)

select
drug,
claims,
null as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
null as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from total_data

union all

select 
drug,
claims,
cast(round((cast(claims as float)/cast(t_claims as float))*100, 4) as decimal(10,2)) || ' %'  as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
round(("Amt paid"*100/t_amt_paid),2) || ' %' as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from 
(select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
round(avg(cast(dayssupply as float)),0) as "D/S",
avg(metricquantity) as "Met Qua",
sum(ingpaid) as "Ing Paid",
round(sum(ingpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Ing Paid",
sum(copay+amtpaid) as "Total",
round(sum(copay+amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Total",
sum(copay) as "Copay",
round(sum(copay)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Copay",
sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",
round(sum(amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Amt paid",
count(distinct CARDHOLDER_KEY) as "Act Mbrs"  
from
final_view
group by short_drugname
)
cross join (select claims as t_claims,"Amt paid" as t_amt_paid from total_Data)
order by claims desc
--limit 100

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as sponsorname,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP  as MasterGroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as mastergroupname,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER AS GroupNumber,
		CLAIMS.group_name as GROUPNAME,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3154 and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

select

groupname  "Sponsor/Group/Cardholder",
age  "Age",
gender  "Gender",
claims,
MetricQuantity "Met Qua",
DaysSupply "D/S",
GenericClaims "Generic Claims",

SubjectLine: Year to Date Shelby Materials Claims Summary by Formulary
Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),   

final_data as (
SELECT 
claims.system_link,
claims.systemnumber,
claims.system_name as systemname,
claims.sponsor_name as sponsorname,
claims.sponsornumber,
claims.master_group as mastergroupnumber,
claims.master_Group_name as mastergroupname,
claims.group_name as groupname,
claims.groupnumber,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
Case CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG when 'M' then 'Mail'
				when 'D' then 'DMR'
				else 'Retail' end as MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,
case grp.FORMULARY_STRUCTURE  
			WHEN '4' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '4T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '4T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '4T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '4T - Tier 4 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '4T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '4T - Preferred' 
				END)
			when '3' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '3T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '3T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '3T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '3T - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '3T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '3T - Preferred' 
				END)
			when 'M' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then 'M - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then 'M - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then 'M - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then 'M - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then 'M - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else 'MT - Preferred' 
				END) end as FormularyGroup,
COUNT(*) AS Claims,
SUM(client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid, 
SUM(patient_pay) AS Copay,
SUM(client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
SUM(TAX) AS Tax,
SUM(client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
SUM(UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
SUM(AWP_100_PERCENT) AS AWP100Pcnt,
COUNT( DISTINCT LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)) AS ActiveMembers
from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif) claims
WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'Y'

and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3071 and    


process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims

left join 
(select group_number, formulary_structure from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') grp
on claims.groupnumber = grp.group_number

group by
claims.system_link,
claims.systemnumber,
claims.system_name,
claims.sponsor_name,
claims.sponsornumber,
claims.master_group,
claims.master_Group_name,
claims.group_name,
claims.groupnumber,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
Case CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG when 'M' then 'Mail'
				when 'D' then 'DMR'
				else 'Retail' end,
case grp.FORMULARY_STRUCTURE  
			WHEN '4' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '4T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '4T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '4T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '4T - Tier 4 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '4T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'

					when 'P' then '3T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '3T - Tier 3 - Preferred'

					when 'O' then '3T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'

					when 'G' then '3T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '3T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '3T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '3T - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '3T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '3T - Preferred'

					when 'P' then 'M - Tier 2 - Preferred'

		where claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'N' and claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'D'

)
