Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),   

final_data as (
SELECT 
claims.system_link,
claims.systemnumber,
claims.system_name as systemname,
claims.sponsor_name as sponsorname,
claims.sponsornumber,
claims.master_group as mastergroupnumber,
claims.master_Group_name as mastergroupname,
claims.group_name as groupname,
claims.groupnumber,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
Case CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG when 'M' then 'Mail'
				when 'D' then 'DMR'
				else 'Retail' end as MAIL_ORDER_FLAG,
case grp.FORMULARY_STRUCTURE  
			WHEN '4' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '4T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '4T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '4T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '4T - Tier 4 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '4T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '4T - Preferred' 
				END)
			when '3' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '3T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '3T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '3T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '3T - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '3T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '3T - Preferred' 
				END)
			when 'M' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then 'M - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then 'M - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then 'M - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then 'M - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then 'M - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else 'MT - Preferred' 
				END) end as FormularyGroup,
COUNT(*) AS Claims,
SUM(client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid, 
SUM(patient_pay) AS Copay,
SUM(client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
SUM(TAX) AS Tax,
SUM(client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
SUM(UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
SUM(AWP_100_PERCENT) AS AWP100Pcnt,
COUNT( DISTINCT LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)) AS ActiveMembers
from 
(select * from (select *,master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif) claims
WHERE CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'Y'

and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3059 and    


process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims

left join 
(select group_number, formulary_structure from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') grp
on claims.groupnumber = grp.group_number

group by
claims.system_link,
claims.systemnumber,
claims.system_name,
claims.sponsor_name,
claims.sponsornumber,
claims.master_group,
claims.master_Group_name,
claims.group_name,
claims.groupnumber,
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
Case CLAIMS.MAIL_ORDER_FLAG when 'M' then 'Mail'
				when 'D' then 'DMR'
				else 'Retail' end,
case grp.FORMULARY_STRUCTURE  
			WHEN '4' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '4T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '4T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '4T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '4T - Tier 4 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '4T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '4T - Preferred' 
				END)
			when '3' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then '3T - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then '3T - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then '3T - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then '3T - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then '3T - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else '3T - Preferred' 
				END)
			when 'M' then 
				(CASE claims.drug_pref_indicator 
					when 'G' then 'M - Tier 1 - Generic'
					when 'P' then 'M - Tier 2 - Preferred'
					when 'B' then 'M - Tier 3 - Preferred'
					when 'N' then 'M - Tier 3 - Non-Preferred'
					when 'O' then 'M - Tier 2 - Other Preferred'
					else 'MT - Preferred' 
				END) end
)

select 
groupnumber as "Formulary Type",
claims,
ingpaid as "Ing Paid",
avgingpaid as "Avg Ing Paid",
disptax as "Disp - Tax",
avgdisptax as "Avg Disp - Tax",
avgtotal as "Total",
copay as "Copay",
avgcopay as "Avg Copay",
amtpaid as "Amt Paid",

avg_ucr as "Avg UCR",
ActiveMembers as "Mbrs"

from

	'Total:' as groupnumber,

select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),  

final_view as
(select * from subscriptions.vw_subs_claims_drug_summary
where systemnumber is not null 
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3057 and 

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
),

total_data as
(select 
'Total' as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
Null as "D/S",
Null as "Met Qua",
sum(ingpaid) as "Ing Paid",
round(sum(ingpaid)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Ing Paid",
sum(Total) as "Total",
round(sum(Total)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Total",
sum(copay) as "Copay",
round(sum(copay)/sum(claims)  , 2) as "AVG Copay",
sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",
round(sum(amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Amt paid",
Null as "Act Mbrs"
from
(select * from ( select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
sum(ingpaid) as ingpaid,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as copay,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid
from final_view
group by short_drugname

)
order by claims desc 
--limit 100
)
)

select
drug,
claims,
null as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
null as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from total_data

union all

select 
drug,
claims,
cast(round((cast(claims as float)/cast(t_claims as float))*100, 4) as decimal(10,2)) || ' %'  as "Claims % Total",
"D/S",
"Met Qua",
round("Ing Paid",0) "Ing Paid",
"AVG Ing Paid",
round("Total",0) "Total",
"AVG Total",
"Copay",
"AVG Copay",
round("Amt paid",0) "Amt paid",
round(("Amt paid"*100/t_amt_paid),2) || ' %' as "Amt paid % Total",
"AVG Amt paid",
"Act Mbrs"
from 
(select 
short_drugname as drug,
sum(claims) as claims,
round(avg(cast(dayssupply as float)),0) as "D/S",
avg(metricquantity) as "Met Qua",
sum(ingpaid) as "Ing Paid",
round(sum(ingpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Ing Paid",
sum(copay+amtpaid) as "Total",
round(sum(copay+amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Total",
sum(copay) as "Copay",
round(sum(copay)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Copay",
sum(amtpaid) as "Amt paid",
round(sum(amtpaid)/sum(claims) , 2) as "AVG Amt paid",
count(distinct CARDHOLDER_KEY) as "Act Mbrs"  
from
final_view
group by short_drugname
)
cross join (select claims as t_claims,"Amt paid" as t_amt_paid from total_Data)
order by claims desc
--limit 100

select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 

vw_final_data as (
select
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER as GroupNumber,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME as GROUPNAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME as SystemName,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER as SponsorNumber,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME as SponsorName,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP as mastergroupnumber,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number as altgroupnumber,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY as ClaimKey,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) as CardholderKey,
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0) as DrugKey,
to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number card_number_on_card,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
sum(1) as claims,
sum(claims.total_drug_cost) as drugcost,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) as AmtPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) as Copay,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) as DispFee,
SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) as IngPaid,
SUM(CLAIMS.ucr_amount) as UCRAmount,
SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) as MetricQuantity,
SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) as DaysSupply,
SUM(ucr_amount) as ing_billed
from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
WHERE ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3270 and process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
GROUP BY
CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
CLAIMS.GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SYSTEM_NAME,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
CLAIMS.alt_group_number,
CLAIMS.CLAIM_KEY,
LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0),
LPAD(claims.ndc_type_code || lpad(claims.ndc,11,0), 15,0),
CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
CLAIMS.card_number_on_card || ' - ' || claims.member_number ,
CLAIMS.NDC,
CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number 
)

select 

groupnumber "Rx Date",
groupname "Rx Number",
card_number_on_card "Card Number on Card",
ndc "NDC",
prod_abbr "Drug Description",
claims "Claims",
dayssupply "Day Supply",
MetricQuantity "Metric Quantity",
drugcost "Retail Cost",
total "Total Cost",
Copay "Copay",
amt_paid "Amount  Paid"

from 
(

select 
cast(sponsornumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
sponsorname as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'1. sponsornumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
sponsornumber, 
sponsorname,
cast((sponsornumber)  as varchar)

union all

select 
cast(mastergroupnumber as varchar) as groupnumber,
mastergroupname as groupname,
null as card_number_on_card,
null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,

sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'2. mastergroupnumber' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar) as key

group by

mastergroupname,
cast((sponsornumber || mastergroupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select

groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')' as groupname,

null as ndc,
null as prod_abbr,
sum(claims) as Claims,
null as dayssupply,
null as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'3.group' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data
group by 
altgroupnumber, 
groupname || ' (' || groupnumber || ')',
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)

union all 

select 
cast(RxDate as varchar) as groupnumber,
cast(rxnumber as varchar) as groupname,
card_number_on_card as card_number_on_card,
left(ndc,5) || '-' || substring(ndc,6,4) || '-' || right(ndc,3) as ndc,
prod_abbr as prod_abbr,
null as Claims,
max(dayssupply) as dayssupply,
max(metricquantity) as metricquantity,
sum(ing_billed) as drugcost,
sum(copay+amtpaid) as total,
sum(copay) as Copay,
--sum(drugcost)-sum(dispfee+tax) as drugcost,
sum(amtpaid) as amt_paid,
'4.Cardholder' as type,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar) as key
from vw_final_data

group by 
cast(RxDate as varchar),
rxnumber,
card_number_on_card,
ndc,
prod_abbr,
cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber || cardholdernumber)  as varchar)

with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-7) as start_date, 
date(DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)-1) as end_date
), 
final_Data as (
SELECT  
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER as SystemNumber,
		CLAIMS.system_name as systemname,

		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,

		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,

		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity,

	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3962 and mastergroupnumber in ( 88458,88459,88460,88461) and 
	process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
	GROUP BY
		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number,
		CLAIMS.RX_DATE,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,
		CLAIMS.PROCESS_DATE,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX,
		claims.cardholderbirthdate,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.ndc,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex
)

claims,

CardholderNumber,

Query:
with data_filters as (
select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
),  

final_data as (
SELECT	claims.system_link as systemlink,
		claims.systemnumber as systemnumber,
		claims.sponsornumber as sponsornumber,
		claims.master_group as mastergroupnumber,
		claims.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.therapeutic_class_name,
		claims.therapeutic_class_category,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,  
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CASE drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		Count(distinct LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)) as ActiveMembers,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'N' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as TradeClaims
		
		FROM	
		(select *, master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
		where claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'N' and claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
			
			and systemnumber = 163 and sponsornumber = 3154 and 
			
			process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
			) claims
		group by 
		claims.system_link,
		claims.systemnumber,
		claims.sponsornumber,
		claims.master_group,
		claims.prod_abbreviation,
		claims.therapeutic_class_name,
		claims.therapeutic_class_category

		
)

select 
product_num as " ",
product as "product",
Claims,
Total,
amtpaid as "Amt Paid",
UCRAmount as UCR,
genericclaims as "Generic Claims",
concat(round(genericclaims*100/claims,2),' %') as "Generic Claims %",
TradeClaims as "Trade Claims",
concat(round(TradeClaims*100/claims,2),' %') as "Trade Claims %",
NonFormularyClaims as "Non-Form Claims",
concat(round(NonFormularyClaims*100/claims,2),' %') as "Non-Form Claims %",
ActiveMembers as "Member Utilizing",
round(Total/activemembers,2) as "PM/PM",
round(claims/activemembers,2) as "PM/PM avg"

from 
(
select 
null as product_num,
'Total' as product,
sum(Claims) as claims,
sum(amtpaid+copay) as Total,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid,
sum(UCRAmount) UCRAmount,
sum(genericclaims) as genericclaims,
sum(TradeClaims) as TradeClaims,
sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
sum(ActiveMembers) ActiveMembers,
'0.Total' as type,
cast(0 as varchar) as key

from final_Data


union all

select 
therapeutic_class_category as product_num,
therapeutic_class_name as product,
sum(Claims) as claims,
sum(amtpaid+copay) as Total,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid,
sum(UCRAmount) UCRAmount,
sum(genericclaims) as genericclaims,
sum(TradeClaims) as TradeClaims,
sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
sum(ActiveMembers) ActiveMembers,
'1.TC' as type,
cast(therapeutic_class_category as varchar) as key

from final_Data
group by therapeutic_class_category,
therapeutic_class_name,
cast(therapeutic_class_category as varchar)

union all 

select
null as product_num,
prod_abbreviation as product,
sum(Claims) as claims,
sum(amtpaid+copay) as Total,
sum(amtpaid) as amtpaid,
sum(UCRAmount) UCRAmount,
sum(genericclaims) as genericclaims,
sum(TradeClaims) as TradeClaims,
sum(NonFormularyClaims) as NonFormularyClaims,
sum(ActiveMembers) ActiveMembers,
'2.prod' as type,
cast(prod_abbreviation as varchar) as key

from final_Data
group by 
prod_abbreviation,
cast(prod_abbreviation as varchar)
)
order by claims desc,key,type

     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CLAIMS_COUNTER
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN -1
	END as  CLAIMS_COUNTER,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'Y' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'Y'
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR
     END as  CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR,

--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then NULL
--     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then NULL 
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN NULL
--     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN NULL
--     END 
null as date_of_reversal,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 'P' 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 
        CASE WHEN ReJECT_CODE_1 = 601 THEN 'R'  WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN (REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'J') THEN 'O' ELSE 'U' END
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 'P'
    WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN CASE WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 650 THEN 'R' WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 = 0 THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END
    END as PaidorReversalFlag,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 1
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650)	THEN 0
     END as  AdjClaimCount,
case when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) and claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then 0.00 
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (601) then 0   
     when REJECT_CODE_1 in (0) AND claims_final.date_of_reversal is null AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' then claims_final.client_amount_paid
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) AND claims_final.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'R' THEN 0.00
     WHEN REJECT_CODE_1 in (650) THEN 0
     END as  AdjAmountPaid

select date(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)) as start_date,
date(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1) as end_date
), 


top_gpi as
(
select
claims.gpi,
count(*) as claims,
sum(claims.client_amount_paid) as amtpaid,
sum(claims.patient_pay) as copay,
count(distinct LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0)) as count
from 
(select *, master_group as mastergroupnumber from subscriptions.mv_claims_financial_wdif claims
where claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'N' and claims.current_claim_indicator <> 'D'
and systemnumber = 82 and sponsornumber = 436 and 

process_date BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_Date from data_filters)
) claims
group by claims.gpi
order by claims desc
limit 10
),

final_data as(
select
claims.system_link as systemlink,
claims.systemnumber as systemnumber,
claims.sponsornumber as sponsornumber,
claims.master_group as mastergroupnumber,
claims.gpi,
claims.gpi_name,
claims.prod_abbreviation,
case when claims.mail_order_flag = 'D' then 'R' when claims.mail_order_flag = 'M' then 'M' else 'R' end as mailorderflag,
sum(case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then 1 when claims.generic_code = 'B' then 1 else 0 end) as genericclaims,
sum(case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then claims.client_amount_paid when claims.generic_code = 'B' then claims.client_amount_paid else 0 end) as genericamtpaid,
sum(case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then claims.patient_pay when claims.generic_code = 'B' then claims.patient_pay else 0 end) as genericcopay,
sum(case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then claims.metric_quantity when claims.generic_code = 'B' then claims.metric_quantity else 0 end) as genericmetricquantity,
sum( case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then claims.days_supply when claims.generic_code = 'B' then claims.days_supply else 0 end) as genericdayssupply,
0 as genericactivemembers,
sum(case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then 0 when claims.generic_code = 'B' then 0 else 1 end) as tradeclaims,
sum(case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then 0 when claims.generic_code = 'B' then 0 else claims.client_amount_paid end) as tradeamtpaid,
sum(case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then 0 when claims.generic_code = 'B' then 0 else claims.patient_pay end) as tradecopay,
sum(case when claims.generic_code = 'Y' then 0 when claims.generic_code = 'B' then 0 else claims.metric_quantity end) as trademetricquantity,

CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
claims.member_birth_date as birthdate,
claims.member_relationship_code as relationshipcode,
claims.card_id_sent_from_pharm,
claims.alt_group_number,
claims1.network_number,

claims.member_sex as sex,

on claims.claim_key = claims1.claim_key

CLAIMS.system_name,
CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,

with data_filters as (
select to_char(date_trunc('month',current_date)-interval '1 month','yyyy-mm-dd') as start_date,
to_char(date_trunc('month',current_date)-interval '1 day','yyyy-mm-dd') as end_date)
,CardholderData as (
 SELECT
  grp.SYSTEM_LINK,  
  grp.SYSTEM_NUMBER,  
  grp.SYSTEM_NAME,  
  grp.SPONSOR_NUMBER,  
  grp.SPONSOR_NAME,  
  grp.MASTER_GROUP,  
  grp.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,  
  grp.GROUP_NUMBER,  
  grp.GROUP_NAME,  
  SUBSTRING(grp.ALT_GROUP_NUMBER, 1, 3)AS SiteCode,  
  ove.USER as Name,  
  ove.USER,   
  ove.REASON,   
  ove.REASON_CODE,  
  ove.PRIOR_AUTHORIZATION,  
  ove.ENTER_DATE,  
  cd.FIRST_NAME,  
  cd.LAST_NAME,  
  cd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  
  cd.MEMBER_NUMBER,  
  gpi.GPI,  
  gpi.GPI_DESCRIPTION,  
  ove.EFFECTIVE_DATE,  
  ove.TERMINATION_DATE,  
  ove.TYPE_CODE ,
  SUBSTRING(grp.ALT_GROUP_NUMBER, 4, 3) as Diagnosis
from 
(select grp_1,cardholder_key,last_name,first_name,eff_date_1,ter_date_1,cardholder_number,member_number,SPON_NUMBER 
from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') as cd
inner join 
(
select group_number,ALT_GROUP_NUMBER, group_ter_date,sponsor_number,
SYSTEM_LINK,  
SYSTEM_NUMBER,  
SYSTEM_NAME,  
SPONSOR_NAME,  
MASTER_GROUP,  
MASTER_GROUP_NAME,  
GROUP_NAME from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data  
where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') grp
on grp.group_number =cd.grp_1 and  grp.sponsor_number=cd.SPON_NUMBER
left join 
(select "user" ,reason ,reason_code ,prior_authorization ,enter_date ,
effective_date ,termination_date ,type_code ,cardholder_number ,member_number ,sponsor ,gpi 
from cloud_data_warehouse.overrides where meta_curr_ind ='Y') as ove
    ON cd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER = ove.cardholder_number   
    AND cd.MEMBER_NUMBER = ove.MEMBER_NUMBER   
    AND cd.SPON_NUMBER = ove.SPONSOR
inner join 
(select gpi,gpi_description from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data  where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') as gpi
on gpi.GPI = ove.GPI
WHERE   
-- if @OverrideReportType = 'A'  
(ove.EFFECTIVE_DATE <= (select start_date from data_filters)) AND (ove.TERMINATION_DATE IS NULL OR ove.TERMINATION_DATE >= (select end_date from data_filters)) AND grp.SYSTEM_NUMBER = 162 and grp.SPONSOR_NUMBER =1291  
-- if @OverrideReportType = 'E'  ->"eneter date overrides"
--ove.ENTER_DATE BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) and (select end_date from data_filters)  AND grp.SYSTEM_NUMBER = 162 and grp.SPONSOR_NUMBER =1291
)
,
OVERRIDES_T_C_DESC as(select type_code ,type_code_description

final_query as

  Cdh.SPONSOR_NUMBER as SponsorNumber ,

  Cdh.MASTER_GROUP_NAME as MasterGroupName,  
  Cdh.GROUP_NUMBER as GroupNumber ,  
  Cdh.GROUP_NAME as GroupName,  
  Cdh.SiteCode ,  
  Cdh."Name" as UserName ,  
  Cdh."USER" as PDMI_User,  
  Cdh.Reason ,
  Cdh.ENTER_DATE as TimeEntered ,  
  Cdh.FIRST_NAME as PatientFirstName ,  
  Cdh.LAST_NAME as PatientLastName ,  
  Cdh.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER as PatientID ,  
  Cdh.MEMBER_NUMBER as MemberNumber,  
  Cdh.PRIOR_AUTHORIZATION as PriorAuth,  
  Cdh.REASON_CODE as ReasonCode,  
  Cdh.GPI,  
  Cdh.GPI_DESCRIPTION as GPIDescription,  
  Cdh.EFFECTIVE_DATE as EffectiveDate,  
  Cdh.TERMINATION_DATE as TermDate,  
  1 as Claims,  
  Cdh.TYPE_CODE ,  
  Cdh.Diagnosis as Diagnosis,  
  otcd.TYPE_CODE_DESCRIPTION
  from CardholderData as Cdh
  left join OVERRIDES_T_C_DESC as otcd
  on otcd.TYPE_CODE = Cdh.TYPE_CODE),
  OVER_003_001NS as (
  select null as "User",null as "PDMI User", SystemLink as "GPI",
 null as "GPI Description",null as "Type Code",null as "Enter Date",null as "Cardholder",
count(Claims)||' Overrides' as "Name" ,null as "Eff Date",null as "Term Date",null as "Reason" ,'1' as "type" ,'1' as "Order_by"
,'1' as "key" from final_query
group by SystemLink
union  all 
  select SystemNumber::varchar as "User",null as "PDMI User", SystemName::varchar as "GPI",
 null as "GPI Description",null as "Type Code",null as "Enter Date",null as "Cardholder",
count(Claims)||' Overrides' as "Name" ,null as "Eff Date",null as "Term Date",null as "Reason",
'2' as "type" ,'2' as "Order_by"
,SystemNumber::varchar as "key" from final_query
group by SystemNumber,SystemName
union  all 
  select SponsorNumber::varchar as "User",null as "PDMI User", SponsorName::varchar as "GPI",
 null as "GPI Description",null as "Type Code",null as "Enter Date",null as "Cardholder",
count(Claims)||' Overrides' as "Name" ,null as "Eff Date",null as "Term Date",null as "Reason",
'3' as "type" ,'2' as "Order_by"
,(SystemNumber::varchar||SponsorNumber::varchar) as "key" from final_query
group by SponsorNumber,SponsorName,SystemNumber
union  all 
  select MasterGroupNumber::varchar as "User",null as "PDMI User", MasterGroupName::varchar as "GPI",
 null as "GPI Description",null as "Type Code",null as "Enter Date",null as "Cardholder",
count(Claims)||' Overrides' as "Name" ,null as "Eff Date",null as "Term Date",null as "Reason",
'4' as "type" ,'2' as "Order_by"
,(SystemNumber::varchar||SponsorNumber::varchar||MasterGroupNumber::varchar) as "key" from final_query
group by MasterGroupNumber,MasterGroupName,SystemNumber,SponsorNumber
union  all 
  select SUBSTRING(cast(GroupNumber as varchar), 1, LENGTH(cast(GroupNumber as varchar)) - 3) || '-' || RIGHT(cast(GroupNumber as varchar), 3) as "User",null as "PDMI User", GroupName::varchar as "GPI",

'5' as "type" ,'2' as "Order_by"
,(SystemNumber::varchar||SponsorNumber::varchar||MasterGroupNumber::varchar||GroupNumber::varchar) as "key" from final_query
group by GroupNumber,GroupName,SystemNumber,SponsorNumber,MasterGroupNumber

select '' as "User", ("PDMI_User") as "PDMI User" ,

to_char(EffectiveDate,'mm/dd/yyyy')::VARCHAR as "Eff Date",to_char(TermDate,'mm/dd/yyyy')::varchar as "Term Date",Reason as "Reason",
'6' as "type",'2' as "Order_by",
(SystemNumber::varchar||SponsorNumber::varchar||MasterGroupNumber::varchar||GroupNumber::varchar||PatientID::varchar) as "key"

Final_Query as(
SELECT 
distinct   
c.CLAIM_KEY as "CLAIM KEY",  
gd.SYSTEM_LINK as "SYSTEM LINK",   
gd.SYSTEM_NUMBER as "SYSTEM NUMBER",   
gd.SPONSOR_NUMBER as"SPONSOR NUMBER",

phdm.NABP_NUMBER as "NABP NUMBER",   
phdm.PHARMACY_NAME as "PHARMACY NAME",   
c.CHAIN_NUMBER as "CHAIN NUMBER",  
--CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.CARDHOLDER_KEY ELSE cd.CARDHOLDER_KEY END AS CARDHOLDER_KEY,  
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER ELSE cd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER END AS "CARDHOLDER NUMBER",   
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.MEMBER_NUMBER ELSE cd.MEMBER_NUMBER END AS "MEMBER NUMBER",   
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_LAST_NAME ELSE cd.LAST_NAME END AS "LAST NAME",   
CASE WHEN gd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG = 'N' THEN c.PATIENT_FIRST_NAME ELSE cd.FIRST_NAME END AS "FIRST NAME",   
c.DAW_INDICATOR as "DAW INDICATOR",  
c.DRUG_PREF_IND as "DRUG PREF IND",  
c.GENERIC_CODE as "GENERIC CODE",   
c.GPI,  
dd.NDC,   
dd.PROD,  
dd.PROD_ABBR as "PROD ABBR",   
c.RX_DATE as "RX DATE",    
c.RX_NUMBER as "RX NUMBER",  
c.METRIC_QUANTITY as "METRIC QUANTITY",   
c.DAYS_SUPPLY as "DAYS SUPPLY",    
'$'||c.AMOUNT_PAID as "AMOUNT PAID",   
'$'||c.COPAY as "COPAY",   
'$'||c.ING_PAID as "ING PAID",   
'$'||c.DISP_FEE as "DISP FEE",   
'$'||c.ADMIN_FEE as "ADMIN FEE",   
'$'||c.TAX ,  
c.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR as CCI 
from 
(SELECT    
CLAIM_KEY,  
CHAIN_NUMBER,  
PHYSICIAN_NUMBER_X,  
GENERIC_CODE,  
REVERSAL_CODE,  
GPI,  
RX_DATE,  
PROCESS_DATE,  
RX_NUMBER,  
PCN,
PATIENT_FIRST_NAME,
CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,
DAW_INDICATOR,
GROUP_NUMBER,
DRUG_PREF_IND,
METRIC_QUANTITY,  
DAYS_SUPPLY,  
AMOUNT_PAID,  
COPAY,  
ING_PAID,  
DISP_FEE,  
ADMIN_FEE, 
MEMBER_NUMBER,
TAX ,  
PATIENT_LAST_NAME,
CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR as CCI,  
CARDHOLDER_KEY,DRUG_KEY,PHARMACY_NUMBER,
EXCEPTION_20,CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR from cloud_data_warehouse.claims where meta_curr_ind = 'Y' and PROCESS_DATE
between (select start_date from data_filters) AND (select end_date from data_filters)
and CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR in ( 'Y' ,'C') and DAW_INDICATOR in ('1','2','3') and sys_number=162 and SPONSOR_NUMBER=1291) as c
inner join
(select 
SYSTEM_LINK,  
SYSTEM_NUMBER,  
SPONSOR_NUMBER,  
SPONSOR_NAME,  
MASTER_GROUP,  
GROUP_NUMBER,
CARDHOLDER_NUMBER_FLAG
from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') as gd
ON gd.GROUP_NUMBER = c.GROUP_NUMBER 
inner join 
(select
CARDHOLDER_KEY,  
CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  
MEMBER_NUMBER,  
LAST_NAME,  
FIRST_NAME,  
SEX AS GENDER,  
BIRTH_DATE
from cloud_data_warehouse.cardholder_data where meta_curr_ind = 'Y')  as cd
ON cd.CARDHOLDER_KEY = c.CARDHOLDER_KEY  
inner join
(select
NDC,  
PROD,  
PROD_ABBR,
DRUG_KEY
from cloud_data_warehouse.DRUG_DATA where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') as dd
ON dd.DRUG_KEY = c.DRUG_KEY 
inner join 
(select
PHARMACY_NUMBER from cloud_data_warehouse.PHARMACY_DATA where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') as pd
ON pd.PHARMACY_NUMBER = c.PHARMACY_NUMBER  
inner join
(select gpi from cloud_data_warehouse.GPI_DATA where meta_curr_ind = 'Y') as gpi
ON gpi.GPI = c.GPI  
inner join
(select  nabp_number, NPI_NUMBER, PHARMACY_NAME from cloud_data_warehouse.phdem where meta_curr_ind = 'Y' and SYSTEM_NUMBER=0) as phdm
ON phdm.NABP_NUMBER = c.PHARMACY_NUMBER)

(select

  grp.SYSTEM_NUMBER,      
  grp.SYSTEM_NAME,      
  grp.SPONSOR_NUMBER,      
  grp.SPONSOR_NAME,

  cd.LAST_NAME,      
  cd.CARD_NUMBER_ON_CARD,      
  gpi.GPI,

  exc.PHARMACY_NUMBER ,    
  exc.NDC,  
  exc.CHAIN_NUMBER,  
exc.PHYSICIAN_NUMBER,  
exc.DAYS_SUPPLY,  
exc.METRIC_QUANTITY,  
exc.COPAY_OVERRIDE,  
exc.MAX_DOLLAR,  
exc.MAX_DOLLAR_TO_DATE,  
exc.OCCURENCE,  
exc.NO_MAXIMUM,  
exc.MAX_DL_1,  
exc.MAX_TO_DATE_1,  
exc.OCCUR_1,  
exc.MED_CODE

(
select group_ter_date,
SYSTEM_LINK,      
  SYSTEM_NUMBER,      
  SYSTEM_NAME,      
  SPONSOR_NUMBER,      
  SPONSOR_NAME,      
  MASTER_GROUP,      
MASTER_GROUP_NAME,      
  GROUP_NUMBER,      
  GROUP_NAME,      
ALT_GROUP_NUMBER
from cloud_data_warehouse.group_data  
where meta_curr_ind = 'Y' and SYSTEM_NUMBER= 162 and SPONSOR_NUMBER=1291) grp
on grp.group_number =cd.grp_1 and  grp.sponsor_number=cd.SPON_NUMBER
left join 
(select cardholder_number ,member_number ,sponsor ,gpi,"user" ,reason ,enter_date ,eff_date_1 ,
 term_date_1 ,change_date ,type_code ,pharmacy_number ,ndc ,chain_number ,physician_number  ,days_supply ,metric_quantity ,copay_override ,max_dollar ,
 max_dollar_to_date ,occurence, no_maximum ,max_dl_1 ,max_to_date_1 ,occur_1 ,med_code  from cloud_data_warehouse.exceptions where meta_curr_ind ='Y'
 and 
 -- if @ExceptionReportType = 'E'      
--((ENTER_DATE BETWEEN (select start_date from data_filters) AND (select end_Date from data_filters))
--or (CHANGE_DATE between (select start_date from data_filters) AND (select end_Date from data_filters)))
--if @ExceptionReportType = 'A'      
EFF_DATE_1 <= (select end_Date from data_filters)        
 AND (TERM_DATE_1 IS NULL or TERM_DATE_1 = '1801-01-01' OR TERM_DATE_1 >= (select end_Date from data_filters))
 ) as exc
 on  exc.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER = cd.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER

(select gpi,gpi_description from cloud_data_warehouse.gpi_data  where meta_curr_ind = 'Y')  as gpi
on gpi.gpi = exc.GPI
),
final_result as(

'' as "Cardholder Number",
'' as "Name", 
SYSTEM_LINK as GPI,
 '' as "GPI Description",
 '' as "User Name",
 '' as "PDMI Name",
 count(Claims)||' Exceptions'  as "Enter Date",
 '' as "Change Date",
 '' as "Eff Date",
 '' as "Term Date",
 '' as "Reason",
 '1' as "type",
 '1' as "Key"

group by SYSTEM_LINK
union all 
select 
'' as "Cardholder Number",
SYSTEM_NUMBER::text as "Name", 
SYSTEM_name as GPI,
 '' as "GPI Description",
  '' as "User Name",
 '' as "PDMI Name",
 count(Claims)||' Exceptions'  as "Enter Date",
 '' as "Change Date",
 '' as "Eff Date",
 '' as "Term Date",
 '' as "Reason",
  '2' as "type",
SYSTEM_NUMBER::varchar as "Key"
from final_data
group by SYSTEM_NUMBER,SYSTEM_name
union all 
select 
'' as "Cardholder Number",
Sponsor_NUMBER::text as "Name", 
Sponsor_name as GPI,
 '' as "GPI Description",
  '' as "User Name",
 '' as "PDMI Name",
 count(Claims)||' Exceptions'  as "Enter Date",
 '' as "Change Date",
 '' as "Eff Date",
 '' as "Term Date",
 '' as "Reason",
   '2' as "type",
SYSTEM_NUMBER::varchar||Sponsor_NUMBER::varchar as "Key"
from final_data
group by Sponsor_NUMBER,Sponsor_name,SYSTEM_NUMBER
union all 
select 
'' as "Cardholder Number",
MASTER_GROUP::text as "Name", 
MASTER_GROUP_NAME as GPI,
 '' as "GPI Description",
  '' as "User Name",
 '' as "PDMI Name",
 count(Claims)||' Exceptions'  as "Enter Date",
 '' as "Change Date",
 '' as "Eff Date",
 '' as "Term Date",
 '' as "Reason",
    '2' as "type",
SYSTEM_NUMBER::varchar||Sponsor_NUMBER::varchar||MASTER_GROUP::varchar as "Key"
from final_data
group by MASTER_GROUP,MASTER_GROUP_NAME,MASTER_GROUP,SYSTEM_NUMBER,Sponsor_NUMBER
union all 
select 
'' as "Cardholder Number",
GROUP_NUMBER::text as "Name", 
GROUP_NAME as GPI,
 '' as "GPI Description",
  '' as "User Name",
 '' as "PDMI Name",
 count(Claims)||' Exceptions'  as "Enter Date",
 '' as "Change Date",
 '' as "Eff Date",
 '' as "Term Date",
 '' as "Reason",
     '2' as "type",
SYSTEM_NUMBER::varchar||Sponsor_NUMBER::varchar||MASTER_GROUP::varchar||GROUP_NUMBER::varchar as "Key"
from final_data
group by GROUP_NUMBER,MASTER_GROUP,MASTER_GROUP_NAME,MASTER_GROUP,SYSTEM_NUMBER,Sponsor_NUMBER,GROUP_NAME
union all 
select 
(cardholder_number||'-'||MEMBER_NUMBER) as "Cardholder Number",      
 (LAST_NAME||', '||FIRST_NAME) as "Name",

GPI_DESCRIPTION as "GPI Description",

 to_char(EFF_DATE_1,'mm/dd/yyyy') as "Eff Date",
 to_char(TERM_DATE_1,'mm/dd/yyyy') as "Term Date",
 REASON as "Reason",
     '2' as "type",
(SYSTEM_NUMBER::varchar||Sponsor_NUMBER::varchar||MASTER_GROUP::varchar||GROUP_NUMBER::varchar||cardholder_number::varchar) as "Key"
from final_data
group by GROUP_NUMBER,MASTER_GROUP,MASTER_GROUP_NAME,MASTER_GROUP,SYSTEM_NUMBER,Sponsor_NUMBER,GROUP_NAME,cardholder_number,

 "Cardholder Number",

 "User Name",
 "PDMI Name",
 "Enter Date",
 "Change Date",
 "Eff Date",
 "Term Date",
 "Reason"

 gd.GROUP_NUMBER,

 gd.SPONSOR_NUMBER,

 gd.SYSTEM_NAME,

MIDDLE_INITIAL,

BIRTH_DATE,  
SEX ,
CARDHOLDER_KEY,  
CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,  
MEMBER_NUMBER,

TEAM_MEMBER,

STREET_2,

SYSTEM_NAME,

select MASTER_GROUP::varchar,MasterGroupName::varchar,'Active Members:' as "Cardholder Number"
,count(*)::varchar as "Cardholder Name" ,null as "Birth Date" , null as "Effective Date" , null as "Term Date",'3' as "type", (MASTER_GROUP::varchar) as "key",'2' as "Order_By"  from sample

 '5' as "type", (GROUP_NUMBER::varchar ||(CARDHOLDER_NUMBER::varchar||'-'||MEMBER_NUMBER::varchar)) as "key",'2' as "Order_By"

		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0) CARDHOLDERKEY, 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc) DrugKey,
		CLAIMS.cardholder_number || ' - ' || claims.member_number as cardholdernumber,
		CLAIMS.Member_Number as membernumber,
		to_char(CLAIMS.RX_DATE,'mm/dd/yyyy') as RxDate,
		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER as RxNumber,
		CLAIMS.member_first_name as firstname,
		CLAIMS.member_last_name as lastname,
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_SEX as gender,
		CLAIMS.prod_abbreviation as PROD_ABBR,
		claims.ndc as NDC,
		Claims.age,
		claims.cardholder_sex,
		COUNT(*) AS Claims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_amount_paid) AS AmtPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.patient_pay) AS Copay,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_dispensing_fee) AS DispFee,
		SUM(CLAIMS.TAX) as Tax,
		SUM(CLAIMS.client_ingredient_paid) AS IngPaid,
		SUM(CLAIMS.UCR_AMOUNT) AS UCRAmount,
		SUM(CLAIMS.awp_100_percent) AS AWP100Pcnt,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.drug_pref_indicator WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonFormularyClaims,
		SUM(CLAIMS.METRIC_QUANTITY) AS MetricQuantity, 
		SUM(CLAIMS.DAYS_SUPPLY) AS DaysSupply,
		SUM(CASE CLAIMS.GENERIC_CODE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GenericClaims
	FROM  subscriptions.mv_claims_financial CLAIMS
	where ((CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR = 'D'  AND (CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal IS NULL OR CLAIMS.Date_of_Reversal > CLAIMS.period_ending )) OR 
			(CLAIMS.CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'N' AND CURRENT_CLAIM_INDICATOR <> 'D'))

		CLAIMS.SYSTEMNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.system_name,
		CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.SPONSOR_NAME,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP,
		CLAIMS.MASTER_GROUP_NAME,
		CLAIMS.GROUPNUMBER,
		CLAIMS.group_name,
		LPAD(CLAIMS.SPONSORNUMBER,8,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,10,0) || lpad(CLAIMS.MEMBER_NUMBER,2,0), 
		('00' || CLAIMS.ndc_type_code || CLAIMS.ndc),
		CLAIMS.CARDHOLDER_NUMBER,

		CLAIMS.RX_NUMBER,

cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar) as key
from 
final_data
group by
	groupnumber,
	groupname,
	altgroupnumber,
	cast((sponsornumber || groupnumber)  as varchar)
	
union all 

select
	Null as groupnumber,
	'Total'  as groupname,
	Null as "Client Group Number",
	sum(claimcount) as "Claims",
	sum(sys_adminfee) as "Admin Fee",
	sum(claiminvoiceamount) as "Claims Paid",
	sum(claiminvoiceamount + sys_adminfee) as "Total",
	'4.Total' as type,
	'Total' as key
from
final_data

)
order by key,type asc
